name: Union EXP
description: Union Level EXP. Obtained from exploration.
background: Rich experience helps to adapt to the survival rules of this world.

name: Shell Credit
description: The universal currency issued by Huanglong, officially recognized across many regions.
background:
In the ancient past, the ancestors of Huanglong utilized seashells as currency. Though the manufacturing techniques have evolved over time, the shell-like appearance of this currency has endured. 
"As a witness, it preserves the history of our people."

name: Astrite
description: The precious remnants of the civilization reverberate within... Perhaps they hold infinite possibilities.
background: Echoes from distant planets have found their way here from the vast expanse of the universe. In the starry night, the symphony of civilizations from untold light-years away resonates.

name: Lunite
description: Within the changing Lunite lies a treasure known as truth... Perhaps it reveals everything about the past and the future.
background: The moon has long been shattered by the Waveworn Phenomenon. What we observe is nothing but the past's mirage.

name: Waveplate
description:
Waveplates gradually restores over time and there is a storage limit.
Astrites can be consumed to exchange for Waveplates.
background: Data values reflecting the real-time status of the Resonator. When the Resonator is active, the Waveplate gradually depletes. Once it reaches a critical level, the Resonator's mobility becomes restricted.

name: Waveplate Crystal
description:
Refined Waveplate with a higher purity.
Waveplate Crystals start to regenerate once Waveplates are full, at the rate of 1 per 12 minutes. Consume to replenish an equal amount of Waveplates.
background:
Created using the special technology from the Black Shores. An effective form to store and manage Waveplate resources.
"Always be prepared to avoid wastage."

name: Podcast Experience
description: Experience obtained from completing Podcast Tasks can be used to upgrade the Podcast level.
background: Complete Podcast Tasks to build up energy and earn valuable rewards.

name: Activity Points
description: Item obtained from dailies, can be collected to receive daily rewards.
background: Following the direction of the pointer, you travel on the land of Solaris-3, these journeys will never be forgotten.

name: Data Bank experience
description: The experience used to upgrade the Data Bank level can be obtained by unlocking new Echo.
background: "Calculate accurately and evolve continuously."

name: Data Set
description: The combat data obtained from the Tactical Hologram: Calamity can be exchanged for various rewards in the Simulation Training Store.

name: Hazard Record
description: The precious experimental records brought back from the Tower of Adversity can be exchanged for various rewards in the Adversity Exchange.

name: Survey Points
description: Obtained from completing Survey Tasks. Survey Points can be exchanged for various rewards in the Wuthering Exploration event.

name: Preparation Credits
description: A written order for materials with an inventory schedule attached. Used for Wishes. Automatically restored to 100 at 04:00.
background: The supplies prepared for the Moonlit Fair must be meticulously planned and allocated to ensure they fulfill as many wishes as possible.
source: Wishing Stall (Complete Wish Upon the Moon IV to unlock)
Automatically restores to the full at 04:00 a.m.

name: Operation Fund
description: Funds prepared for the Moonlit Fair that are used for construction or Wishes.
background: You can never have too many funds if you want to hold a grand festival.

name: Wish
description: The Wish Tag of a fulfilled wish. Used to improve characters' stats.
background: Completed Wish Tags are stored carefully as invaluable mementos to everyone who has worked hard to make the Moonlit Fair possible.
source: Xiang-LEE (Complete Wish Upon the Moon IV to unlock)

name: Popularity
description: Popularity Points are gained by completing Wishes. They indicate how successful the Moonlit Fair is.
background: An objective overview of the number of visitors at the Moonlit Fair and their feedback, gathered through big data analysis, anonymous questionnaires, community reviews, and random street interviews.

name: Palace Lantern
description: A common souvenir of the Moon-Chasing Festival that can be exchanged for exclusive rewards.
background: Perfect for holding in one's hand, this small and exquisite lantern is usually given out as souvenirs during the festival.

name: Lollo Stamp
description: The voucher used to redeem the Lollo Helper special delivery.
background:
Thank you for being a Lollo Helper!
To express our gratitude, we'd love to present you with a Lollo Stamp. You can use it to exchange for your Lollo Helper special delivery during all Lollo Campaign events.

name: Tide Note
description:
A note containing music scores of Solaris's unique music.
Collect a certain number of these notes to claim rewards on the event page.
background:
In a world constructed out of energy and syntony, all words and stories can be sung in music.
"I came into this world, bringing naught but paper, rope, and a shadow."

name: Dream Fragment
description: Dream Fragment
background: Dream Fragment

name: Dream Fragment
description: Dream Fragment
background: Dream Fragment

name: Dream Fragment
description: Dream Fragment
background: Dream Fragment

name: Stardust
description: A special material. A reward will be granted after you've gathered a certain number of them.
background:
Tiny shards of stars that long lost their blaze.
Observe and deduce, and in time, you'll find the entire history of Solaris in even the tiniest of fragments.
"For eons, she has been a solitary caretaker of stars, old or new, dead or alive."

name: Adventure Log
description: A token earned by submitting exploration reports from various regions. Can be exchanged for "Adventure Packages" during the Beyond the Waves event series.
background: "If the Pioneer Association is the eyes of civilization, then Lollo Logistics aspires to be the feet that carry humanity forward," a Lollo Logistics member remarked during an interview.

name: Rinascita Commemorative Stamp
description: Commemorative stamps issued by the Pioneer Association. Obtain enough number of them to redeem rewards.
background:
A commemorative stamp issued by the Ragunna branch of the Pioneer Association, themed around the long-awaited return of the Carnevale.
The sea breeze welcomes the return of this grand celebration!
"Some spend their entire lives chasing illusions, only left to seek relief within them.
Now, go forth—time to live in a real life!"

name: Riccioli Fishery Coin
description: The fishery coin circulated within the Riccioli Islands. Can be used to purchase fishing gear and cover daily expenses.
background: The Riccioli Islands, a territory of Rinascita, uses Shell Credits as well. However, fishermen and sailors there have their own unique currency for sea trade.

name: Abyssal Coral
description: A precious coral cherished by Riccioli fishermen. Can be used to redeem rewards.
background: It's a tradition to trade using precious corals in the Riccioli Islands—though, not all corals are conveniently washed ashore by the waves.

name: Coast Flax
description: A special Coast Flax native to the Riccioli Islands. Can be used to enhance Fishing Abilities.
background: A special Coast Flax native to the Riccioli Islands, often used as a roughing material.

name: Palm Tree Log
description: A special Palm Tree Log native to the Riccioli Islands. Can be used to enhance Fishing Abilities.
background: A special Palm Tree Log native to the Riccioli Islands, often used as a roughing material.

name: Metal Debris
description: Metal Debris discovered in the Riccioli Islands. Can be used to enhance Fishing Abilities.
background: Metal Debris discovered in the Riccioli Islands. Despite erosion from the sea, it is still suitable as a roughing material.

name: "Sweet Puff"
description: A special species of Gulpuff. Can be used as explosives, thus they are known as "Bampuffs."
background: It is said that this particular type of Gulpuff releases a sweet fragrance when it explodes, making it a sought-after material for crafting wedding fireworks.

name: Sandworm
description: The most common bait in Rinascita. Casting it with Baiting creates an ideal Fishing Spot.
background: The go-to bait for Riccioli fishermen, rich in the shallow seas.

name: Trial Coin
description: A special coin forged by the Fisalia family, obtained by completing Tactical Hologram: Phantom Pain. Can be exchanged for a variety of supplies prepared by the Fisalias.

name: Fame
description: Used to increase your Fame Level in the Riccioli Islands.
background: The rule is simple: the more fish you catch, the more experience you gain as a fisherman, and the more Fame you earn. Just remember, fish are never meant to be worn as medals on your chest.

name: Nameless Coin
description: A mysterious coin uncovered while fishing in the Riccioli Islands. Can be used to redeem rewards.
background: An ancient coin eroded by the sea, its faint carving of a horse barely discernible. Its true value remains deeply hidden in history.

name: Universal Compass
description: A mysterious compass, used to unlock Key Fishing Ability.
background: What use is a compass with a malfunctioning pointer? Where is it pointing?

name: Old Compass
description: An old compass, used to unlock and enhance other Fishing Abilities.
background: This compass is so old that it's impossible to tell if it's malfunctioning or working perfectly. But does it really matter? As long as it points somewhere, who cares where it lead, right?

name: Rinascita Fishing Guidebook
description: A guidebook obtained by chance, used to enhance Rover's Fishing Ability.
background: A detailed guidebook compiled by Rinascita's finest fishing experts—but remember, it takes no responsibility for what's caught.

name: Fragment of a Mysterious Scripture
description: A scripture fragment obtained by chance, used to enhance Phoebe's Fishing Ability.
background: A scripture fragment found on the seabed of the Riccioli Islands, documenting what is unrecorded in the Codex of the Order of the Deep. Those fragmentary words seem to respond to the very call of the ocean.

name: Adventure Log
description: A token earned by submitting exploration reports from various regions. Can be exchanged for "Adventure Packages" during the Beyond the Waves event series.
background: "If the Pioneer Association is the eyes of civilization, then Lollo Logistics aspires to be the feet that carry humanity forward," a Lollo Logistics member remarked during an interview.

name: Matrix Crystal
description: A data crystal generated by the system's backend, containing challenge-related data. Can be used to redeem event rewards in "Virtual Crisis."
background: The Tethys System faithfully logs every action in the simulated battleground. These data crystallize into tangible forms, fueling the Stellar Matrices' calculations. Though not in reality, every success and failure paves the way to the future.

name: Popularity
description: A unit of quantified influence used to support your favorite Cube. Only to be used in the Second Coming of Solaris.
background: Enjoy the attention on you and the competition itself! Feel the rush of wild winds upon the field, and embrace both the victories and defeats that await at the finish line.

name: Magic Dice
description: A dice for the Warmup. Can be used in the Cubie Derby: Warmup.
background: A peculiar dice crafted to spice up the match. Its creator believes that luck-based competition is far more thrilling than mere tests of strength, especially when a single lucky roll can help the underdog snatch victory from the jaws of defeat.

name: Adventure Log
description: A token earned by submitting exploration reports from various regions. Can be exchanged for "Adventure Packages" during the Beyond the Waves event series.
background: "If the Pioneer Association is the eyes of civilization, then Lollo Logistics aspires to be the feet that carry humanity forward," a Lollo Logistics member remarked during an interview.

name: Nightmarket Token
description: A black-gold metallic token that the Gilded Nightmarket accepts in exchange for all sorts of items.
background: A chip found in Black Alley. Some say it is cast from the daggers of the defeated, while others say it is made from violently pried-off bottle caps... In any case, it's worth something to Black Alley merchants.

name: Trial Point
description: Can be used to increase your Trial Level.
background: The essence of tribulations endured by warriors, which charges up the Banners of Conquest.

name: Hunt Point
description: Can be used to increase your Glory Level.
background: The essence of bravery shown by warriors, which charges up the Banners of Conquest.

name: Matrix Crystal
description: A data crystal generated by the system's backend, containing challenge-related data. Can be used to redeem event rewards in "Virtual Crisis."
background: The Tethys System faithfully logs every action in the simulated battleground. These data crystallize into tangible forms, fueling the Stellar Matrices' calculations. Though not in reality, every success and failure paves the way to the future.

name: Challenge Progress
description: Your progress in the "Banners Never Fall" event. Unlock bountiful rewards by increasing your progress.
background: Valiant warriors, go claim the final victory!

name: Festivity Point
description: A token of festival gaiety obtained in Solaris New Voyage Celebration. Can be used to advance reward progress.
background: A true celebration should be full of life! Bring your friends, dive into the fun, and crank up the excitement!

name: Challenge Progress
description: Your progress in the "Banners Never Fall" event. Unlock bountiful rewards by increasing your progress.
background: Valiant warriors, go claim the final victory!

name: Dreamland Badge
description: A memento from the Dreamland, used to redeem rewards.
background: An exquisite badge once given to guests of Dreamland as a souvenir. The Hocus Pocus on it seems to be ever beckoning guests into a wonderland of boundless surprises.

name: Lost Mirror Piece
description: A shard of mirror showing the reflection of the White Cat. Used to unlock Dream Boon.
background: A shard of mirror showing the reflection of the White Cat. But on which side of the mirror does reality lie? Glancing into it feels like delving into a dream.

name: Badge of Glory
description: A souvenir badge for travelers in Septimont. Can be used to advance reward progress in Gifts of Glory.
background: The Agon Medals are a mark of honor for the people of Septimont. Over time, they have become one of the symbols of the city itself. Inspired by that, this souvenir badge lets travelers carry home a piece of Septimont's fiery spirit. Even far away from Septimont, they can still hear the echo of battle in their hearts.

name: Badge of Glory
description: A souvenir badge for travelers in Septimont. Can be used to advance reward progress in Gifts of Glory.
background: The Agon Medals are a mark of honor for the people of Septimont. Over time, they have become one of the symbols of the city itself. Inspired by that, this souvenir badge lets travelers carry home a piece of Septimont's fiery spirit. Even far away from Septimont, they can still hear the echo of battle in their hearts.

name: Adventure Log
description: A token earned by submitting exploration reports from various regions. Can be exchanged for "Adventure Packages" during the Beyond the Waves event series.
background: "If the Pioneer Association is the eyes of civilization, then Lollo Logistics aspires to be the feet that carry humanity forward," a Lollo Logistics member remarked during an interview.

name: Blighted Fang
description: A calcified fang-shaped remnant of the Dark Tide creatures. Can be used to advance reward progress in Hunters' Rite.
background: A calcified fragment left behind by the Dark Tide creatures, shaped like a beast's fang. Though affected by Tidal Blight, it poses no threat and holds no practical purpose. To most, it's just another forsaken shard scattered across the Plateaus. But to Gladiators, Blighted Fangs carry meaning. Hunters who clash with the Dark Tide often claim these fangs from fallen Dark Tide creatures before they dissolve. Each fang is a blood-earned token of valor and a silent yet gleaming badge of honor.

name: Waveborn Moonstone
description: A mineral that holds a glimmer of light. Can be used in the Moonlit Revelation event to decipher the Lunar Phases.
background: A natural blue mineral, known for its ability to absorb glimmers of light. When night falls, it gleams with a soft glow like moonlight rippling across the sea, hence the name Waveborn Moonstone. In Septimont, its association with the moon has made it a medium for reading the Lunar Phases.

name: Lollo Stamp
description: The voucher used to participate in the Lollo Genie special lottery.
background: Each time you complete an order and upload the data, Lollo Stamps will be transferred to your account as smoothly as a warm cup of milk before bed.

name: Modding EXP
description: Experience gained by riding the motorbike through varied and challenging terrain. Used to upgrade an expedition motorbike's Modding Level.
background: Measure the world with your wisdom.

name: Adventure Log
description: A token earned by submitting exploration reports from various regions. Can be exchanged for "Adventure Packages" during the Beyond the Waves event series.
background: "If the Pioneer Association is the eyes of civilization, then Lollo Logistics aspires to be the feet that carry humanity forward," a Lollo Logistics member remarked during an interview.

name: Synchro Coin
description:
A special token issued by the Synchrolink System based on the trainee's performance in general simulation training.
Each hard-earned coin stands as proof of a Synchronist's progress and breakthroughs. Can be exchanged for a variety of supplies that the Academy prepared for Synchronists.

name: Antivoid Modding Point
description: A digital permit granted upon the completion of Modding Tasks. Used to install functional modules on an expedition motorbike.
background: "A full-on skill-point upgrade system, straight out of the classic RPGs! Now that's what we're talking about!"

name: All-Terrain Modding Point
description: A digital permit granted by increasing the Modding Level. Used to install functional modules on an expedition motorbike.
background: "A full-on skill-point upgrade system, straight out of the classic RPGs! Now that's what we're talking about!"

name: "Module"
description: Special drops from the Lahai-Roi region, which can be used to exchange for various items from I.R.I.S. at the Spacetrek Archive.
background:
The Spacetrek Collective has deployed Supply Chests across Lahai-Roi, serving not only as supply containers but also as terminals recording environmental data. 
These Supply Chests continuously record surrounding data, including temperature, humidity, frequency fluctuations, and the Voidmatter Index, storing it onto a disk known as the Module.
The information contained within the Modules can be revisited and analyzed, and they also serve as training data for I.R.I.S., nourishing her deep learning capabilities and enhancing her processing power.

name: Exploration Data
description: Exploration Data collected from research expeditions in Lahai-Roi. Used to upgrade Lahai-Roi Pioneer Level.
background: What can be observed can be sensed, and what can be sensed can be understood.

name: Spacetrek Datachip
description: An item issued by the Spacetrek Collective to researchers stationed in the frostlands. Used as a token for Tracing Progress.
background: Issued by the Spacetrek Collective to researchers stationed in the frostlands, this item enables the recording of field logs and research data at any time. Its specialized chip is engineered to survive the region's volatile climate and extreme conditions. To the researchers, it is more than a tool—it is a beacon of knowledge. They entrust it with the hard-earned insights of their expeditions, and bury these devices across the frozen expanse to guide those who come after.

name: Grand Commander's Blessing
description: A blessing from the Grand Commander. It hones the blade carried by your heart and makes you better prepared for the exam. For a while at least.
background: Open it to earn Interim GPA Level EXP that grants Interim GPA Levels effective for the current Exam.

name: Grand Commander's Blessing
description: A blessing from the Grand Commander. It hones the blade carried by your heart and makes you better prepared for the exam. For a while at least.
background: Interim GPA Level EXP earned by opening chests. Can grant Interim GPA Level effective for the current Exam.

name: Encrypted Data
description: Critical data that's carefully encrypted. Used to exchange for rewards in the Recurring Challenge "Endstate Matrix."
background: These data are invaluable relics of countless fallen civilizations. Fractured by the assault on the Matrix and stitched back together by viral corruption, they now drift scattered across the data space… Thankfully, the Spacetrek Collective has the means to restore them.

name: Spindrift
description: Token for redeeming items in the Bountiful Waves event.
background: Though merely the last foam of a wave, it still gleams with an unfading radiance. This is a gift from the tides.

name: Aerial Modding Point
description: A digital permit granted by increasing the Modding Level. Used to install functional modules on an expedition motorbike.
background: "A full-on skill-point upgrade system, straight out of the classic RPGs! Now that's what we're talking about!"

name: 2nd Anniversary Coin
description: Commemorative coins given out during the 2nd anniversary event of Second Coming of Solaris.
background: The 2nd anniversary of Second Coming of Solaris is a massive collaboration between Startorch Academy and the Spacetrek Collective, with Lollo Logistics and the Pioneer Association joining the bash. As for why Abby's face ended up on the commemorative coin... probably either Abby, or the great Abbowser still lurking somewhere inside Second Coming of Solaris, clearly demanded the spotlight.

name: Adventure Log
description: A token earned by submitting exploration reports from various regions. Can be exchanged for "Adventure Packages" during the Beyond the Waves event series.
background: "If the Pioneer Association is the eyes of civilization, then Lollo Logistics aspires to be the feet that carry humanity forward," a Lollo Logistics member remarked during an interview.

name: Voidmatter Chip
description: Data chips scattered beneath the frostlands, presumed to have been left behind by expedition members. Used as a token for Tracing Progress.
background: Data chips scattered beneath the frostlands, their surfaces scarred by the corruption of a Void Storm, like final words left for Solaris by the explorers who never returned. Time does not erase everything. The proof of what once happened, of what was endured, slowly settles alongside those fearless souls.

name: Simulation Data
description: Large quantities of data gathered during the testing of the hologram.
background: The more data is collected from the drills, the more accurate the Waveworn Phenomena simulations become.

description: Item obtained from dailies, can be collected to receive daily rewards.
background: Following the direction of the pointer, you travel on the land of Solaris-3, these journeys will never be forgotten.

name: CredChip
description: The digital currency of Night City brought by the Edgerunners. Collect and exchange them for rewards with the Edgerunners.
background: "Remember, only money that can be traced is clean money."

name: Pull Tabs
description: The currency used to exchange for items in Store.
background: "It's so much harder to part with real cash, isn't it? I mean, if you're dead set on using paper money... just take this pull-tab. Pretend it's a coin and make do."

name: Sliver of Xuanfang
description: Mechanism fragments collected while exploring the Land of Xuanfang. They can be used to raise the level in "A Glimpse of Xuanfang" event.
background: Xuanfang Hold inches ceaselessly toward ruin... Before it vanishes for good, these fragments stand as witnesses, recording its every smallest collapse. Some say that within them, one can glimpse the whole of Xuanfang Hold.

name: Sparring Coin
description:
A special token forged by the Skyworks, which can be exchanged for an assortment of supplies prepared for the participants.
Every fierce battle the Xuanfang Hold has endured will become the experience that strengthens its foundation.

name: Regenerative Pistil
description:
Upload data to the Bioprinter to print Resonator Ascension Collectibles native to the following regions:
Huanglong - Jinzhou, Black Shores, Rinascita, Honami City
background:
Thanks to the efforts of the Spacetrek Collective, the Upphaf Life Chamber located in the Roya Frostlands is now officially operational. 
Simply input compliant sample data, and the chamber can "print" the designated plants identical to the original specimens.

name: Encrypted Data
description: Critical data that's carefully encrypted. Used to exchange for rewards in the Recurring Challenge "Endstate Matrix."
background: These data are invaluable relics of countless fallen civilizations. Fractured by the assault on the Matrix and stitched back together by viral corruption, they now drift scattered across the data space… Thankfully, the Spacetrek Collective has the means to restore them.

name: Influence
background: A symbol of long-standing mutual trust between Rover and various affiliations. By establishing stable friendships with different affiliations, Rover may gain stronger support in the future.

name: Crystal Solvent
description: Obtain 60 Waveplates after use.
background: A necessary solvent for Resonators. It not only helps stabilize themselves but also enhances the numerical level of Waveplates.

name: Inscription Device
description: Leave a Memo using the Memo system.
background: Portable Reverberation Marker produced by New Federation. It contains the mixture of high concentration Wutheronphage Cryptococcus (improved type II). With precisely calculated dose, user can mark down Resonating Sounds by injecting small amount of Wutheron.

name: Waypoint
description: A temporary Resonance Beacon that can be flexibly placed, it needs to be placed by consuming the core module.
background: A temporary Resonance Beacon employed for location marking by utilizing beacon data from its surroundings. While retaining the same functions as Resonance Beacons, it offers enhanced mobility, rendering it indispensable for field workers.

name: Casket Sonar
description: A portable gadget designed for pinpointing undiscovered special collectibles. Re-activating it requires Sonar Circuits.
background: Built upon the principles of previous sonar technology, this instrument can detect and pinpoint special collectibles by utilizing specific frequencies.

name: Lootmapper
description: Used to find the undiscovered treasures around the drop point.
background: The Lootmapper identifies specific frequencies to quickly locate nearby undiscovered Supply Chests and Tidal Heritage. It is an indispensable tool to facilitate exploration in the wilds.

name: Casket Sonar Use Permit: Jinzhou
description: Grants the bearer of this permit the access to Casket Sonar in given regions.
background: The use permit of the Casket Sonar in Jinzhou. To ensure frequency safety in Jinzhou, users are permitted to use the Casket Sonar only within authorized areas in compliance with this official permit.

name: Lootmapper Use Permit: Jinzhou
description: Grants the bearer of this permit the access to the Lootmapper in given regions.
background: The use permit of the Lootmapper in Jinzhou. To ensure frequency safety in Jinzhou, users are permitted to use the Lootmapper only within authorized areas in compliance with this official permit.

name: Sonar Circuit
description: Can be used to activate the Casket Sonar's search and pinpointing functions for special collectibles.
background: The most basic structure to artificially reproduce or store Remnant frequency. It allows the Casket Sonar to match the frequencies around with the Remnant information within its storage to locate special collectibles.

name: Waypoint Module
description: Used to activate the search function of Waypoint.
background: The core module of the Waypoint, responsible for collecting, sharing, and updating location information. It connects the Waypoint and the Resonance Beacon, making it essential for initiating and maintaining the functioning of the Waypoint.

name: Casket Sonar Use Permit: Rinascita
description: Grants the bearer of this permit the access to Casket Sonar in given regions.
background: The use permit of the Casket Sonar in Rinascita. To ensure frequency safety in Rinascita, users are permitted to use the Casket Sonar only within authorized areas in compliance with this official permit.
source: Reward for Sonance Casket collection in Rinascita

source: Reward for Sonance Casket collection in Rinascita

name: Wonder Bubble in the Port of Riccioli
description: A mysterious floating bubble where fish might be hiding. Upon purchase, a Wonder Bubble will be generated near the current dock to help Rover catch crabs and urchins.
background: Legend has it that this bubble forms from the breath of the Cetus the Tidebreaker, serving as a natural shelter for fish... until fishermen burst their bubble of sanctuary.
source: Reward for Sonance Casket collection in Rinascita

name: Sailer's Conviction
description: An awning for Rachel. Enhances cruising speed.
background: What follows is a long voyage—a relentless pursuit to the every edge of the world.

name: Faith of Unity
description: An awning for Rachel. Boosts the chance of gaining high-quality catches.
background: In the heart of the tempest, we gather. The storm may rage, but we were born to prevail.

name: Valor of Tidebreaker
description: An awning for Rachel. Helps evade certain threats while cruising.
background: Amidst the furious waves, we press on. It lies just before us.

name: Passion of Vengeance
description: An awning for Rachel. Increases the chance to gain catches of extreme sizes.
background: In the end, silence reigns. I am the only one who reports to you.

description: Grants the bearer of this permit the access to Casket Sonar in the given regions.

description: Special Operation Diary D12547
background: Special Operation Diary D12547

name: Broken Shackles
description: A damaged anklet, with a string of text engraved on the inside. After a long time, only the word "Institute" can be distinguished.
background: "I shall offer my one and only life for these broken shackles. A beast as I am, should also be given the highest acclaim."

name: Mangosteen
description: Mangosteen
background: Mangosteen

name: Sundial
description: Sundial
background: Sundial

name: test/Leaf
description: test/A Leaf
background: Leaf

name: scavenger hunt note
description: TEXT: At 7:00 a.m., where the shadow of the spire of the lighthouse in Central Plains lies, there is a treasure that only the brave and the strong can open.
background: Treasure note from a mysterious man

name: fantastic-tasting rice
description: Aureate Fried Rice turns into rice after sitting in the Backpack for a day.
background: rice

name: "Suppressor Tower I - Maintenance Log"
description: Maintenance log of Court of Savantae's No. I fog suppressor.
background: Maintenance log for Court of Savantae's No. I suppressor, documenting the research findings of the SR-461 team from the Court of Savantae during their time in Whining Aix's Mire.

name: "Suppressor Tower II - Maintenance Log"
description: Maintenance log of Court of Savantae's No. II fog suppressor.
background: Maintenance log for Court of Savantae's No. II suppressor, documenting the research findings of the SR-461 team from the Court of Savantae during their time in Whining Aix's Mire.

name: Unsent Electronic Communication
description: An electronic communication from a member of the SR-461 research team.
background: Appears to be the maintenance log for Court of Savantae's No. III suppressor. However, instead of research findings, it contains what seems to be an unsent message.

name: Basic Sealed Tube
description: Basic Echo EXP item. Provides 500 EXP.
background: A cylindrical storage that contains simplified frequency cluster. To activate it, users must rotate the cipher wheel to the correct position. Resonators can then extract its data using their Terminal, employing it to optimize the performance of the absorbed Echoes.

name: Medium Sealed Tube
description: Medium Echo EXP item. Provides 1,000 EXP.
background: A cylindrical storage that contains standard frequencies. To activate it, users must rotate the cipher wheel to the correct position. This medium-sized storage holds a greater volume of information compared to the basic version. Consequently, the database available for training is more complete, better optimizing the performance of the absorbed Echoes.

name: Advanced Sealed Tube
description: Advanced Echo EXP item. Provides 2,000 EXP.
background: A cylindrical storage that contains advanced frequencies. To activate it, users must rotate the cipher wheel to the correct position. This storage not only contains the database needed for routine training, but also incorporates simulation materials tailored to diverse scenarios. Therefore, it can fully exploit the potential of the absorbed Echoes.

name: Premium Sealed Tube
description: Premium Echo EXP item. Provides 5,000 EXP.
background: A cylindrical storage that contains special frequencies. To activate it, users must rotate the cipher wheel to the correct position. It contains precious data collected from various extreme environments, facilitating the revolutionary transformation of the absorbed Echoes.

name: Basic Tuner
description: A device for Tuning 2-star Echoes. Unlocks one Substat.
background: Adjust Echoes' frequencies, remove any noise, and unleash their true potential.

name: Medium Tuner
description: A device for Tuning 3-star Echoes. Unlocks one Substat.
background: Adjust Echoes' frequencies, remove any noise, and unleash their true potential.

name: Advanced Tuner
description: A device for Tuning 4-star Echoes. Unlocks one Substat.
background: Adjust Echoes' frequencies, remove any noise, and unleash their true potential.

name: Premium Tuner
description: A device for Tuning 5-star Echoes. Unlocks one Substat.
background: Adjust Echoes' frequencies, remove any noise, and unleash their true potential.

name: Modifier
tag: Please contact our Customer Service for assistance
description: Used to modify the Mainstat of an unenhanced 5-Star Echo.
background: Used to adjust Echo frequencies to obtain different characteristics.

name: Transducer
description: Used to modify the Substats of a fully-tuned 5-Star Echo.
background: A device designed to manipulate flowing frequencies. It blends human ingenuity with complex frequencies, making change tangible and controllable. With it, you can convert frequencies into the most functional forms you desire.

name: Sonance Casket
description: Exchangeable for resources when delivered to the relic merchant.
background: The Sonance Casket is a product of the natural decay and collapse of the Sonoro Sphere, containing the unlost past. Since the Sonoro Sphere is an important source of information for humans to understand the history of the Lament and the evolution of the civilization, the Sonance Casket, as a "fragment" and "condensation" of the Sonoro Sphere, is considered to have a high archaeological value and is regarded as an "antique" by people.

name: Windchimer
description: Exchangeable for resources when delivered to Xian'ge.
background: An ingenious gadget that captures sounds and transforms them into energy. It can be used in tuning. It is said to be of great interests to some collectors, who'd provide resources in exchange for them.

name: KU-Cass Cartridge
description: Submit it to KU-Cass to raise the Data Hub level.
background:
Game cartridges gathered and distributed by KU-Cass, a small robot active on the Black Shores. Some of the games are discontinued ones. These cartridges are sometimes given as awards in the Black Shores area.
"Why the cartridges if we can make them digital?"
"It's the tradition!"

name: Sonance Casket: Ragunna
description: Sonance Caskets in Ragunna are often found in precarious locations. Use Grapple for easier access. Deliver them to the Plushies in the Garden of the Lost in exchange for resources.
background: The product of a collapsed Sonoro Sphere, scattered all over the world. It records the untwisted memories of the past. The Plushies are collecting them—perhaps they'll have something in exchange.

name: Sonance Casket: Septimont
description: Sonance Caskets in Septimont are often found in precarious locations. Use Grapple for easier access. Deliver them to the Plushies in the Border Mountains in exchange for resources.
background: The product of a collapsed Sonoro Sphere, scattered all over the world. It records the untwisted memories of the past. The Plushies are collecting them—perhaps they'll have something in exchange.

name: Tape of Last Words
description: Touch to collect or use Grapple to hook and quickly approach the Tapes of Last Words scattered across Lahai-Roi.
background:
When the Void Storm consumes personnel carrying a Cassette, the magnetic moment within the device becomes corrupted, reducing it to a Tape of Last Words. The encoded information is rendered unreadable.
A Mechasout in a Solsworn apparel is now collecting these Tapes of Last Words in the hope of "cleansing" the Voidmatter corruption and restoring the data once preserved within them.

name: Soliseed of Essehalo
description: Obtained by finding a lost Soliskin. Deliver it to the Giant Soliskin at the Monument of Returning Soliseeds to claim your reward.
background: Like plants, the Essehalo floating above the Soliskin grows and bears fruits, which are carefully preserved and later given to those who earn the Soliskin's trust.

name: Unclaimed Rafter Kite
description: Touch to collect or use Grapple to hook and quickly approach the Unclaimed Rafter Kites.
background:
Rafter Kites carry letters, and each Unclaimed Rafter Kite holds a message undelivered for over a century. 
Deliver these to Qiuhong or Chiwen, and they will use them to learn more about Xuanfang Hold's past and better plan how to protect its future.

name: LF Whisperin Core
description: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
background: The Tacet Core of a feeble Whisperin. It takes the form of a broken star. Faint and deep frequencies are still lingering within the core, yet the messages they try to convey remain elusive to all.

name: MF Whisperin Core
description: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
background: The Tacet Core of a common Whisperin. It takes the form of a clear and complete star. Its Frequency Energy aligns with the hearing range of normal people. Yet, the question remains: what's the intention behind this imitation?

name: HF Whisperin Core
description: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
background: The Tacet Core of a powerful Whisperin. It takes the form of a star with sharp ridges along its outline—like an embodiment of its shrill Frequency Energy. Perhaps, its personification has already led to the Uncanny Valley effect.

name: FF Whisperin Core
description: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
background: The Tacet Core of a special Whisperin. It takes the form of an intricate star, bearing both recognizable and unfamiliar Frequency Energy. It seems that humans only know the tip of the iceberg of themselves.

name: LF Howler Core
description: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
background: The Tacet Core of a feeble Howler. It is the remaining part of a Tacetite Bloom after it withers. Despite its astonishing accuracy in mimicry, it only ends one way—reducing to a mass of twisted Frequency Energy.

name: MF Howler Core
description: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
background: The Tacet Core of a common Howler. After the Tacetite Bloom withers, a certain amount of Frequency Energy remains. Similar to the natural cycle of life, this frequency can probably serve as the sustenance for newcomers.

name: HF Howler Core
description: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
background: The Tacet Core of a powerful Howler. The fierce and untamed Frequency Energy continues to reverberate within it. Evolution is all about adapting to the environment. Who will emerge victorious from the ordeal of the devastating Waveworm Phenomenon?

name: FF Howler Core
description: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
background: The Tacet Core of a special Howler. It takes the form of a seed emerging from a withered Tacetite Bloom. Life is brimming with endless possibilities. This core, akin to the seed of life, also contains infinite possibilities.

name: Crude Ring
description: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
background: A crude ring that serves more as an identification than for practical use. It is used to display one's commitment to sever ties with civilized society.

name: Basic Ring
description: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
background: A ring with bearable quality. Apart from helping the Exiles to recognize each other's identification, it also provides various functions such as basic communication, location services, and scanning. These features assist the Exiles to better survive in the wilderness.

name: Improved Ring
description: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
background: An improved Ring, exclusive to a selected few. This ring stores a large amount of wilderness survival information. Certain entries detailing rare plants and special minerals hold academic significance compared to papers written by the Academy.

name: Tailored Ring
description: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
background: A ring made of special material using unique techniques. Its owner must boast a legendary experience. Much of the information stored within it is encrypted and challenging to decipher for details.

name: LF Polygon Core
description: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
background: A fractured polygonal Tacet Core with an intricate, terraced pattern. Cracks can be found on its frail spiral structure. Seems to be a simple power unit of a Tacet Discord.

name: MF Polygon Core
description: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
background: A common polygonal Tacet Core with an intricate, terraced pattern. The spiral structure is fairly complete. Seems to be an analog circuit recording the behavioral patterns of a Tacet Discord.

name: HF Polygon Core
description: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
background: A robust polygonal Tacet Core with an intricate, terraced pattern. The concentric layers spiral inward in dense steps. It's deduced the density of its pattern correlates with the complexity of the Tacet Discord's behavioral patterns.

name: FF Polygon Core
description: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
background: A robust polygonal Tacet Core with an intricate, terraced pattern. The polygonal structure shows a tendency to expand outwards, likely because of the lack of capacity for storing the growingly complex logic in the behaviors of a Tacet Discord.

name: LF Tidal Residuum
description: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
background: A friable formation resembling a stranded boat, often found on Tacet Discords in Rinascita. Legends say these once covered every shore as the Dark Tide receded.
source: Tacet Discords influenced by the Dark Tide

name: MF Tidal Residuum
description: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
background: A common formation resembling a storm-weathered boat, often found on Tacet Discords in Rinascita, which are said to be born of the Dark Tide and carry this Residuum since their formation.
source: Tacet Discords influenced by the Dark Tide

name: HF Tidal Residuum
description: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
background: A robust formation resembling a sailing ship, occasionally found on certain Tacet Discords in Rinascita. Legend say Tacet Discords with this Residuum can hear the distant echoes of the Dark Tide.
source: Tacet Discords influenced by the Dark Tide

name: FF Tidal Residuum
description: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
background: A unique formation resembling a tide-breaking vessel, found only on a few powerful Tacet Discords in Rinascita. Legend say Tacet Discords bearing this Residuum can chart the course to the Journeying Paradise.
source: Tacet Discords influenced by the Dark Tide

name: LF Exoswarm Core
description: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
background: Fragile flower-shaped Tacet Core, resembling a dying blossom. Commonly found in areas affected by Void Storms.

name: MF Exoswarm Core
description: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
background: Standard flower-shaped Tacet Core, resembling a wilting blossom. Often recovered from Exoswarm corrupted by Void Storms.

name: HF Exoswarm Core
description: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
background: Stable flower-shaped Tacet Core, resembling a budding blossom. Occasionally found in areas with frequent Void Storm occurrences.

name: FF Exoswarm Core
description: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
background: Unique flower-shaped Tacet Core, resembling a fully bloomed blossom. Found only in the most dangerous areas ravaged by Void Storms. Legend has it that when a Void Storm sweeps across Lahai-Roi, this kind of Tacet Core may be seen entwined around the body of the strongest Exoswarm.

name: LF Mech Core
description: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
background: Fragile triangle Tacet Cord, looking broken and unstable. Commonly found in areas affected by Void Storms.

name: MF Mech Core
description: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
background: Standard triangle Tacet Cord, on the brink of shattering. Commonly found in areas ravaged by Void Storms.

name: HF Mech Core
description: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
background: Stable triangle Tacet Cord, with a strong, enduring structure. Occasionally found in areas with frequent Void Storm occurrences.

name: FF Mech Core
description: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
background: Special triangle Tacet Cord, exhibiting the most resilient structure, retaining complete frequency even under intense energy shock. Legend has it that when a Void Storm sweeps across Lahai-Roi, this kind of Tacet Cord can control even the most powerful mech humanity has ever built.

name: Fractured Exoswarm Pendant
description: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
background: A broken pendant. It was a traditional Royan accessory used by the Roya to bind scattered Exoswarm components together, symbolizing connection. Among the Royan Outcasts, however, the Exoswarm are seen not as companions but as prey. They hunt the Exoswarm and take the pendants from other Roya as trophies of their victories.

name: Worn Exoswarm Pendant
description: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
background: A worn pendant. It was a traditional Royan accessory used by the Roya to bind scattered Exoswarm components together, symbolizing connection. Among the Royan Outcasts, however, the Exoswarm are seen not as companions but as prey. They hunt the Exoswarm and take the pendants from other Roya as trophies of their victories.

name: Chipped Exoswarm Pendant
description: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
background: A slightly worn pendant. It was a traditional Royan accessory used by the Roya to bind scattered Exoswarm components together, symbolizing connection. Among the Royan Outcasts, however, the Exoswarm are seen not as companions but as prey. They hunt the Exoswarm and take the pendants from other Roya as trophies of their victories.

name: Intact Exoswarm Pendant
description: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
background: A relatively intact pendant. It was a traditional Royan accessory used by the Roya to bind scattered Exoswarm components together, symbolizing connection. Among the Royan Outcasts, however, the Exoswarm are seen not as companions but as prey. They hunt the Exoswarm and take the pendants from other Roya as trophies of their victories.

name: LF Autopuppet Kernel
description: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
background: A weak kernel structure capable of providing only a limited amount of energy. The Autopuppets it powers are typically restricted to executing the simplest of commands. Commonly found on weak Autopuppets.

name: MF Autopuppet Kernel
description: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
background: A standard kernel structure produced in massive quantities. This is the most ubiquitous model, serving as the default powerhouse for standard Autopuppets. Commonly found across a wide variety of models.

name: HF Autopuppet Kernel
description: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
background: A powerful kernel structure capable of outputting a massive amount of energy. The Autopuppets it drives can execute exceptionally complex commands. It can only be recovered from the rare, formidable Autopuppets.

name: FF Autopuppet Kernel
description: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
background: A unique kernel structure that grants its host Autuppet a rudimentary form of "intelligence." Legends tell of an Autopuppet capable of perfectly passing as human, driven entirely by a kernel identical to this one. Out of the countless machines produced by the Skyworks, only the absolute pinnacle of models possesses the qualification to harbor it.

name: Mask of Constraint
description: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
background: A mask worn by Fractsidus recruits. It seems to be used to suppress the rejection reaction induced by the integration of Tacet Discords. The side effect that comes with it is the suppression of the wearer's normal human emotions. Perhaps, that's one of the designer's purposes?

name: Mask of Erosion
description: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
background: A mask worn by Fractsidus active members. Due to long-term use, its ability to stabilize frequency has been greatly mitigated. One can clearly feel the torment of being drowning in negative emotions from the mask.

name: Mask of Distortion
description: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
background: A mask worn by Fractsidus veterans. The original owner has now had no turning back on the road of Overclocking. Would they have chosen to wear this mask if they had foreseen all the torment and suffering that lay ahead?

name: Mask of Insanity
description: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
background: A very peculiar Fractsidus mask. It would be nearly impossible for a normal person to imagine the mental state of its owner. Judging from the residual frequency on the mask, one can perceive that the owner's emotions have become severely distorted, generating frequencies that resemble Tacet Discords.

name: Mysterious Code
description: Used for Rover's Ascension.
background: The metal scrolls with mysterious symbols seem to be able to create some kind of connection with Rover.

name: Strife Tacet Core
description: The Crownless's drop, a Resonator's Ascension item.
background: The core of Crownless's clone. Only more strife and sacrifice can mend the cracks and voids within this Tacet Core.

name: Thundering Tacet Core
description: Thundering Mephis's drop, used for Resonator Ascension.
background: The core of Thundering Mephis. Like a miniature thunderstorm, the core radiates a dazzling light between the flashes.

name: Elegy Tacet Core
description: Mourning Aix's drop, used for Resonator Ascension.
background: The Tacet Core of Mourning Aix, singing a never-ending elegy. Those who touch the Tacet Core will be overwhelmed by a great sense of loneliness and loss and will unconsciously shed tears. But this is not empathy, perhaps just a kind of emotional hypersensitivity.

name: Rage Tacet Core
description: Inferno Rider's drop, used for Resonator Ascension.
background: The Tacet Core of Inferno Rider, surrounded by the never-ending fire of rage. The raging flames, fueled by the supreme clamor, vow to burn everything to ashes.

name: Roaring Rock Fist
description: Feilian Beringal's drop, used for Resonator Ascension.
background: The rock shell covering the arm of Feilian Beringal, named for the thunderous roar of Feilian's heavy punch.

name: Gold-Dissolving Feather
description: Impermanence Heron's drop, used for Resonator Ascension.
background: The golden feathers of Impermanence Heron, from which a dirty and rotten smell constantly flows. A researcher once tried to seal the feathers in various metal containers, but the containers would corrode in a moment.

name: Sound-Keeping Tacet Core
description: Lampylumen Myriad's drop, used for Resonator Ascension.
background: The Tacet Core of Lampylumen Myriad, freezing the humming whispers. The surrounding sounds will be captured by the Tacet Core and turned into a cold absolute echo.

name: Group Abomination Tacet Core
description: Mech Abomination's drop, used for Resonator Ascension.
background: The huge Clamorling hidden in the underground ruins of Court of Savantae, is a huge collection of countless program logics. The heterogeneous Tacet Core is stacked in disorder, just like the complex code of the mechanical puppet.

name: Monument Bell
description: Bell-Borne Geochelone's drop, used for Skill Upgrade.
background: The ancient bell carried on the back of the Bell-Borne Geochelone. When the bell rings, the awakened past will leave a new mark in this era.

name: Wave-Cutting Tooth
description: Cetus the Tidebreaker's drop, used for Skill Upgrade.
background: The blue spiral-shaped heteromorphic sharp tooth of Cetus the Tidebreaker, capable of cutting through waves. Legend has it that the water surface cut through by the Cetus's tooth will leave long-lasting ripples.

name: Unending Destruction
description: Scar's drop, used for Skill Upgrade.
background: The card in Scar's hand with the mark of a black sheep. The flame attached to it seems to never extinguish. That flame will burn forever with Scar's never-ending desire for destruction.

name: Dreamless Feather
description: Dreamless's drop, used for Skill Upgrade.
background: Emerging from the abyss with aspirations of ruling the land and the beings in Jinzhou, it now lies extinguished in the shadows, leaving behind only this feather.

name: Hidden Thunder Tacet Core
description: Tempest Mephis's drop, used for Resonator Ascension.
background: The core of Tempest Mephis. Like a miniature thundercloud, the rumbling thunder spreads from the Tacet Core, causing the surroundings to quiver in its wake.

name: Sentinel's Dagger
description: Sentinel Jué's drop, used for Skill Upgrade.
background:
A ritual vessel gifted by Sentinel Jué.
Legend holds that upon the Lament's arrival in Jinzhou, time became entangled, with no more clear line between mornings and nights.
The Magistrate used the Sentinel's dagger as the gnomon of the sundial to determine the date and time.

name: Topological Confinement
description: Fallacy of No Return's drop, used for Resonator Ascension.
background: A dataset with an ever-changing topology that serves to create an infinite, eternal representation of reality. The Tethys System created this prison of causality, where unknown variations, including love and hope, are forever trapped.
source: Fallacy of No Return - Early Access

name: Cleansing Conch
description: Queen of the Night's drop, used for Resonator Ascension.
background: A mystical, star-speckled conch. Hold it to your ear, and you may hear Lorelei's faint whispers. It was once used by the lost faithful to clear their minds and strengthen their belief. Some say a tiny Sonoro hides within, and the whispers are nothing more than echoes of one's true self.

name: Platinum Core
description: Sentry Construct's drop, used for Resonator Ascension.
background: A finely crafted armor grants the Echo unstoppable strength, while a restless core hums quietly beneath its protective shell. Is it a mechanical component that powers the Echo, or a spirit trapped within its metal confines?

name: Blazing Bone
description: Dragon of Dirge's drop, used for Resonator Ascension.
background:
The bone of the giant dragon, burning with a haunting flame.
The fire blazes from its marrow, bringing both a soul-shaking trial and destruction to those who dare intrude. This is its eternal duty, a rage that never fades, ignited by those who forced it into service.

name: The Netherworld's Stare
description: Hecate's drop, used for Skill Upgrade.
background: The joyful rhythm of her rondo taps on the gates of the netherworld, and with a single exchange of glances, death takes its first step. A gaze from the other side transforms into a full moon, filling her hollow right eye—thus, the still moon shifts, awakened by her stare.

name: When Irises Bloom
description: Fleurdelys' drop, used for Skill Upgrade.
background:
An item bestowed on her during the Order's Initiation.

Fleurdelys used to be a meticulously crafted "idol" for the public. Only when the divine shell is shed can her true life begin.

Fleurdelys, or Cartethyia... Which name does she truly wish to live by?

name: Unfading Glory
description: Lioness of Glory's drop, used for Resonator Ascension.
background: When the hero's banner rises, even the mountains of Septimont honor this crown with respect. It's not made to dazzle like gold or gems. It's forged from sheer strength and unshakable will.

name: Truth in Lies
description: Fenrico's drop, used for Resonator Ascension.
background: He fumbled forward through formless chaos, barely recalling when the shift in his perception took hold—the day he rose as the Primus, an icy conviction settled in his chest, so cold that it burned in his clenching grip.
source: Fenrico: Deliverance in the Deep - Early Access

name: Blighted Crown of Puppet King
description: The False Sovereign's drop, used for Resonator Ascension.
background:
The shattered crown of the False Sovereign.
Forged from the collective yearning of the masses, the puppet took the form of their deepest desire. Yet its role as the Sovereign and even its very existence are nothing but a fabrication. When the tide recedes, the crown of power and authority is revealed to be nothing but a mask, tainted by the Dark Tide.

name: Abyssal Husk
description: Lady of the Sea - Embers of Glory's drop, used for Resonator Ascension.
background:
The cheers, the applause, the cry for glory from within...
She sinks, as if into the depths of the sea, drifting ever farther from those sounds of her past, unable to respond.
In the stillness below, only the shadows of a sea creature circle her in silence.
source: Lady of the Sea - Early Access

name: Curse of the Abyss
description: Threnodian Leviathan's drop, used for Skill Upgrade.
background: Once the manifestation of Leviathan's power, its calcified tail stands as a testament to the fall of an ancient divinity—yesterday's shackles long since broken. As the endless night recedes, the curse turns into strength, carried forth until the final waves.

name: Suncoveter's Reach
description: Starward Handmaiden: Hyvatia's drop, used for Resonator Ascension.
background:
Fragment of the Hyvatia Observation Array's Primary Lens
Once used to survey the Reactor Drive, Hyvatia was among the Spacetrek Collective's proudest creations. Now, the polished beryllium plate no longer reflects the sun of tomorrow, but a distorted illusion of Voidmatter. What stretches toward the future is no longer noble ideals, but grasping, covetous hands.

name: Burning Judgment
description: Reactor Husk's drop, used for Resonator Ascension.
background:
When the Reactor Drive's defense is triggered, it can only mean that the Threnodian has breached containment. The mech will eliminate the intruder at all costs. 
Even if the body itself is destroyed, it will fulfill its duty to the very last moment.

name: Our Choice
description: Nameless Explorer's drop, used for Resonator Ascension.
background:
The broken helmet offers no clue to the explorer's identity, only a faint string of numbers: 1957104192825. 

It points back to lost times, leaving the present shrouded in mystery. The starlight once danced across its surface, but also scarred it with abyssal marks. Yet, even so, the choice would be repeated. Again and again.

name: Gold in Memory
description: Sigillum's drop, used for Skill Upgrade.
background: Memories of that person—their strength and frailty, their suffering and joy, everything that was them—remain only in this battered yet radiant golden fragment.

name: We Who Question
description: Denia's drop, used for Skill Upgrade.
background:
Aleph-1 is always watching her in the distance.
In the nauseating stillness, in every second of her existence, each second etched away, Voidmatter scalds her lungs.
When the delicate facade peels back, all she does is cling to you, questioning this world:
"Why do people always look forward to tomorrow?"

name: Nightmare Flashdrive
description: Nightmare: Adam Smasher's drop, used for Lucy and Rebecca's Ascension.
background: A nightmare in crystal. Though its shell and the dreamscape it haunted have perished, this crystal pulses with a malevolent frequency, forever casting a shadow over each and every true love.

name: Skyward Glazed Heart
description: Thousand-Puppet Pavilion's drop, used for Skill Upgrade.
background:
He believes he has exploited everything of this emotion, yet he never truly understands its essence.

A burning hatred against the foes. A pining for home. A longing for the beloved. A wandering lost on the road ahead. The terror of death. The sheer tenacity for life.

It was never some incomprehensible impurity, nor the dawn of chaos.

What the girl witnessed as she cast a glance back was voices fading softly into the drifting winds—hearts as clear as glass, carried away on feathers toward the far reaches of the sky.

name: Solidarity's Loneflame
description: Myriad Snare: Rustfire Chassis's drop, used for Resonator Ascension.
background:
The forge fires have melted multiple modular parts into a singular mass. After a century of bitter warfare, only a lonely, unbending soul remains to drive this vessel, turning it into an unquenchable flame.

This obsession burns to this very day, fueled by the desire to repay that unwavering companionship that leaves no soul behind, and to fulfill a century-old vow to defend Xuanfang to the death. Within the flickering firelight, a fine line faintly comes into view: "Son of Unyielding Virtue."
source: Myriad Snare: Rustfire Chassis - Early Access

name: Drummer Solvent
description: Boosts Energy Regen of all Resonators in the team by 30% for 180s. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.

[Effect] Stabilizes the Resonator's condition to a certain extent and aids in their recovery.
[Precautions] Long intervals between doses are recommended. Excessive use within a short period is not advisable.
