description: Increases Echo Skill DMG of all Resonators in the team by 40% for 180s. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background: A small, compact proportioning data card, the data of which is read by the Synthesizer to gain access to Synthesis' corresponding products.

name: String Solvent Recipe
description: Grants a selected Resonator in the team 1 Concerto Energy per second for 180s. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background: A small, compact proportioning data card, the data of which is read by the Synthesizer to gain access to Synthesis' corresponding products.

name: Drummer Solvent Recipe
description: Boosts Energy Regen of all Resonators in the team by 30% for 180s. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background: A small, compact proportioning data card, the data of which is read by the Synthesizer to gain access to Synthesis' corresponding products.

name: Potion No.5 Recipe
description: Instantly revives a selected Resonator. Can only be used once every 60s. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background: A small, compact proportioning data card, the data of which is read by the Synthesizer to gain access to Synthesis' corresponding products.

name: Morale Tablets Recipe
description: Allows a selected Resonator in the team to additionally reduce the Vibration Strength of the targets by a certain percentage when they trigger Counterattack within 60s. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background: A small, compact proportioning data card, the data of which is read by the Synthesizer to gain access to Synthesis' corresponding products.

name: Harmony Tablets Recipe
description: Allows a selected Resonator in the team to regain 20 Concerto Energy when releasing Intro Skill within 60s. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background: A small, compact proportioning data card, the data of which is read by the Synthesizer to gain access to Synthesis' corresponding products.

name: Passion Tablets Recipe
description: Allows a selected Resonator in the team to regain 5 Resonance Energy when they successfully Dodge an attack within 60s. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background: A small, compact proportioning data card, the data of which is read by the Synthesizer to gain access to Synthesis' corresponding products.

name: Vigor Tablets Recipe
description: Grants a selected Resonator in the team immunity to the next fatal damage and heals 25% of the Resonator's Max HP, lasting for 60s. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background: A small, compact proportioning data card, the data of which is read by the Synthesizer to gain access to Synthesis' corresponding products.

name: Abyssal Solvent Recipe
description: Increases Echo Skill DMG by 50% for all Resonators in the team for 180s. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background: A small, compact proportioning data card, the data of which is read by the Synthesizer to gain access to Synthesis' corresponding products.

name: Lotus Seeds
description: A material used for Synthesis.
background: An aquatic plant prized for its ornamental and practical value. Its seeds are renowned for their fragrance in Jinzhou.

name: Climbing Fig
description: A material used for Cooking and Synthesis.
background:
The fruit of climbing vines that thrive on the exterior walls of buildings, which is often used in desserts.
When Jinzhou people move to a new residence, it's a tradition to take a cutting from the vine growing at their old house and plant it near the new home.

name: Iris
description: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
background:
A plant native to Whining Aix's Mire. It symbolizes broken or concealed affection.
Affected by the continuous thundercloud weather of this place, this variant has a significantly shortened flowering period compared to its original species. A true pity, indeed.

name: Terraspawn Fungus
description: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
background: A fungus that spreads across dark soil, resembling a black lotus. Once the cap matures and darkens, it begins to liquefy and makes the ground fertile for more mushrooms to grow, hence its name.

name: Lanternberry
description: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
background:
A fluorescent berry growing in caves.
Before miners get down the mine in the Tiger's Maw, their family will tuck a lanternberry into their pocket, hoping its glow will lead them safely home in the midst of darkness.

name: Pecok Flower
description: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
background:
A vibrant flower, with its sap often processed into dye.
Known for its fragrance and water-resistant properties, the flower is commonly used to produce seal ink paste for official or personalized stamps.

name: Belle Poppy
description: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
background:
Once the symbol of the Port City of Guixu, it nearly went extinct when Incinero Petals were rampant.
However, at the outskirts of the city ruins, Belle Poppy was found to bloom still at its home, having endured the disaster.

name: Coriolus
description: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
background:
A special fungus associated with ancient trees. Its medicinal and curative properties have been recorded in numerous medical classics of Jinzhou.
An ancient specimen is preserved in the Academy, a living relic tracing back to the era when the towering Central Banyan in the Dim Forest was not so majestic.

name: Wintry Bell
description: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
background:
A flower blooming on the high shores.
Legend has it that the Wintry Bell does not really wither. When the ancient bells born by the giant Turtoise in Gorges of Spirits resonate, they will rise again from the ice and snow.

name: Violet Coral
description: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
background: Violet Coral, commonly found trapped in the shallow beaches, is always revitalized with the flow and withered with the ebb.

name: Bittberry
description: A material used for Cooking and Synthesis.
background:
A fruit of bitter taste and a childhood nightmare of many Jinzhou people.
Bittberry is often associated with phrases like "recall past bitterness, savor present sweetness" or "bitter food detoxifies the body".

name: Pavo Plum
description: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
background:
Berries resembling feathers, the people of Hongzhen call them Linglong Hearts.
It is said to be exceedingly nutritious for the brain. But it's never seen as edible because of its extreme bitterness.

name: Pearl Leaf
description: A material used for Cooking and Synthesis.
background:
Common countryside plants.
Mushed Pearl Leaves can quickly stop bleeding when applied to wounds.
Jinzhou pharmacopeia records an instance in which a Green Rabbit gnawed Pearl Leaves to accelerate the healing of wounds.

name: Dewvetch
description: A material used for Synthesis.
background:
A scarlet Dewvetch. Natural moisture often builds on its buds, thus it is called Dewvetch.
It is a major nectariferous plant within Huanglong. Its honey has a natural, fresh fragrance, and it is refreshing and sweet to taste.

name: Noctemint
description: A material used for Cooking and Synthesis.
background: If applied externally, Noctemint soothes inflammation and relieves itching; if brewed with tea, Noctemint refreshes the user's mind. It is a daily essential, especially for warriors from the Midnight Rangers stationed in the wild. Chewing a few leaves offers a refreshing sensation from tongue to brain, assisting warriors through the enduring night.

name: Honeysuckle
description: A material used for Cooking and Synthesis.
background:
Honeysuckle is named after its characteristic of two flowers blooming from one stem.
Besides its use in tea drinks and medicines, it is also a favorite ornamental pot plant in Jinzhou.

name: Perilla
description: A material used for Cooking and Synthesis.
background:
Perilla is not impressive to the eye, but is known for its unique, rich aroma.
The adding of Perilla to a dish not only removes unpleasant odor, but also enhances the ingredient's freshness.

name: Angelica
description: A material used for Cooking and Synthesis.
background:
A lone and tall herb. It seems that it can confront grave difficulties with a composed demeanor. In Jinzhou, it's affectionately known as the "'Cold Beauty".
This association sometimes sparks an intriguing comparison to a certain researcher from the Academy—yet, neither of them will comment on this.

name: Lemongrass
description: A material used for Cooking and Synthesis.
background:
An aromatic plant native to the New Federation. It exudes a unique citrus fragrance.
The stems and leaves of Lemongrass can be used to extract essential oil, which is an ingredient for perfume, soap, or seasoning to add a flavor twist to foods.

name: Erodorchid
description: A material used for Synthesis.
background:
A plant that grows on the edges of Tacet Fields. It blooms even in the harsh environment.
As a saprophyte, it cannot support photosynthesis with its pale leaves, and only absorbs nutrition from decayed organisms. As it is often found blooming in areas lacking vitality, it is named "Erodorchid" by Resonators who often travel around dangerous zones.

name: Waterlamp
description: A material used for Synthesis.
background:
A fluorescent plant that grows by the riverbanks. They look like the lamps at the side of the ships anchoring for the night, hence the name Waterlamp.
The white pith inside Waterlamp's stem is used as wick, while the fibre of the stem skin is used for knit weaving and paper making.

name: Bunnywort
description: A material used for Synthesis.
background: Common bladderwort in river crevices. An insectivorous plant that is not harmful to human. Its stamens secrete a unique fragrant substance that attracts insects.

name: Caltrop
description: A material used for Synthesis.
background: The fruit of Caltrop is known as tropfruit. It is produced underwater, beneath the plant's dense leaves. To obtain the fruit, the whole plant must be picked and the leaf must be carefully removed.

name: Chromeshell
description: A material used for Synthesis.
background:
Chromeshell is a pearl shell. Under illumination, its nacre will glow with a strange polychrome gloss.
When it ebbs, many Chromeshells will be left on beaches.

name: Dripsnail
description: A material used for Synthesis.
background:
A snail with strange wave-like patterns on its shells. Usually spotted after Retroact Rains.
Dripsnail's shell can store the sound waves of specific frequencies, and once the shell is crushed, nearby creatures will hear a sound similar to the rain sound, hence the name.

name: Viola
description: A material used for Cooking.
background:
The Exiles prefer Viola, a plant of great vitality. They cook the young shoots of Viola as a source of vegetable.
Experienced observers can determine the whereabouts of the Exiles by the distribution of Viola.

name: Cliffrecluse
description: A material used for Synthesis.
background:
A blossom on cliffs, swaying to the blowing of breezes.
When the flowers swing in the currents, their light gestures always leave a strong impression.

name: Umbragricus
description: A material used for Cooking and Synthesis.
background: Legend has it that a traveler, who delighted in exploring mountains and rivers, stumbled upon this mushroom. Its shape, resembling a person sheltering from rain under an umbrella, inspired the traveler to name it "Umbragricus".

name: Gemberry
description: A material used for Synthesis.
background: A gem-like plant with scarlet, sweet, and juicy fruit, perfect for immediate consumption or sauce making.

name: Edodes
description: A material used for Cooking and Synthesis.
background: Edodes offers a richer and more tender flavor compared to common mushrooms. Simply boiling Edodes in fresh water with a pinch of salt yields a taste akin to Jinzhou Stew.

name: Gloom Slough
description: A material used for Synthesis.
background:
Gloom Slough is commonly found among the ruins of villages or cities, and is named for the glowing light that resembles a candle flame without the heat.
Gloom Cicada's diet is mainly fluorescent plants, and the sloughs they produce are left with the sedimented fluorescent matters from the insects' skin.

name: Pavo Plum
description: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
background:
Berries resembling feathers, the people of Hongzhen call them Linglong Hearts.
They have an incredibly spicy taste and are said to be able to refresh the mind and enhance intelligence when consumed.

name: Loong's Pearl
description: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
background: A tranquil flower, casting its gentle radiance amidst the shadows.

name: Silver Lotus
description: A material used for Cooking and Synthesis.
background: A resilient lotus blossoming amidst the freezing snow. When cooked with other ingredients, it can offer solace and warmth to those in need of comfort from the cold.

name: Nova
description: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
background: An unstable crystal precipitated out of highly concentrated Remnant Energy. It is so unsteady that it starts to sublimate as soon as it is formed, disappearing into thin air as energy. Its existence reminds one of the transience of the life of a Nova.

name: Sea Flytrap
description: A material used for Cooking.
background: A translucent shellfish, known as the "sea flytrap." It has a body composed of a dense gelatinous substance. It uses the luminescent pearl-like objects on its body to lure in and prey on marine organisms.

name: Fowl Meat
description: A material used for Cooking.
background: Meat obtained from fowls. Freshly cut. Extra tender. With skilled hands, it can be transformed into exquisite dishes.

name: Feather
description: A material used for Synthesis.
background: Lightweight and soft feathers that are often used in crafting of accessories or toys.

name: Raw Meat
description: A material used for Cooking.
background: Meat obtained from animals, featuring a clean cut with distinct fat marbling. With skilled hands, it can be transformed into exquisite dishes.

name: Phoenix Butterfly
description: A material used for Synthesis.
background:
A large butterfly. They are often active in dense vegetation areas in woodlands or other environments. They often fly in pairs at high altitudes and feed on nectar. Hard to capture.
It is the most commonly seen butterflies because of its high reproductive ability and adaptability to the living environment.

name: Red Feather Butterfly
description: A material used for Synthesis.
background: Red Feather Butterfly is a variant of the heterochrome Phoenix Butterfly family. Its overly bright coloration renders it less adaptable to various environments compared to the common Phoenix Butterfly, making it more susceptible to predators. It ranks second in terms of both quantity and rarity among the three butterfly species.

name: Blue Feather Butterfly
description: A material used for Synthesis.
background: Blue Feather Butterfly is a variant of the heterochrome Phoenix Butterfly. Its genetic mutation gives it a dreamy scale color but also reduces its reproduction ability. As a result, the Blue Feather Butterfly is the rarest and most elusive of the three species.

name: Chrysopa
description: A material used for Synthesis.
background:
Chrysopa possesses two pairs of wings made of transparent membranes with delicate reticulate veins resembling leaves.
It primarily preys on small insects and serves as a natural predator for many pests, making it a valuable resource for biological pest control.

name: Golden-ringed Dragonfly
description: A material used for Synthesis.
background: Golden-ringed Dragonfly is a wetland and water predator. Its diet includes flying insects and small fish and shrimp. It is known for rapid flying and predating speed.

name: Fish
description: A material used for Cooking.
background: Meat obtained from fish, featuring a tender cut with a refreshing taste. With skilled hands, it can be transformed into exquisite dishes.

name: Silver-Banded Lizard
description: A material used for Synthesis.
background: Carnivorous reptiles, mainly living in stone crevices or caves and other dark places. Their skin is covered with leathery scales, and their body has black and white ring-shaped patterns alternately arranged. They most feed on earthworms, snails, and insects.

name: Azure Lizard
description: A material used for Synthesis.
background: Carnivorous reptiles, mainly living by waters or in wetlands. Their skin is covered with leathery scales. While their whole body is blue, musclar spines are found on their back. They favor wet, warm environments and small shrimp, crabs for diet.

name: Green Pit Lizard
description: A material used for Synthesis.
background: Carnivorous reptiles, common lizards in grasslands, though occasional sightings in towns exist. They would hide themselves in parterres or plant trellis. However, as they are not poisonous, has a wide diet and a gentle temper, they are sometimes taken as pets by citizens.

name: Black-Striped Frog
description: A material used for Synthesis.
background: A small frog often found on the banks of the rivers and lakes. Their habitat is often established on lush bushes. When it rains, they often come out to feed on snails and earthworms. Therefore, after rain, Black-Striped Frogs can often be seen crossing the roads in an attempt to return to the waterside.

name: Goldenback Frog
description: A material used for Synthesis.
background: A small frog often found on the banks of the rivers and lakes. A heterochrome species of Black-Striped Frog. Since it is relatively scarce and more vulnerable to enemies due to the color, some amphibian fans will catch Goldenback Frogs after rain and take them home as pets.

name: Scarletthorn
description: A material used for Crafting.
background: A specialty mineral with a shape of needle clusters. Sharp and tough. Mostly used in cutting metals or other crystals or making weapons.

name: Lampylumen
description: A material used for Crafting.
background: A translucent specialty mineral found in the Tiger's Maw Mine. Both the crystal produce and raw status of this mineral has a translucent azure shine. As a material, it has excellent toughness and stability.

name: Indigoite
description: A material used for Crafting.
background: A widely distributed mineral. Its unique, profound purple distinguishes itself from other minerals. Due to its fragility, it requires careful processing with specialized equipment.

name: Floramber
description: A material used for Crafting.
background: Minerals formed over time from the remains of dead plants within Tacet Fields that had sunken into its terrains. Due to the retained woody plant-like structural appearances, these minerals were given the name "Floramber", though they are unrelated to ambers in terms of shape or form.

name: Boost Part
description: A material used for Crafting.
background: A boost part disassembled from various weapons, featuring impressive versatility. By collecting enough quantity of these parts, you can apply them to enhance the performance of Tacetite Weapons.

name: Echo Frequency Chip
description: A material used for Crafting.
background: A chip with missing content. Therefore, it cannot be directly used to optimize the performance of Echoes. However, by collecting enough quantity of these chips, you can still pick out complete frequencies with similar effects.

name: Standard Weapon Mold
description: Used for weapon crafting.
background: A rare crafting material with extremely high plasticity. Can be used for the manufacture of various weapons.

name: Gilded Ginkgo
description: Used to increase the Syntonization Rank of Golden Eternal weapons.
background: A beautiful jade has been carved into the shape of a ginkgo leaf.

name: Fluorite
description: A material used for Crafting.
background: An ore bearing a likeness to the Sentinel's scale. Can be used to repair weapons.

name: Skyhunter's Feather
description: Used to increase the Syntonization Rank of Hunter's Growl weapons.
background: A raw material for fine weapons in Septimont, meticulously shaped by Septimont's artisans into the form of a Gryphon's feather. Cold to the touch, yet burning with untempered resolve.

name: Bird Egg
description: A material used for Cooking.
background: A gift from birds, and a regular on dinner tables.

name: Hearty Supper
description: Used to increase the Syntonization Rank of Somnoire Anchor.
background:
Ever since he turned into a white cat, Ivory Gatekeeper has been dreaming of a grand meal...
It's a shame that he refuses to share any details with anyone.

name: Blue-Spotted Giant Fish
description: Used to increase the Syntonization Rank of Ocean's Gift.
background: The eyes of this mysterious giant fish gleam with an eerie glow, and if you listen closely, you might even catch a faint melody within the flickers. Undoubtedly, it is one of the ocean's gifts.

name: Core of Oath
description: A strange Tacetite Bloom arranged in a spiral pattern. Can be used to increase the Syntonization Rank of Bloodpact's Pledge.
background: This uniquely shaped Tacetitie Bloom encages an ancient yet powerful core from which you sense a familiar power.
source: Fabricatorium of the Deep Exploration Progress Reward

name: Bay Leaf
description: A material used for Cooking and Synthesis.
background:
An herb with the longest history of use in Rinascita. 
Bay Leaves are used in cooking to give extra flavor to dishes because of their unique aroma, while Cassia Buds are used for their calming properties and to ward off insects. Together, they are revered in Rinascita as the "Sublime Remedy."

name: Thief's Talon
description: A material used for Synthesis.
background:
Golden Thiefbat's talon.
Golden Thiefbats have dexterous claws and like to steal anything that shines. The Thief's Talon is considered a lucky charm in Rinascita.
It is not unusual for a Ragunnesi businessman to put a Thief's Talon in their pocket in the hope of cutting lucrative deals.

name: Animal Fat
description: A material used for Cooking.
background:
Refined animal fat, rich with savory aroma.
In expert hands, it creates a perfectly golden crisp crust, delivering indulgent flavor without a hint of greasiness. 
One bite and your taste buds will be in pure bliss.

name: Sea Bunny Meat
description: A material used for Cooking.
background:
Sea Bunny Meat, rich in protein with a tender, succulent texture.
This delicacy requires careful preparation. The Heliobane Fungia, along with other poisonous glands and fluids, must be removed, and the meat cooked to just the right temperature to neutralize any toxins. Whether it becomes a delicious delicacy to die for, or one that costs you your life, depends entirely on the chef's skill.

name: Fur
description: A material used for Synthesis.
background:
Thick, soft fur, gentle to the touch, and warming to the very core.
Why strip their coats bare, you ask? Well, haven't you heard of the law of conservation of energy? The warmth hasn't disappeared, it's simply been transferred from them to you.

name: Goldcrest Scarab
description: A material used for Synthesis.
background:
A species of scarab that resembles a coin in appearance, with a reflective golden exoskeleton.
For Golden Thiefbats, Goldcrest Scarabs are both a pleasant sight and a delicious snack.

name: Heliobane Fungia
description: A material used for Cooking.
background:
A type of poisonous algae that forms a symbiotic relationship with Sea Bunnies. Heliobane Fungia is rich in gelatine, an important ingredient in many desserts.
Gelatin extracted from Heliobane Fungia has a subtle sweetness and gives desserts a silky, springy texture.

name: Bell Crab
description: A material used for Cooking.
background:
A species of crab that makes its home in miniature bells. 
Bell Crabs feed on fish, shrimp, clams, and other small sea creatures. They can scuttle about quickly, emitting a jingling sound as they go. At night, they avoid predators by hiding beneath the decaying hulls of beached boats.

name: Mastic Nuvola
description: A material used for Cooking and Synthesis.
background:
A creamy resin produced by Nuvola trees, shaped like a cloud and carrying a unique fragrance.
The Nuvola tree is a symbol of healing and renewal. If such a tree is cut, it produces resin to seal the wound until it fully heals. The Ragunnesi call Mastic Nuvola "Healer's Tears."

name: Sunflare Everlasting
description: A material used for Cooking.
background: A type of strawflower that grows in clusters. Sunflare Everlasting has pinnate leaves and disk-shaped flowers. Once picked and air-dried, the flowers retain their golden hue, described as "sunlight that never fades."

name: Viscum Berry
description: A material used for Cooking.
background:
Legend says the first divine oracle given to Ragunna was carved into a tree trunk, and from the mark, a green branch grew.
The Viscum Berries that sprout from this branch are known as the "Fruit of Wisdom." It is believed that eating them grants spiritual enlightenment.

name: Cassia Bud
description: A material used for Cooking and Synthesis.
background:
An herb with the longest history of use in Rinascita. 
Bay Leaves are used in cooking to give extra flavor to dishes because of their unique aroma, while Cassia Buds are used for their calming properties and to ward off insects. Together, they are revered in Rinascita as the "Sublime Remedy."

name: Felicitous Olives
description: A material used for Cooking and Synthesis.
background:
The delectable fruit of a wild olive shrub that grows in fertile soil. Felicitous Olives are a favored food for certain animals.
Herders often raise herbivores with a keen sense of smell to help track down these prized olives.

name: Golden Fleece
description: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
background:
A cluster of golden sulfur crystals, often found in caves rich in geothermal activity. They resemble their mythical namesake—the Golden Fleece guarded by a venomous dragon.
When ground into a fine powder and combined with a hint of molten copper, Golden Fleece transforms into stage-worthy fireworks.

name: Sword Acorus
description: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
background:
A tall flower with a firm stem, crowned by delicate flowers.
Sword Acoruses are often used by instructors to teach swordsmanship to young nobles, replacing real swords with these harmless blooms. The children, entranced by the beauty and fragrance, find their attention captured far more easily than by cold, menacing blades.

name: Firecracker Jewelweed
description: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
background:
A vividly colored flower shaped like an unfurling firework.
Give a Firecracker Jewelweed a gentle shake, and its swollen capsules will burst open...
The seeds scatter in all directions, resembling the colorful burst of a firecracker.

name: Seaside Cendrelis
description: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
background:
A fluorescent flower often found in the crevices of ruins. In the past, Seaside Cendrelis wreaths were used in the rite of initiation for infants and the inaugurations of new Fisalia family heads. As a result, it became a symbol of the power once held by the old nobility.
Ever since the tower's fateful ascent to the sky, the Seaside Cendrelis has been considered extinct, for it has never been seen again.

name: Resonant Calcite
description: A material used for Crafting.
background:
A mineral soaked in the waters of Nimbus Sanctum, its surface gleaming with an iridescent sheen. Resonant Calcite is an excellent conductor of Remnant Energy.
The origins of Resonant Calcite are still debated. Some believe its unique properties come from prolonged exposure to the flow of frequencies in Nimbus Sanctum, while others argue that these frequencies seeped into geological fissures, where they influenced the mineral's formation.

name: Fool's Gold
description: A material used for Crafting.
background:
A versatile, bronzed iron ore often mistaken for gold, though it's not hard to tell the difference upon closer inspection.
In the past, con artists would craft Fool's Gold into jewelry and sell it as real gold.
Though such tricks are long obsolete, the name "Fool's Gold" endures to this day.

name: Oaknut
description: A material used for Cooking.
background:
A nut from the tall evergreen trees of Septimont. They drop when ripe, waiting to be gathered by animals preparing for the coming year.
Where there's a Leaftail Fox, you'll usually find these nuts. The foxes wrap their tails in oak leaves and use the nuts as lures for unsuspecting prey.

name: Amber Halite
description: A material used for Synthesis.
background: These clear, cube-shaped halites, marked by unique swirling patterns, are found along Septimont's coastlines and coastal ravines. Septimontians often grind them into smelling salts or craft them into elegant jewelry.

name: Bamboo Iris
description: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
background: A common purple flower from the Septimont plains. Locals use it for spice blends or as home décor.

name: Bloodleaf Viburnum
description: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
background: Viburnums that grow in Border Mountains. Its deep red leaves stand out sharply, like blood seeping through the pale mountains.

name: Abyss Luminary
description: A material used for Cooking.
background:
A strange glowing marine life found in the ocean depths.
The Rinascita legend has it that the Sentinel left the Abyss Luminaries beneath the waves to guide the souls of the drowned.

name: "Afterlife"
description: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
background:
A pure-white lycoris.
Its petals seem untinted by the vivid scarlet typical of its kind. Or perhaps the colors that were there have long faded. These delicate flowers bloom quietly in darkness. Just like the name they've been given, their unique appearance suggests maybe a whole new world exists beyond the Beyond.
"Things unfinished in this life shall wait for the next."

name: Shrimp Meat
description: Meat obtained from shrimps.
background: Meat obtained from shrimps, tender and springy. In skilled hands, it can be transformed into exquisite dishes.

name: Titanhorn
description: A material used for Synthesis.
background: A hardened horn from a Titanhorn Antelope. These creatures are known to feed on stone in the most unforgiving environments, resulting in horns as tough as the rocks they consume.

name: Stone Rose
description: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
background: A strange flower that blooms where the Dark Tide has receded. Though its core has been completely calcified, a faint fragrance still lingers—a proof that life's resilience shall never be underestimated.

name: Sliverglow Bloom
description: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
background:
A rare flower found only in the Sanguis Plateaus, said to glow like moonlight in the dark.
"O warriors, should shadow steal the moon, look down, and the Sliverglow Bloom still shines beneath your feet."

name: Luminous Calendula
description: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
background:
A rare bloom found only in the Sanguis Plateaus, said to thrive where warriors have shed their blood.
When Gladiators die a glorious death in Septimont's wild hunts, their companions often place a Luminous Calendula at their graves as a solemn tribute to their courage and sacrifice.

name: Summer Flower
description: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
background: This flower has always remained in bloom as the Lament sealed it and the City within the Sonoro Sphere. Just like an eternal summer, it never withers, never fades. In the past, during every blossom season, Honami City would hold a traditional Summer Flower viewing event.

name: Pine Cone
description: A material used for Cooking.
background: These pinecones grow slowly under low clusters of needles. Their thick shells can't hide the warm, nutty scent inside. The kernels have a gentle pine-resin sweetness, and once roasted, they release a mellow, toasty aroma, perfect for travelers crossing the frostlands who need quick energy.

name: Dusk Honeypot
description: A material used for Cooking.
background:
A large berry nourished by the Reactor Drive's light, gleaming with the warm amber glow of dusk. Sweet-tart, juicy, and rich in natural sugars, it is often gathered by Shepherds tending the Exoswarm, who drink its nectar to recover their strength.

Yet once a Dusk Honeypot overripens, it can leave both humans and Exoswarm intoxicated. When a Shepherd fails to return from a foraging trip, chances are they've simply indulged in one too many overripe berries without realizing it.

name: Fern Spore
description: A material used for Cooking.
background:
An ancient fern that thrives in cool, shady spots. Its newly sprouted fronds will curl tightly at the tips, forming tender, fresh fern balls. Naturally dehydrated after being picked, these balls are easy to preserve as compact, long-lasting dried food.

Before eating, simply soak them in snowmelt to rehydrate, and they instantly regain a vibrant, fresh green, as if just harvested. The Roya often thread Fern Spores for grilling or scatter them in shaded areas to grow new ferns. Most Roya have their first taste of Fern Spores in early childhood, though it's rarely a fond memory.

name: Cradle Lichen
description: A material used for Synthesis.
background:
This species of lichen clings to waterside rocks, its existence as ancient as the underground cavern itself, even predating the arrival of the Exostrider. Long before the underground was called Lahai-Roi, this type of lichen had already taken root. Over countless years, it slowly eroded the hard rock, breaking it down into soil capable of nurturing new life.

In Royan mythology, Cradle Lichen symbolizes return and transformation. When burying precious objects, the Roya will weave the lichen into mats, wrapping the treasures before laying them in the earth.

name: Jade Wood
description: A material used for Weapon and Tool crafting.
background:
After the geological shifts in the Royan Frostlands, some trees were frozen instantly, while others were dragged underground with the moving crust and slowly turned into minerals under long pressure. Their growth rings remain perfectly preserved, providing key clues about how Solaris's climate changed after the Lament.

In Royan stories, Jade Wood stands for time, experience, and wisdom—the embodiment of nature's memories.

name: Gemini Spore
description: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
background:
A meteorite crashes into the ground, and upon it sprout spores. The fungal network grows, forming a microscopic cosmos of its own.

The Gemini Spores are extraordinarily delicate. One gentle puff and they dissolve into fine spore dust, drifting like a miniature galaxy. Yet they are also incredibly resilient, perhaps harboring faint frequencies of the "old universe." They are the only Lahai-Roi creature capable of surviving in the Voidmatter Zone.

The frequencies of the star clusters have painted them with celestial colors. The Roya use these spores as pigments to record observed galaxies or create predictive petroglyphs of their structures.

name: Rimewisp
description: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
background: No taller than the knee, fragile against the icy wind, yet it grows year after year in the cracks of frozen rocks. Only at the very instant the polar night ends does it bloom, unfurling clusters of white flowers like delicate snowflakes. The Roya call it Linnaea, meaning "the last trace of tenderness in the blizzard."

name: Arithmetic Shell
description: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
background: For most Roya, their first encounter with "calculation" in childhood wasn't a numeration table from Startorch Academy, but the cross-section of an ancient seashell. These fossilized shells, known as Arithmetic Shells, have natural interiors etched into concentric grooves, like a mathematical grid carved by the hands of the divine. Elders would teach children to drop small stones of varying colors and shapes—or tiny sticks—into the grooves, mimicking the processes of addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, distribution, and pairing…

name: Luxite
description: A material used for Synthesis.
background:
Due to the Exostrider's fragmented frequencies incorporated into these minerals, they have become ideal materials for both Exoswarm restoration and construction. Over the course of history, the Exoswarm has been instinctively collecting Luxite. Some friendly Exoswarm also assist the Spacetrek Collective in harvesting the mineral, providing material for Lahai-Roi's infrastructure.

Beyond its practical uses, certain Luxite deposits possess exceptional optical properties. At specific angles, they refract the Reactor's light in a fixed pattern, allowing observers to determine their position relative to the Reactor Drive. The Roya call these special stones the Eye of Sol.

name: Moss Amber
description: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
background: A "time capsule" preserving Lahai-Roi's warmer days. Tree resin encased the moss below, holding a fleeting moment in time. When this frozen memory shatters, even paused life may find a chance to begin anew.

name: Edelschnee
description: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
background:
In the harsh frostlands, the carnivorous Edelschnee has developed a unique survival strategy.

At rest, it curls into a fluffy snowball. When it senses a wounded creature nearby, it gently unfurls, wrapping the being in its delicate tendrils to feed. While doing so, it cleans wounds and secretes a mild anesthetic, while its long fibers cover and protect the injury.

Creatures of the frostlands often seek Edelschnee for healing. Once the seed balls mature, they disperse through the environment. Its fluffy fibers are used for textiles and medicine, making Edelschnee an essential resource for the Roya.

name: Waxweaver Web
description: A material used for Synthesis.
background:
Legend has it that the Waxweavers were once Solsworns, cursed for failing their sacred charge.

Day in and day out, they observe the light. Day in and day out, they weave the light. Their spinning begins with the first rays of dawn and concludes at the hour of twilight when the finished web is retrieved. This endless vigil continues, as if they are still desperately striving to fulfill the duty they abandoned, weaving a web of their own atonement.

For this reason, the Roya maintain a solemn, religious reverence and deep pity for the Waxweavers.

When melted, their silk can be applied to wounds to aid healing, or used as a water-resistant coating.

name: Foxtail Kelp
description: A material used for Cooking.
background:
Foxtail Kelp is entirely edible. Its long, fragile stems often break off and drift to the shore, looking like lost walking sticks or pipes.

The Roya call it the "Traveler’s Staff." For lost travelers trapped in caves, it can serve as a reliable source of food until they reach safety. Children also play with the stems, sparring with one another to see whose kelp lasts the longest.

name: Meteoric Iron
description: A material used for Synthesis.
background:
Meteoric Iron is naturally magnetic and often paired with Sunstone to guide herders through snowstorms. Its excellent heat conductivity also makes cookware crafted from it highly prized, reducing cooking time while adding unique flavors.

Within the iron are dense gems formed under immense pressure when it fell, known as Star Marks among the Roya. They are extremely hard and valuable outside Lahai-Roi. Some have been caught defying Royan rules to extract and trade them.

name: Frostwort
description: A material used for Cooking.
background:
Frostwort has a structure remarkably similar to neural tissue. Over millennia of independent evolution, it has gained the ability to transmit simple signals through its symbiotic network, helping it grow efficiently and repair itself.

The Roya dry Frostwort and use it to brew drinks, though it is reserved only for adults.

name: Dream of Stars
description: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
background: An otherworldly plant that always sprouts out of nowhere. It drinks from the barren walls to yield blossoms as radiant as a thousand stars.

name: Redbell
description: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
background: A far‑from‑home species that, when mature, bears bell‑shaped crimson fruits. In Ashinohara, these fruits are often consecrated to the divine. Should a soft chime ring out during prayer, know that the divine has heard your plea.

name: Forget-Me-Not
description: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
background: Flowers born from the Terminals left behind by fallen members of the Spacetrek Collective, their vines entwining with cold circuits, the final, living blooms of their faded frequencies.

name: Past Reveries
description: A material used for Lucy and Rebecca's Ascension.
background: A cartridge preserving memories of the good old days, alongside the final chapter of a true legend's journey.
source: AI Variety Store in Somnoire: Night City

name: Uncracked Jade
description: A material used for Cooking.
background: The Land of Xuanfang is rich in jade. Locals see the Jadeplume Eagle as a spiritual creature bound to the jade, and guard it closely. If a fallen Jade Egg is found, they will try to return it to its nest. Only those confirmed abandoned are treated as a gift from the wild and used with care. Once the chicks hatch, the remaining jade‑calcified shells become even more precious. They are carved into ornaments for children, carrying the blessing: "May you spread your wings and soar."

name: Climber Shoots
description: A material used for Cooking.
background: Once Climber Shoots emerge from the ground, they gradually take on the straight appearance of ordinary bamboo shoots, their color shifting from black to green. Locals associate them with a wondrous artifact in Huanglong legends capable of connecting people's hearts, viewing the shoots as an auspicious ingredient that blesses children with sharp senses and deep empathy.

name: Jade Hexahedron
description: A material used for Cooking.
background: Hard and dense, the Jade Hexahedron is a superb energy-conducting medium, frequently mined for use in mechanics and residential construction. When selecting a site for a Autopuppet factory, the builders will specifically choose an area rich in Jade Hexahedron veins to meet the immense power demands of its automated operations.

name: White Jade Beauty
description: A material used for Cooking.
background:
The White Jade Beauty is difficult to preserve. Once touched or bruised, the damaged area rapidly oozes a striking cyan-blue hue, resembling a clouded jewel or a cracked jade plate. 
Though delicious, it is mildly toxic. Eating it raw causes dizziness and vomiting, so it must be fully cooked before consumption. To ensure safety, eateries often take diners' utensils away while the mushrooms are cooking to prevent them from sneaking a premature bite.

name: Opus Stone
description: A material used for Cooking.
background:
Every Opus Stone is made thanks to the rigorous selection process of Opus Otters. Uncut stones with dull acoustics or messy textures are discarded along the water's edge, becoming "Otter Castaways" occasionally found by travelers.
The people of Mengzhou carefully polish Opus Stones of varying pitches, crafting them into lithophones and wind chimes hung beneath eaves or by the water. Whenever the chimes ring, nearby Opus Otters often pause their work to listen closely. If the mood strikes them, they will even knock on their own stones in harmony, as if jamming a song with a kindred spirit.

name: Leafweaver
description: A material used for Synthesis.
background: The Leafweaver has a delicate frame and a pale golden hue. As a "professional weaver," it cuts leaves or petals to construct intricately designed, spiral tower-like nests. On sunny afternoons in the Land of Xuanfang, one can often spot busy Leafweavers fluttering through the air, carrying leaves several times larger than their own bodies.

name: Floral Crest Jade
description: A material used for Synthesis.
background:
The Floral Crest Jade is encased in a shell of dense, incredibly hard black jade. Twistscales grind away at this outer layer using their own scales, polishing it over and over until the surface gleams like a mirror. Eventually the shell flakes off in one smooth piece, revealing the "jade chrysanthemum" beneath—fully intact and vivid with color.
Cherishing the stone's delicate veining, the people of Mengzhou have long taken to displaying these Twistscale-polished jades in their homes, where they sit upon desks as quiet, elegant treasures.

name: Cloudperch Seed
description: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
background: In the Land of Xuanfang, the Cloudperch Seed is seen as the embodiment of lightness and ambition. Whenever the late autumn winds begin to blow, the tree's "perching feathers" rustle in unison, breaking free from the branches to dance through the valleys. Borne on mountain breezes and air currents, these seeds can travel immense distances. Only when the wind finally subsides do the winged seeds touch down gently, scattering life across distant lands.

name: Flowborne Dream
description: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
background:
"Drawing the twilight's glow, gathering radiance upon scales."
The Flowborne Dream is exceptionally sensitive to environmental shifts. The shimmering changes in its scales and its swimming patterns allow it to detect ecological imbalances in a given area faster than any crafted device. It is also why the people of Mengzhou often keep them in wall-mounted glass tanks draped with thin silk scroll paintings. Beyond mere decoration, they serve as a natural early-warning instrument.

name: Blade Blossom
description: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
background: With its sword-like leaves and refreshing scent, the Blade Blossom has historically been imbued with the folkloric meaning of "warding off evil with blade leaves" by the people of Mengzhou. Every midsummer, locals gather their long, straight leaves and hang them alongside mugwort on doorframes and windows, believing they can ward off impurities and misfortune. Its tendency to bloom under the moonlight and scatter its blade-like petals in the wind is viewed as a fleeting purification ritual. Wherever the petals drift, all gloom seems washed away.

name: Basic Resonance Potion
description: Provides 1,000 Resonator EXP.
background: A potion that can slightly enhance the user's frequency perception ability. It is especially beneficial for Resonators struggling with mastering their Fortes, as it greatly enhances adaptability. However, when consumed by Resonators who already exhibit excellent control over their Fortes, its effectiveness is somewhat diminished due to its fully diluted nature.

name: Medium Resonance Potion
description: Provides 3,000 Resonator EXP.
background: A potion that can further enhance the user's frequency perception ability. By adjusting the mixture ratio, this potion is more suitable for Resonators with relatively good control over their Fortes. With a near-perfect cost-effectiveness, it is regarded as flawless except for its "notoriously" bland taste.

name: Advanced Resonance Potion
description: Provides 8,000 Resonator EXP.
background: A potion that can greatly enhance the user's frequency perception ability. Collaborating with professional nutritionists, this potion is more beneficial to both physical and mental well-being compared to many healthcare products on the market. This potion enjoys high popularity among Resonators, with many voices urging its manufacturer to explore a variety of flavors.

name: Premium Resonance Potion
description: Provides 20,000 Resonator EXP.
background: A potion that can significantly enhance the user's Frequency perception. Its formula is locked within a vault with the highest security. Rumor has it the inventor of this potion is a powerful Resonator in their own right, and their hope is to groom a successor capable of surpassing their achievements.

name: Basic Energy Core
description: Provides 1,000 Weapon EXP.
background: Purified liquid energy extracted from Tacetite, its purity increasing with higher ratings. When injected into a weapon, it offers a corresponding bonus.

name: Medium Energy Core
description: Provides 3,000 Weapon EXP.
background: A supplement storing a small amount of Tacetite Energy. It can be used to recharge the core modules of Tacetite Weapons. Routine preventative maintenance of weapons is advised for all Resonators, or they may find themselves caught off guard in the case of an emergency.

name: Advanced Energy Core
description: Provides 8,000 Weapon EXP.
background: A supplement storing a small amount of Tacetite Energy. It can be used in the core modules of Tacetite Weapons to increase power output. Weapons are the allies of Resonators and Tacetites serve as their food. Only by nourishing weapons well can they be handier and more powerful in battles.

name: Premium Energy Core
description: Provides 20,000 Weapon EXP.
background: A supplement storing high-density Tacetite Energy, fully capable of powering most Tacetite Weapons. Experienced Resonators often preassemble and preheat this supplement to prevent weapon malfunctions during intense battles.

name: Inert Metallic Drip
description: A basic material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Sword Resonators.
background: A fluid metallic drip whose activity has been greatly diminished. Its surface appears lackluster, covered with a dense layer of passivation film. However, under suitable temperatures, the residual Frequency Energy within it can still be utilized.

name: Reactive Metallic Drip
description: A medium material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Sword Resonators.
background: A fluid metallic drip whose activity has been partially retained. Its surface presents a luster similar to that of Tacetites. As it is quite reactive, it needs to be stored properly upon collection to prevent any loss of Frequency Energy.

name: Polarized Metallic Drip
description: An advanced material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Sword Resonators.
background: A fluid metallic drip with high activity. Its surface presents an amazing luster. This polarized matter only forms under extremely strict conditions, and the scientific world has yet to fully figure out its transformation patter.

name: Heterized Metallic Drip
description: A premium material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Sword Resonators.
background: A special fluid metallic drip which can barely form naturally. It maintains a perpetual flow on its surface. Microscopic examinations of a few samples have revealed its intricate inner structure, resembling more of a living organism than an inorganic substance.

name: Impure Phlogiston
description: A basic material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Pistols Resonators.
background: A crystal shaped like a solidified flame. Its unconventional appearance challenges Old Science. Typically, it contains a rather high level of impurities and thus requires specialized purification treatment for practical use.

name: Extracted Phlogiston
description: A medium material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Pistols Resonators.
background: A crystal shaped like a solidified candle flame. Its impurities are significantly reduced through a rough extraction and recrystallization process. This makes it simple even for those without expertise to distinguish between crystals of varying quality.

name: Refined Phlogiston
description: An advanced material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Pistols Resonators.
background: A crystal shaped like a solidified firework. After repeated purification, it is almost free of impurities. Its eye-catching and magnificent appearance not only holds practical utility but also elevates its collectible value.

name: Flawless Phlogiston
description: A premium material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Pistols Resonators.
background: A crystal shaped like a raging flame, known for its impeccable purity. As a result, some Resonators don't want to use these crystals solely for enhancement, instead opting to entrust professional craftsmen to process them into unique accessories.

name: Lento Helix
description: A basic material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Rectifier Resonators.
background: A helix with soothing waveforms. Facing this remarkable substance, human beings finally realize what static vibration is about.

name: Adagio Helix
description: A medium material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Rectifier Resonators.
background: A helix with gentle waveforms. Researchers can extract and utilize the sealed Cadence Energy within it. However, it is worth mentioning that researchers cannot effectively analyze the content contained within this helix.

name: Andante Helix
description: An advanced material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Rectifier Resonators.
background: A helix with graceful waveforms, like a melodious song composed by nature. Instead of being studied by scientists, it might in essence be a subject best explored by researchers of aesthetics.

name: Presto Helix
description: A premium material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Rectifier Resonators.
background: A helix with intense waveforms. Researchers are greatly captivated by the perfect harmony of movement and stillness it displays. However, to this day, no one knows how this harmony is formed.

name: Waveworn Residue 210
description: A basic material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Broadblade Resonators.
background: A Waveworn residue featuring a double-layered spherical shell. However, the inner balance has been disturbed, causing the Remnant within the inner core to reduce to the Reverberation.

name: Waveworn Residue 226
description: A medium material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Broadblade Resonators.
background: A Waveworn residue featuring a double-layered spherical shell. It is not in a state of decline. By selecting an appropriate absorber, users may still have the chance to extract Remnant Energy.

name: Waveworn Residue 235
description: An advanced material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Broadblade Resonators.
background: A Waveworn residue featuring a double-layered spherical shell. It maintains a delicate balance. When it is highly concentrated in a centrifuge, it produces products that have various applications.

name: Waveworn Residue 239
description: A premium material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Broadblade Resonators.
background: A Waveworn residue featuring a double-layered spherical shell. It is known for its astonishing balance. Due to its indispensable role in many high-tech fields, it is subject to the most stringent trade restrictions.

name: Cadence Seed
description: A basic material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Gauntlets Resonators.
background: An unusual substance resembling the shape of a plant seed. If you listen carefully, you can feel a pulse-like rhythm. However, in fact, this substance is not alive, and its structure is pretty similar to that of the Tacet Core of a Howler.

name: Cadence Bud
description: A medium material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Gauntlets Resonators.
background: An unusual substance resembling the shape of a plant bud. If you listen carefully, you can sense the pleasure of sprouting from the ground. However, it can never grow into a complete plant.

name: Cadence Leaf
description: An advanced material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Gauntlets Resonators.
background: An unusual substance resembling the shape of a new leaf. If you listen carefully, you can hear the faint rustle of it bathing in sunlight and sucking dew. In fact, it is able to absorb the wandering Frequency Energy from the environment.

name: Cadence Blossom
description: A premium material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Gauntlets Resonators.
background: An unusual substance resembling the shape of a blossom. If you listen carefully, you can hear the petals unfolding. At the end of the silent time, a blossom of Cadence finally bursts into bloom.

name: Broken Wing Polarizer
description: A basic material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Sword Resonators.
background: A metallic shard, resembling a solitary butterfly wing, its surface dull and covered with a dense passivation layer. Under suitable temperature conditions, the residual frequency energy within can still be harnessed.

name: Monowing Polarizer
description: A medium material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Sword Resonators.
background: A metallic shard, resembling a pair of butterfly wings, its surface glimmers like Tacetites. Due to its reactive nature, careful storage is required after collection to prevent loss of its frequency energy.

name: Polywing Polarizer
description: An advanced material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Sword Resonators.
background: A triple-winged metallic shard, exhibiting an unusual radiance. This material forms under extremely rare conditions, and its transformation patterns remain largely unexplored by current scientific research.

name: Layered Wing Polarizer
description: A premium material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Sword Resonators.
background: A solidified metallic shard, resembling a fused cluster of butterfly wings. Microscopic analysis of a few samples reveals their highly intricate internal structure, which appears more like that of a living organism than an inorganic material.

name: Incomplete Combustor
description: A basic material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Pistols Resonators.
background: A bullet-shaped metal, named Combustor for its peculiar shape. Specialized purification processes are required as it typically contains a high level of impurities.

name: Aftertune Combustor
description: A medium material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Pistols Resonators.
background: Resembling a solidified bullet, this metal has undergone quenching, greatly reducing impurities. Even non-specialists can discern the differences between various grades.

name: Remnant Combustor
description: An advanced material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Pistols Resonators.
background: Resembling a bullet, this metal has its impurities almost removed after repeated purification. Beyond its practical applications, its exquisite and unusual form makes it a highly sought-after collectible.

name: Reverb Combustor
description: A premium material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Pistols Resonators.
background: Rsembling a bullet, this metal is virtually flawless in purity. Some Resonators hesitate to use it as Ascension Material, preferring to have it crafted into unique ornaments by skilled artisans.

name: Spliced String
description: A basic material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Rectifier Resonators.
background: Pieced together from fragments, this Resonance Cord reveals to humans the concept of stationary vibration for the first time.

name: Broken String
description: A medium material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Rectifier Resonators.
background: Intermittent and incomplete, this Resonance Cord contains stored tonal energy that can be extracted by researchers, yet its content remains indecipherable.

name: Solidified String
description: An advanced material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Rectifier Resonators.
background: Complete and solidified, this Resonance Cord captures the paradox of motion and stillness that fascinates researchers. Its secrets, however, remain unsolved.

name: Melodic String
description: A premium material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Rectifier Resonators.
background: Interwoven yet balanced, this Resonance Cord is as harmonious as a song that no one has ever written. Perhaps it is more a subject for aesthetics than science.

name: LF Carved Crystal
description: A basic material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Broadblade Resonators.
background: A chipped crystal of Waveworn residue. Originally a blocky structure, its equilibrium is broken, and its Remnant Energy has mostly dissipated.

name: MF Carved Crystal
description: A medium material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Broadblade Resonators.
background: A chipped crystal of Waveworn residue. It remains stable and, with the proper absorber, the contained Remnant Energy may still be extracted.

name: HF Carved Crystal
description: An advanced material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Broadblade Resonators.
background: A chipped crystal of Waveworn residue. It maintains a delicate equilibrium and, after centrifugation, its concentrated product becomes widely useful.

name: FF Carved Crystal
description: A premium material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Broadblade Resonators.
background: A chipped crystal of Waveworn residue. It maintains a breathtakingly stable equilibrium. As a critical material for advanced technologies, it is subject to the strictest trade restrictions worldwide.

name: LF Waveworn Shard
description: A basic material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Gauntlets Resonators.
background: A radial-cracked Waveworn residue. Its equilibrium has been disrupted, and the remaining Remnant Energy has decayed to mere Reverberations.

name: MF Waveworn Shard
description: A medium material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Gauntlets Resonators.
background: A radial-cracked Waveworn residue. It remains stable and, with the proper absorber, the contained Remnant Energy may still be extracted.

name: HF Waveworn Shard
description: An advanced material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Gauntlets Resonators.
background: A radial-cracked Waveworn residue. It maintains a delicate equilibrium and, after centrifugation, its concentrated product becomes widely useful.

name: FF Waveworn Shard
description: A premium material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Gauntlets Resonators.
background: A radial-cracked Waveworn residue. It maintains a breathtakingly stable equilibrium. As a critical material for advanced technologies, it is subject to the strictest trade restrictions worldwide.

name: Wood-textured Shard
description: Special drops from the Huanglong region, which can be used to exchange for various items in the Souvenir Store.
background:
"In the Huanglong region, ancient buildings were traditionally built using wood, but it proved to be insufficient in meeting modern strength requirements. Hence, Huanglong began to explore alternative building materials that could replicate the traditional wooden texture while providing sturdiness.
These Wood-textured Shards can be found all throughout the region, with varying shapes and origins – from houses and shops to military camps and academies. Although uncovering the stories behind them is a challenging task, the Pioneer Association relentlessly pursues this endeavor. Each shard holds a piece of history waiting to be discovered.

name: Morphable Echo - Gusts of Welkin
description:
Open to obtain a random Echo of the following Sonata Effect: Gusts of Welkin.

2pcs Set: Aero DMG +10%.

5pcs Set: Inflicting Aero Erosion on enemies increases Aero DMG for all Resonators in the team by 15%, and for the Resonator triggering this effect by an additional 15%, lasting for 20s.
background: Between the cracks, the gentle breeze cleanses impurities like a clear spring...

name: Morphable Echo - Windward Pilgrimage
description:
Open to obtain a random Echo of the following Sonata Effect: Windward Pilgrimage.

2pcs Set: Aero DMG +10%.

5pcs Set: Hitting a target with Aero Erosion increases Crit. Rate by 10% and grants 30% Aero DMG Bonus, lasting for 10s.
background: The footprints in the rift will never fade...

name: Morphable Echo - Flaming Clawprint
description:
Open to obtain a random Echo of the following Sonata Effect: Flaming Clawprint.

2pcs Set: Fusion DMG +10%.

5pcs Set: Casting Resonance Liberation increases Fusion DMG of Resonators in the team by 15% and the caster's Resonance Liberation DMG by 20%, lasting for 35s.
background: The spark in the rift will eventually ignite a blaze...

name: Morphable Echo - Rite of Gilded Revelation
description:
Open to obtain a random Echo of the following Sonata Effect: Rite of Gilded Revelation

2pcs Set: Spectro DMG +10%.

5pcs Set: Dealing Basic Attack DMG increases Spectro DMG by 10% for 5s, stacking up to 3 times. With 3 stacks, casting Resonance Liberation grants 40% Basic Attack DMG Bonus.
background: Through the cracks, deep rumbles of distant waves sound...

name: Morphable Echo - Halo of Starry Radiance
description:
Open to obtain a random Echo of the following Sonata Effect: Halo of Starry Radiance.

2pcs Set: Healing Bonus+10%.

5pcs Set: When healing a Resonator in the team, every 1% of Off-Tune Buildup Rate grants a 0.2% ATK increase to all Resonators in the team for 4s, up to 25%. Effects of the same name cannot be stacked.
background: Through the cracks, deep rumbles of distant waves sound...

name: Morphable Echo - Pact of Neonlight Leap
description:
Open to obtain a random Echo of the following Sonata Effect: Pact of Neonlight Leap.

2pcs Set: Spectro DMG +10%.

5pcs Set: Casting Outro Skill increases the ATK of the incoming Resonator who casts Intro Skill by 15%. Each point of Tune Break Boost the incoming Resonator has additionally increases their ATK by 0.3%, up to 15%. This effect lasts for 15s, or until the Resonator is switched out.
background: Through the cracks, deep rumbles of distant waves sound...

name: Morphable Echo - Dream of the Lost
description:
Open to obtain a random Echo of the following Sonata Effect: Dream of the Lost.

3pcs Set: Holding 0 Resonance Energy increases Crit. Rate by 20% and Echo Skill DMG Bonus by 35%.
background: The footprints in the rift will never fade...

name: Morphable Echo - Crown of Valor
description:
Open to obtain a random Echo of the following Sonata Effect: Crown of Valor.

3pcs Set: Obtaining a Shield increases the shielded Resonator's ATK and Crit. DMG by 6% and 4% respectively for 4s, stacking up to 5 times. This effect can be triggered once every 0.5s.
background: The footprints in the rift will never fade...

name: Morphable Echo - Law of Harmony
description:
Open to obtain a random Echo of the following Sonata Effect: Law of Harmony

3pcs Set: Casting Echo Skill grants 30% Heavy Attack DMG Bonus to the caster for 4s. Additionally, all Resonators in the team gain 4% Echo Skill DMG Bonus for 30s, stacking up to 4 times. Echoes of the same name can only trigger this effect once. The record of Echo triggering this effect is cleared along with this effect. At 4 stacks, casting Echo Skill again resets the duration of this effect.
background: The footprints in the rift will never fade...

name: Morphable Echo - Flamewing's Shadow
description:
Open to obtain a random Echo of the following Sonata Effect: Flamewing's Shadow.

3pcs Set: Dealing Echo Skill DMG increases Heavy Attack Crit. Rate by 20% for 6s. Dealing Heavy Attack DMG increases Echo Skill Crit. Rate by 20% for 6s. While both effects are active, gain 16% Fusion DMG Bonus.
background: The footprints in the rift will never fade...

name: Morphable Echo - Thread of Severed Fate
description:

3pcs Set: Inflicting Havoc Bane increases the Resonator's ATK by 20% and grants 30% Resonance Liberation DMG Bonus for 5s.
background: The footprints in the rift will never fade...

name: Morphable Echo - Trailblazing Star
description:
Open to obtain a random Echo of the following Sonata Effect: Trailblazing Star.

2pcs Set: Fusion DMG +10%.

5pcs Set: Inflicting Fusion Burst or Tune Rupture - Shifting increases the Resonator's Crit. Rate by 20% and grants 20% Fusion DMG Bonus for 8s.
background: The footprints in the rift will never fade...

name: Morphable Echo - Chromatic Foam
description:
Open to obtain a random Echo of the following Sonata Effect: Chromatic Foam.

2pcs Set: Fusion DMG +10%.

5pcs Set: When the Resonator inflicts Fusion Burst on the enemies, they gain the following effects: Gain 10 Fusion DMG Bonus for 15s. While this effect is active, casting an Outro Skill grants the incoming Resonator 25% Fusion DMG Bonus for 15s or until they are switched out.
background: The footprints in the rift will never fade...

name: Morphable Echo - Sound of True Name
description:
Open to obtain a random Echo of the following Sonata Effect: Sound of True Name.

2pcs Set: Aero DMG +10%.

5pcs Set: Dealing Echo Skill DMG to enemies increases the Resonator's Echo Skill Crit. Rate by 20%, and grants 15% Aero DMG Bonus for 5s.
background: The footprints in the rift will never fade...

name: Morphable Wishes of Quiet Snowfall
description:
Open to obtain a random Echo of the following Sonata Effect: Wishes of Quiet Snowfall.
2pcs Set: Glacio +10%.
5pcs Set: Inflicting Glacio Chafe on enemies increases Glacio DMG dealt by 10% for 15s. The Resonator gains the Snowfall effect, which can be triggered once every 25s.
While Snowfall is active:
- Dealing Resonance Liberation DMG removes Snowfall and increases the Resonator's Crit. Rate by 25% for 6s. Dealing Resonance Liberation DMG again during the effect prolongs its duration by 4s, triggered once every 0.5s, up to 6 times each time Snowfall is removed.
- Casting Outro Skill removes Snowfall and grants 25% Glacio DMG Bonus to the incoming Resonator for 15s.
Only one of the two effects can be triggered each time Snowfall is removed.
background: The footprints in the rift will never fade...

name: Morphable Reel of Spliced Memories
description:
Open to obtain a random Echo of the following Sonata Effect: Reel of Spliced Memories.
2pcs Set: ATK +10%.
5pcs Set: Inflicting Tune Rupture - Shifting or Tune Strain - Shifting on enemies increases the Tune Break Boost of Resonators in the team by 20 for 30s. Effects of the same name do not stack.

name: Boost Unit
description:
Increases Max STA by 10 points.
Can be obtained from upgrading the Data Bank.
background: A component that requires a large amount of computing power to run. It can stably output power, and when loaded on a Terminal, it can significantly improve the owner's mobility.

name: Boost Unit: Flight
description: Increases Max STA for Flight by 10 points. Can be obtained from Exploration Rewards of Ragunna.
background: An expansion unit of Data Bank, steadily increasing the maximum power limit of the Flight function.

name: Dagger with Special Symbols
description: A small knife given by Mr. Zi.
background: A delicate small knife, engraved with patterns like a crocodile.

name: "Lingo Collection - Part One"
description: Industry Lingo provided by Mr. Zi.
background: Lingo Collection - Part One Shoulder: buddy, man, friend. Make it Loud: State your name. The Silent: Who can't state the name. The Loud: Who have strong background. Outsiders: Who don't understand Lingo. Mingle: Use Lingo. Movers: Who have reputation. Shakers: Boss, leader. Pour the Water: Gimme the Money. Wipe Your Eyes: Take a good look. To the Far: Eyes. To the Wind: Ears. The Long: Legs. The Green: Weapons. Rod: Guns. ...

name: Heat Absorption Device
description: A device that can mitigate the negative effects of the Sea of Flames.
background: The Protection Device comes in two parts, carrying both can significantly reduce the Incineranur's harm to the user. However, if you remain in the Incineranur for too long, damage values will accumulate over time. Please also be aware not to step directly onto the Petals.

name: Soundproof Device
description: A device that can mitigate the negative effects of the Sea of Flames.
background: Two sets of devices that can mitigate the toxic pollens greatly. Please note that extended stay in the Sea of Flames can be dangerous even with these devices. Also, please stay away from the petals.

name: Photo: Shuyun in the Refinery
description: Digital image recorded by the Terminal.
background: A digital image recorded by the Terminal, showing Shuyun working in the Refinery.

name: Photo: Shu Yun in the Mine
description: Digital image recorded by the Terminal.
background: A digital image recorded by the Terminal, showing Shuyun working in the Mine.
