description: Digital image recorded by the Terminal.
background: A digital image recorded by the Terminal, showing Shuyun working in the Port.

name: "Instruction Manual For Left-handers"
description: An Instruction Manual given by Shuyun.
background: An Instruction Manual. Its writer, Shuyun details the steps to operate machines in the Refinery for Uncle Xie, who has injured his right hand.

name: Water Quality Sample
description: Squeaky Express new site preparation environmental sampling.
background: A sample of potential new site locations. It is used to test whether the environment meets the standards for site construction.

name: Soil Sample
description: Squeaky Express new site preparation environmental sampling.
background: A sample of potential new site locations. It is used to test whether the environment meets the standards for site construction.

name: Biological Sample
description: Squeaky Express new site preparation environmental sampling.
background: A sample of potential new site locations. It is used to test whether the environment meets the standards for site construction.

name: Locked Box
description: A box left by Jiaping, with an electronic lock on it.
background: During her days in the Exiles camp, she carefully preserved the things inside, but now they lay casually discarded in the corner.

name: Jiaping's Diary
description: Jiaping's Diary.
background: It contains a record of what happened during Jiaping's stay in the Exile camp, as well as some nonsensical feelings and expectations.

name: Qingru's Reward
description: "The Precious" given by Qingru.
background: In order to give Pinwen an inexpensive, precious, and inviting gift, Qingru has decided to ask for your help at a hefty price.

name: Metal Key
description: Key obtained from the Hoochief group.
background: An old-fashioned key, obtained from a group of Hoochiefs.

name: Special Waterlamp
description: Waterlamp that blooms during the day.
background: One of the gifts that Yise asked Rover to collect. A special Waterlamp that can bloom in the daytime by hiding in the darkness.

name: Star-shaped Core
description: Core dropped by the Tacet Discord.
background: One of the gifts that Yise asked Rover to collect. An exclusive gift used to please the researcher.

name: Mature Cliffrecluse
description: Daily Quests Item
background: This item can only be obtained when three Cliffrecluses grow into one piece.

name: Crude Voice Material
description: A crude voice material made by the Exiles.
background: A crude sound material made from Gloom Slough, enabling thrill-seekers to experience tense and fearful scenarios. While its effects are modest, it is easy to make.

name: Map drawn by Hoochief
description: A map that marks the locations of the cages in the eastern forest and the Hoochief camp.
background: Out of hatred for humans, the Hoochiefs in the Dim Forest will use tree cages to imprison passers-by. They use the hides of other creatures in the forest to crudely imitate humans and draw maps to remind the locations of the tree cages.

name: Strangely Shaped Key
description: A key that can open the hidden passage of the Dim Forest.
background: A special-shaped key that can open the secret passage in the Dim Forest. It belongs to the zookeeper before the Lament.

name: Rusted Data Card
description: A data card in the Dim Forest camp.
background: A data card obtained from the Dim Forest camp, old and rusty. Perhaps, it can be used to open the nearby iron cage.

name: Rescue Team Badge
description: A badge that seems to have been weathered.
background: A badge from fifty years ago. It used to be worn by the Resonators who formed a temporary rescue team to protect Huanglong citizens from Tacet Discords and natural disasters during the great migration.

name: Special Dewvetch
description: A Dewvetch flower that represents a woman named "Dewvetch" from the Danjin family.
background: A flower that carries an elder's deep feelings

name: Half of a jade pendant
description: A half of a jade pendant held by Dewvetch's sister, it seems to match the jade pendant held by Dewvetch.
background: A jade pendant with secret information. It was of great significance to someone.

name: Mechanical box
description: A mechanical box left by Dewvetch to the old man.
background: A puzzle box with unknown secrets.

name: Dewvetch's diary
description: A record of Dewvetch's own voice left before her death.
background: Information that records the ill-fated life of a woman.

name: Chixia's father's diary
description: Chixia's father's diary.
background: A diary left behind by Chixia's father during his lifetime. Seems to record his conversation with a friend.

name: Worn-out Box
description: A box given to the Rover by the boss of the Boar Gang.
background: A box that Muzhi secretly entrusted Rover to transport. Seems to contain some Tacetite weapons, with its recipient unknown...

name: Exiles' Weapon
description: Weapons confiscated from the Exiles.
background: The weapons targeted by the Boar Gang. The original owner seems to be no longer important.

name: Court of Savantae's Data Chip
description: The chip given by the Magistrate Jinhsi.
background: The chip given by Jinhsi, which stores the research records of the Court of Savantae on the Sentinel.

name: Suspicious Audio Sound Material
description: The sound material that can reproduce the scene after use.
background: The sound material made from suspicious audio which appeared in the Blazing Prairie.

name: Qiongxue's Original Manuscript
description: The original manuscript stored in the information device.
background: A data device left by Qiongxue, recording the creativity of the two siblings in their childhood.

name: "Fire in the Wilderness" Excerpt
description: The novel excerpt stored in the information device.
background: Selected chapters from Blazing Prairie, master work of the fantasy novelist "Jing".

name: Scenic Photo
description: The scenic photo near the camp of the Ninth Investigation Corps of the Central Plains.
background: Scenery photos taken by Athos. He accidentally left behind his camera, hoping that Rover would find the camera through these landscape photos.

name: Athos's Information Touchpad
description: Return the information touchpad to Athos.
background: A touchpad left behind by Athos in the Memento Square.

name: Icefield Honor Medal
description: The medal lost by Zhi Zhi.
background: The highest honor bestowed by the Academy to the participants in the Glacier Science Research Initiative. For Zhizhi, these were the last words her father left her.

name: Data source to be analyzed
description: Ancient laboratory data source.
background: The data source that fell from the body of the Mech Abomination. Appears to store information about the Court of Savantae. An old laboratory data source.

name: Universal repair box
description: Toolbox that can handle various repair work.
background: A versatile repair kit for all occasions. Whether it's household fixes or professional maintenance, you're sure to find the right tools inside.

name: Sound catcher
description: Strange Court of Savantae device.
background: An amazing device created by the Court of Savantae. Able to collect scattered Acoustic Prints.

name: Recorder
description: Strange Court of Savantae device.
background: A device created by the Court of Savantae and used with the Sound Capture Device. Able to compile the collected Acoustic Prints and restore the sound that once existed.

name: Records
description: Threnodian "noise" that remains in the target object.
background: Threnodian "noise" that remains in the target object. Able to make any contactor become violent and aggressive.

name: Photo of the Snow Crane
description: Deliver the photo to Hanxiang, to fulfill her wish.
background: Hanxiang wants to see the photo of the Snow Crane.

name: Wooden training sword
description: Deliver the wooden sword to Hanxiang, to inspire her courage.
background: Help Hanxiang become a member of the Mornguard.

name: Primitive tide stone
description: Weapon energy of the Exile Leader.
background: The yellow ore obtained after removing the Tacetite shell is shaped like Tacetreite, but is actually still Tacetite, and is usually used by the Exile Leaders.

name: Survival code
description: For Exiles to read and acquire wilderness survival skills and experience.
background: The Exile Leader's survival codex, which contains various survival tips and experiences for their fellow Exiles. Varies slightly from camp to camp.

name: Cruising Drake's delivery box
description: A delivery box invented by the Cruising Drake.
background: Seven pairs of packed delivery boxes, containing the strange inventions of the Cruising Drake. Strange packing methods were used in order to carry the strange inventions.

name: Tacetite ore
description: Energy ore.
background: Energy mineral that has been gradually phased out, now mostly used as refining raw materials, somehow fell into the hands of Exiles.

name: "Dream Return Song III: Stone Leaf Tears"
description: The tenth anniversary collector's edition of the storybook "Stone Leaf Tear".
background: "He comes back every year, fantasizing her never leaving" Scripts once won the "Audience's Choice Award" in Jinzhou Theater. It tells a story about a couple of childhood sweethearts overcome obstacles to treat strange disease and rescue the whole village. The desolate yet beautiful scene of farewell won over the favor of young boys and girls. Its peripheral product, "Crystallized Vane", was once a heat in Jinzhou.

name: Dropped key
description: The key dropped by Blobfly.
background: A key dropped by Blobfly in Kaimi Remnant Site. It got quite the ancient looks and style.

name: Crystallized Leaf
description: The leaf with a completely crystallized surface.
background: A vane of the ancient tree "Loong's Gaze". Its surface is covered by hard crystals. Script Tear of Stone Vane compared this vane to tears and used it as a symbol of love for the male and female protagonists.

name: Philosophical Notes
description: The information touchpad of Sizhe, returning it may have a reward.
background: Notebook of Sizhe, which records his unconstrained ideas during his investigation missions.

name: The lost weapon
description: The lost weapon.
background: The Weapon dropped by Yunhe, a relatively old standard in the Midnight Rangers.

name: The singing section of the Song of the Empty Dawn
description: The sound material of the Song of the Empty Dawn sung by Qianxin.
background: The singer who performed at the theater turned her singing into sound materials. Due to the singer's own Forte, it can be used to soothe the spirit and enhance the Forte when played. The singing that once gave hope in confusion has now become her last echo in this world.

name: Auspicious Bell
description: The bell that Lingyang wore during the performance. As a thank you for the journey, Lingyang gave it to you.
background:
A copper spherical bell, a gentle shake can hear a crisp and pleasant sound, it is said to bring good luck and courage to the wearer.
Things themselves have no meaning, uniqueness is often given by people. Perhaps, the moment the boy reached out to you firmly in the crowd, he had already shown you his courage.

name: Wood for making a Plum Blossom Pole
description: Wood for making a Plum Blossom Pole, sturdy and hard.
background: Plum Blossom Pole

name: Lingyang's picture book
description: A picture book made by Lingyang based on her own experiences.
background: A picture book

name: Bell Spiriton
description: A special material from the Bell-Borne Geochelone.
background: A rare material from the Bell-Borne Geochelone, which only appears at a specific frequency. It's said that in the hands of a skilled apothecary, it can be refined into a miraculous medicine.

name: Obscure Recipe
description: A recipe detailing the ingredients and method for Jade Treasure Soup.
background: A recipe found in an old book by Panhua, it is said that following this recipe can recreate the long-lost wartime dish, the Jade Treasure Soup that people describe as “a condensed bowl of Jinzhou". However, through time, the terms written in the recipe have become obscure and difficult to understand. Before cooking, it is necessary to further confirm the specific ingredients.

name: Mahe Special Ingredient Pack
description: Special ingredient pack for cooking Jade Treasure Soup.
background: The grocer Mahe, who has traveled far and wide, has identified and prepared an ingredient pack according to the recipe. This pack contains all the ingredients needed to make the Jade Treasure Soup.

name: Koko's special "Luohan Clearwater"
description: Special potion used for cooking Jade Treasure Soup.
background: Luohan Clearwater, an unrecognizable term for Mahe, is used among pharmacies years ago, referring to the potion made by boiling Coriolus, Perilla, and Lemongrass. To make the Jade Treasure Soup, Koko gave you a portion.

name: The Second Coming of Solaris in-game redemption code.
description: An in-game item redemption code that can be used to redeem Second Coming of Solaris x Jewel Boba Collaboration Pack.
background:
The collaboration between Jewel Boba and the Pioneer Association's Second Coming of Solaris has begun, bringing exclusive "jewels" to Second Coming of Solaris!
This secret key includes an in-game item redemption code, which can be used to claim the exclusive Jewel Boba Collaboration Pack in the game client.

name: The Second Coming of Solaris in-game redemption code.
description: An in-game item redemption code that can be used to redeem Second Coming of Solaris x Jewel Boba Collaboration Pack.
background:
The collaboration between Jewel Boba and the Pioneer Association's Second Coming of Solaris has begun, bringing exclusive "jewels" to Second Coming of Solaris!
This secret key includes an in-game item redemption code, which can be used to claim the exclusive Jewel Boba Collaboration Pack in the game client.

name: Familiar-looking Large Fish
description: A large fish acquired by chance from fishing. It can be used to replace another fish.
background: This fish leaped into the boat as the net was hauled in, almost as if eager to be caught. It looked strangely familiar...

name: Helm Village Lighthouse Key
description: Use this key to activate the lighthouse in Helm Village.
background: "Oh, you mean this? Ahab asked me to keep it for him. I don't know where he got it, but... this thing, it must have something to do with that whale, right?"

name: Titanium Mackerel
description: A mysterious mechanical device. It activates the Serene Bay lighthouse.
background: This mysterious fish doesn't seem to be from this world. Perhaps that's why it has the power to activate the lighthouse Imperator built.

name: Reyes Treasure Map Fragment
description: A fragment of a treasure map. Collect all pieces to assemble the complete map.
background: Why are treasure maps often fragmented? They should probably conceal the treasure in multiple locations. Easier for the later generations to find.

name: Pequod Blueprint: Basic
description: Basic blueprint for constructing "Pequod."
background: The island's fishermen never actually saw the real "Pequod." Captain Ahab only described it as a ship that sank at sea. This design is based on Ahab's sketches and the Ragunna boat model.

name: Pequod Blueprint: Advanced
description: Advanced blueprint for constructing "Pequod."
background: "The world is a vast ship sailing onward, with no single, definitive voyage."

name: Ahab's Diary
description: A sea-weathered journal of Ahab's past sailing experiences.
background: He was invincible at sea until he encountered it. The Captain Ahab who once traversed Solaris's vast oceans, is now but an old man, filled with hatred and hope, defiantly awaiting death by the sea.

name: Nannerl's Bottle
description: Nannerl's drift bottle that holds her dreams.
background: "Brother, wherever you may be... if you can see this, play a song for me. I will hear it. One day, you will hear my music too."

name: "Sweet Puff"
description: Bampuff for detonating certain reefs
background: Intended as fireworks for Starbuck's wedding with a certain fish, this Bampuff is incredibly powerful and can also be used to destroy reefs.

name: Fresh Fish
description: Fresh Fish for Julien.
background: Julien loves it! Thanks meow!

name: Special Every Flavor Bell-less Crab
description: Special Every Flavor Bell-less Crab, though it looks like the taste might be a bit weird.
background: Perhaps "delicious" is always subjective, just as Imperator understands that not everyone knows how to ride a horse.

name: Mysterious Complete Treasure Map
description: A fully pieced-together treasure map marking hidden treasure.
background: A life at sea entails battling the the ocean and fighting pirates to the death. To the victor goes the spoils. Thus this Treasure Map is a testament to our victory.

name: Tacet Field Geological Data
description: Geological data collected from the Tacet Field.
background: After the Lament, Tacet Fields have spread across the land, serving as one of the breeding grounds for Tacet Discords. Its geological data is a valuable research sample for researchers.

name: Active Tacetite Sample
description: Active Tacetite sample collected from the Tacet Field.
background: Tacetite is both a new source of energy and a dangerous mineral. Please keep the active Tacetite samples collected from Tacet Fields in a safe place to avoid causing secondary disasters or affecting the health of others.

name: Delivery Box
description: Delivery box from Squeaky Quick Delivery.
background: Delivery boxes printed with the Squeaky Express logo are durable and sturdy. If you meet similar boxes in the field, please help pick them up and recover them.

name: Delivery Box
description: Delivery box from Squeaky Quick Delivery.
background: Delivery boxes printed with the Squeaky Express logo are durable and sturdy. If you meet similar boxes in the field, please help pick them up and recover them.

name: Delivery Box
description: Delivery box from Squeaky Quick Delivery.
background: Delivery boxes printed with the Squeaky Express logo are durable and sturdy. If you meet similar boxes in the field, please help pick them up and recover them.

name: Lost Key
description: A key with a pre-Lament style.
background: Although it is a key from before the Lament, it seems to have been little affected by the seawater due to its special craftsmanship. It seems to be able to open a door of a nearby room.

name: Remaining Key
description: A key with a pre-Lament style.
background: A key left in a room turned into a ruin by the seawater, it should be able to open a door in the same floor.

name: Guide Crystal
description: A precise experimental device
background: A precise experimental device, storing extremely complex frequency information. It belongs to the long-abandoned Bridge Project of Court of Savantae, and is a key item to activate the detection platform.

name: Level Delivery Test Item - Spear Tip
description: Level Delivery Test Item - Spear Tip Function Description
background: bgdescription

name: Level Delivery Test Item - Spear Breech
description: Level Delivery Test Item - Spear Breech Function Description
background: bgdescription

name: Level Delivery Test Item - Gun Body
description: Level Delivery Test Item - Gun Body Function Description
background: bgdescription

name: Robot Spare Parts
description: Spare parts for Huanglong military robots, for drivers to repair when the robot breaks down.
background: Parts should always be where they belong. After all, someone will always need them.

name: Robot Battery Pack
description: Battery pack for Huanglong military robots, providing power for the entire robot.
background: The power that once carried someone through the mountains will remain in the mountains, remain on someone.

name: Robot Engine
description: The engine of the Huanglong military robot, which looks ordinary, but is the most important part of the robot.
background: There is always someone who wants to own it, for money, for friends.

name: Driver's Recording Card
description: An ordinary-looking recording card that can be used to play the recorded content.
background: You hear the restless, tired human voice and the emotionless mechanical sound. Until the radio is completely silent, only the wind is howling in the ear.

name: Explosive Charge
description: A natural fruit with explosive properties that can be used as a substitute for a bomb.
background: A special fruit that looks like a bomb, which can produce a bomb-like explosion when it encounters a violent impact or temperature change, and is often used as a substitute for explosives. Special means are needed for transportation and storage.

name: Seaside Arena Access Card

background: A metal bottle cap, sprayed with a pattern of advancing upwards, symbolizing courage, is a symbol of the trial at the Seaside Arena. Due to limited technology, the badge is made from a metal bottle cap.

background: A commemorative photo of the sunrise viewed from the top of Mt. Pingting. This ray of morning sun inspires people to firmly run towards the ideal tomorrow.

background: A broken old record, it looks like a product from decades ago

background: A broken old sheet music, it looks like a product from decades ago

name: Investigation Report on the Quick-Access Portals on the Black Shores
description: Open to view the content.
background: A report with an appendix over 10 pages long of meticulous data analysis. Whoever submitted it was conscientious; that much is clear.

name: Data Log of Black Shores Staff Forum
description: Open to view the content.
background: An incomplete record of a discussion thread on the Black Shores' Staff Forum about the access doors.

name: Sword of Atrocity
description: A knight's sword, imbued with an obsession for mercy, must be placed in the right Sword Pedestal to seal its power.
background: What one calls mercy, another experiences as cruelty.

name: Sword of Greed
description: A knight's sword, imbued with an obsession for generosity, must be placed in the right Sword Pedestal to seal its power.
background: The greedy souls always complain that the world is not generous enough.

name: Sword of Ignorance
description: A knight's sword, imbued with an obsession for wisdom, must be placed in the right Sword Pedestal to seal its power.
background: True wisdom is always accompanied by an equal measure of folly.

name: Sword of Vanity
description: A knight's sword, imbued with an obsession for honor, must be placed in the right Sword Pedestal to seal its power.
background: Those who put ends before means only find empty glory.

name: Sword of Cowardice
description: A knight's sword, imbued with an obsession for bravery, must be placed in the right Sword Pedestal to seal its power.
background: A coward's heart seeks refuge in the shell of bravery.

name: Crushed Candy
description:
Increases Echo drop rate by 50% for 30m.
A gift from Painter: Thank you, my best audience.
background: How could this happen... I had kept it safe for so long, yet now it's crushed—perhaps I should blame that little stumble during the Night Reveries. Still, I hope you'll accept it, as it's a small token of my gratitude.

name: Innocent Dreams
description: A toy made from unknown materials, capable of detecting weak but warm frequencies.
background:
A token of your successful completion of all the challenges in the event "Fairy Tale’s Finale." It’s a fitting gift for a brave soul like you.
A beautiful glass ball that looks somewhat familiar to you.
You can sense weak but warm frequencies pulsating from the miniature landscape inside it. Yet, it's still unclear what it's supposed to be used for.
"I hope you can draw strength from my story and win all battles."

name: Montelli Clearance Module - Level I
description: A clearance module specially authorized by Carlotta, granting you full access to every section of Averardo Vault.
background:
"This is the highest level of access I can grant you, though it won't save you from the trouble of obtaining permissions within the Vault. I'm counting on you, Cat's Eye."
 
In other words, your clearance within the Averardo Vault is now on par with hers.

description: A clearance module specially authorized by Carlotta, granting you full access to every section of Averardo Vault.

name: Ripples of Serene Dreams
description: An energy entity, symbolizing treasured memories, like ripples formed by a single sound.

name: Stake of Imbalance
description: An item that can remove the Lifer's buff.
background: Once a pivotal stake at the negotiation table, its intricate patterns seem to capture the tension, strategy, resolve, and compromise that transpired between the Order and the various fractions gathered around the table.

name: Porto-Veno's Badge
description: A badge that bears the crest of the Fisalia family.
background: There are four special trials taking place around Porto-Veno Castle. Those who conquer these challenges will be granted this badge by the Fisalia family.

name: Tower
description: A painting gifted by the traveling painter Claudia, capturing a scene from the tower ruins.
background:
According to legend, the Thorncrown Rises, located in Thessaleo Fells, holds the lost glory of the Fisalia family. 
Through the painter's delicate brushstrokes, one can sense her upset and confusion.

name: "Wishes Under a Clear Sky"
description: A toy made from unknown materials, emanating a faint but warm frequency.
background:
Proof of successful completion of all the challenges in "Although Colors Have No Form."
A talisman from Claudia, rumored to be a fragment of the Genesis Nexus. It emits a faint but warm frequency, though its true purpose remains uncertain.
"...They longed for the sky above, yearning for it more desperately than any soul in this world."

name: Box of Silence
description: A bomb originally used by the Order to frame the Montelli family. It has been transformed by Phoebe's soul-healing power into a tool for saving lives.
background: A sacred aura lingers, as if a quiet sigh was left behind by someone.

name: "Past"
description: A strange book, aged and worn. It is marked with traces of erosion from seawater.
background:
A strange book found floating in the Sea of Ghosts, one that seemingly records the past, its cover ravaged by seawater, and the waterlogged pages stick together, making it impossible to open. The past cannot be retraced, yet the abyss insists on drawing you back in time.
Past and Present come together, leading to the Future.

name: "Present"
description: A strange book with a fluid form. It is marked with traces of erosion from seawater.
background:
A strange book found floating in the Sea of Ghosts, its cover formless, its pages sealed. There is no need to look further, for you are presently writing this book.
Past and Present come together, leading to the Future.

name: Fairytale SketchBook
description: A heartwarming fairytale sketchbook. Its pages are slightly yellowed. This book seems to have been made by the maidens.
background: A heartwarming fairytale sketchbook, telling a story of princesses embarking on an adventure. Even though caged, the maidens' hearts were still brimmed with hopeful fantasies.

name: A Strange Book
description: A strange book marked with traces of erosion from seawater.
background: A strange book found floating in the Sea of Ghosts... maybe it's the key to a hidden bookcase door. This book cannot be opened, its contents will not be revealed... Perhaps that's for the best.

name: "Messenger of Deep Dreams"
description:
A seemingly ordinary feather, soft and warm to the touch.

A token of your successful completion of all the challenges in "If You Gaze Into the Abyss of Dreams."
background:
This feather doesn't belong to any real bird, yet it looks somewhat familiar to you.

For a brief moment, holding it evokes the sensation of overlooking the entire Somnoire from great heights.

Though its purpose remains unclear for now, it might come in handy one day.

"If you gaze into the abyss of dreams, the abyss of dreams gazes also into you."

name: Eerie Sketchbook
description: An eerie Sketchbook scribbled in messy and twisted handwriting.
background: An eerie sketchbook, its pages inscribled with a haunting song, scribbled in twisted handwriting. What once were vivid fantasies have now turned into silent tears, dripping across its surface and leaving behind blurry and heartbreaking stains.

name: Repaired Key
description: A key obtained upon passing the Remnant Trial. It might unlock the answers you seek.
background: A key obtained upon passing the Remnant Trial. It might unlock the answers you seek.

name: Above the Stars
description: A photo secretly taken by the Plushie Squad. They witnessed your ascending to the top.
background:
A photo secretly taken by the Plushie Squad. They witnessed your ascending to the top.
You can zoom in to view the photo.

name: "Blazing Claw"
description: The brass knuckles Zani used to wear, as famous as the Blazing Nightwalker's tale itself.
background: For endless nights, these brass knuckles were her only light in the darkness. Now dawn finally breaks. The Blazing Nightwalker may fade into legend and even be lost in history, but the adventures you shared will stay with you forever.

name: The Meditating Blessed Maiden
description: An intact portrait of the Blessed Maiden discovered in the ruins of Avinoleum. You can zoom in to admire it.
background: The painting captures the Blessed Maiden's contemplation in the Seminary. Though it has weathered the passage of time, her sacred aura remains undimmed.

name: Above the Stars
description: A photo secretly taken by the Plushie Squad. They witnessed your ascending to the top.
background:
A photo secretly taken by the Plushie Squad. They witnessed your ascending to the top.
You can zoom in to view the photo.

name: Samousas' Treasure
description: A heavy chest, stashed away here by Samousas.
background: It gives off a dull metallic clatter when shaken. It seems like it's packed with coins... and some dreams long since forgotten.

name: Fisalia Knight's Letter
description: A letter found in the underwater ruins near Ashen Dragon's Crypt of Septimont. It holds the final words of its master.
background: A letter found in the underwater ruins near Ashen Dragon's Crypt of Septimont. It holds the final words of its master.

name: Huafeng's Vehicle Key
description: A vehicle key found in a sealed case at the bottom of Sundermere.
background:
A vehicle key found in a sealed case at the bottom of Sundermere.

The key of Huafeng's very first vehicle. A fine line engraved on its surface reads: "No.1 Biker." It's the key to both his old dream and his present success. Though the vehicle itself is long gone, Huafeng hopes this cheering line will bring you godspeed wherever the track leads.

name: Sweet Candy
description: Candy wrapped in gleaming paper, carrying a gentle sweetness.
background:
Wrapped in translucent, colorful candy paper, the sweets are firm to the touch. Once in the mouth, they release a gentle, lingering sweetness.

A little sweetness keeps numbness at bay. You understand and accept his kindness, even though a faint trace of bitterness still lingers beneath the sugar.

name: Fleeting Snowfluff Fan Meeting Poster
description: A poster alive with bright colors, radiating the passion of its fans.
background:
After the once-beloved voice faded from campus, fans of Fleeting Snowfluff found a haven on her clean, vibrant website. They left behind a trail of messages, wishes, and memories. Year after year, those words gathered like fallen leaves, slowly forming a genuine community.

The singer may be long absent, yet the youthful warmth of her voice still echoes through this academy.

name: Fan Meeting Keepsake Photo
description: A keepsake photo from the fan meeting, capturing a moment of music and joy.
background:
Aemeath sings onstage, her voice light and warm, floating effortlessly through the air. You applaud from below. When the song ends, she slips in beside you and flashes a bright smile toward the camera.

Click.

In this moment, a song left unfinished more than a decade ago finally feels complete. Seeing Aemeath smile like this always lifts your spirits, and before you realize it, you're smiling too.

name: That Child's Talisman
description: A softly contoured talisman with a lustrous finish, engraved with Royan patterns.
background:
A Royan talisman once cherished by a young owner, only to be lost to the whims of fate.
Now that it has found its way back to you, it feels like a silent proof that your efforts were never in vain. The world lies calm and beautiful before you at this moment, just as you always hoped it would on your journey.

The brief yet indelible time you two shared began with this talisman, and now, with its return, it has come full circle.

name: Safety Charm

background:
Similar to an "Exam Charm," this "mysterious lucky charm" can be occasionally found in certain places. Highly sought after by field personnel, it is said to bless its holder with safety and good fortune. Rumor has it that it really can ward off danger and misfortune.
However, this particular piece appears unfinished. Its slightly misaligned edges suggest it is a work in progress.

name: Ancient Royan Incised Stone
description: A stone with carvings of portraits and Royan characters.
background:
On the stone are three animals: a Fluffguin, a Kronapuff, and a Toskr Lemming. They are gathered happily around a Roya girl who is carving statues with a small knife.

"To my best friends: Fenrir, who loves to dance. Dallas, who loves to eat fish. And Bori, who loves flowers.
I carve you on this stone, so we can always be together. Forever."

name: The Nimbus Chorale: Soil of Abundance
description: A musical record found in Nimbus Sanctum. This chorale was performed by the people of Rinascita long before the Order's founding.
background: "We thank Rinascita, for she embraced us with her fertile lands, offering a shelter to those of us drifting in the winds on the sea. From this day forward, we shall have a place to call home, where our roots embed deeply."

name: The Nimbus Chorale: Crystal Sky
description: A musical record found in Nimbus Sanctum. This chorale was performed by the people of Rinascita long before the Order's founding.
background: "We thank the towering figure in the skies above, who guided our sails and protected us as we pressed onward."

name: The Nimbus Chorale: Order of Nature
description: A musical record found in Nimbus Sanctum. This chorale was performed by the people of Rinascita long before the Order's founding.
background: "We thank the cycle of day and night, the ever-shifting seasons, for they have kept hope alive in the darkness and have taught us to look forward to the harvest even in the coldest winters."

name: The Nimbus Chorale: Glory to Humanity
description: A musical record found in Nimbus Sanctum. This chorale was performed by the people of Rinascita long before the Order's founding.
background: "We thank each ancestor who boarded the ship of expedition, knowing they will never return. Time would wear their bodies down, yet their unwavering will carried them forward."

The expression she wore that day has long since faded from memory.

description: The group photo with your Companions after watching "The Tale of Demon-Banishing Asura" together.
background: The time we spend on stage makes our wishes shine brighter.

name: Picture of the First Cubie Derby
description: A commemorative photo from the Pioneer Association. Can be enlarged to view the details.
background: It was such a heated competition thanks to everyone's endless enthusiasm! As the saying goes, competition comes first… Ahem, I mean, friendship comes first!

name: Cubie Derby: Championship Keepsake Photo
description: A commemorative photo from the Pioneer Association. Can be enlarged to view the details.
background: It was such a heated competition thanks to everyone's endless enthusiasm! As the saying goes, competition comes first… Ahem, I mean, friendship comes first!

name: Grand Library Route Map
description: There is a mark on the top left of the map. This could be where the puzzle is.
background: A small scroll inside the Sundial, mapping the possible routes of the "Grand Library", the central database in City Hall. There is a red circle on the top left corner of the map that possibily indicates the location of a secret contraption, indicating a confusing detour to the destination.

name: Wooden Plaque: Left
description: A Wooden Plaque for some kind of ancient rituals.
background: A larger fragment of a wooden plaque with mysterious carvings, possibly used in ancient rituals. The meaning of the patterns is unknown.

name: Wooden Plaque: Right
description: A Wooden Plaque for some kind of ancient rituals.
background: A smaller fragment of a wooden plaque with mysterious carvings, possibly used in ancient rituals. The meaning of the patterns is unknown.

name: Restored Wooden Plaque
description: Restored Wooden Plaque
background: A restored wooden plaque with mysterious carvings. You remember seeing a socket where it could fit somewhere before…

name: A Diary
description: A Strange Diary
background: A strange diary, filled with childish and broken handwriting. It emanates a strange mix of Resonator and Tacet Discords.

name: Black Fruit
description: Jinhsi's Token: I
background: A heavy, dark fruit, just the right size for a hand, emitting a subtle fragrance, it doesn't seem to have anything unusual.

name: Mangosteen
description: Jinhsi's Token: I
background: An ordinary fruit that somehow bears a striking resemblance to the old model of Tacetite Grenade. This is not an indigenous species, as its growth conditions don't agree with the climate of Jinzhou. It's imported by water via the Gunchao Port located in the South.

name: Leaf
description: Jinhsi's Token: II
background: A purple leaf with a faint, peculiar energy.

name: Leaf affected by "Waveworn"
description: Jinhsi's Token: II
background:
A purple leaf with traces of dual Tacet Discord frequencies. The asynchronous fluctuations of the frequencies caused them to cancel each other out and rendered them hard to track.
Could it be that there were actually two separate Tacet Fields surrounding the tree where this leaf originated from?

name: Small Device
description: Jinhsi's Token: III
background:
A finely crafted small device, the surface is engraved with ancient text. The inner ring represents the Four Spirits of Heaven, indicating the location.
"East, the Teal Loong, West, the White Tiger, South, the Vermillion Bird, North, the Black Tortoise".
The outer ring represents the Twelve Earthly Branches, indicating the time.
"Zi, Chou, Yin, Mao, Chen, Si, Wu, Wei, Shen, You, Xu, Hai".

name: Sundial
description: Jinhsi's Token: III
background:
This sundial has a secret compartment. 
Rotate the two disks to the right positions to unlock it and discover its hidden contents.

name: The Unlocked Sundial
description: Jinhsi's Token: III
background: An unlocked Sundial-shaped puzzle box. The direction and time symbols on its disks have been rearranged. However, you have already obtained the key information given by the Jinzhou Magistrate. Now, it appears to be an ordinary small sundial. Only upon closer inspection can you see a faint light source at the top and the shadow of the needle is distorted, almost like a hushed whisper.

name: Sugar Pearl
description: Jinhsi's Token: IV
background: A round, pearl-shaped candy ball hidden inside a simple sweet wrapper.

name: Sugar Pearl
description: Jinhsi's Token: IV
background: A sweet oral vaccine, reminiscent of candy for children in Jinzhou, symbolizes their triumph over the epidemic.

name: Candy
description: A small gift from a child. She hopes you enjoy a sweet time in Jinzhou.
background: A popular treat among the children of Jinzhou, the candy's wrapper bears signs of being eagerly clutched by tiny hands, its folds and creases revealing its cherished history.

name: Archive: Tacet Discord
description: Open the information interface after use
background:
The archives stored in the Huaxu Academy, Jinzhou Campus, record the research information related to "Tacet Discord".
"The information energy body composed of Reverberation, has a mimicry of life activities, and its core behavior goal is to devour and absorb the frequency it needs."

name: Archive: Huaxu Academy, Jinzhou Campus
description: Open the information interface after use
background: An archive of Huaxu Academy, Jinzhou Campus that contains the event of its founding, branches, and other information.

name: Archive: Sugar Pearl Vaccine and Tacet Discord Outbreak
description: Open the information interface after use
background: A research report on "Sugar Pearl" and "Tacet Discord Outbreak", placed on the "Wei" Shelf of Huaxu Academy's archives.

name: Archive: "The First Resonator"
description: Open the information interface after use
background: A research report on Jinzhou's first Resonator, placed on the "Wei" Shelf of Huaxu Academy's archives.

name: Yellowed Sketch
description: Sketch Obtained in the camp of the Séance Society.
background: A sketch drawn with a naive stroke, pressed between faded leaves of a damaged diary. It portrays a family of four and separate image on each one.

name: Peculiar Blake Bloom
description: Peculiar Blake Bloom
background: Identity mark used by members of the Black Shores. You can feel the surge of Remnant Energy when carrying it with your hands.

name: Chrono Sign
description: A key used to open the Woodveil Hall laboratory.
background: The Court of Savantae Committee left many mysteries in Mt. Firmament: its unfinished research buried deep in the mountains and the ending that befell the researchers. Perhaps you'll be able to uncover these dust-sealed secrets with this key.

name: Stories of Guqin
description: A book obtained at Mt. Firmament.
background:
"In this vast expanse, every goodbye could be a farewell for life.
Be well. Farewell."

name: Cipher Key
description: An energy device crafted by the Court of Savantae. Can be used to disable the sealing device of Mianloong Chamber.
background: Those blessed by the deity aspired to raise a gate, however modest it may seem to the divine eyes. Even in its decay, the solitary gate stood sentinel: upholding reverence, for the divine is near.

name: Changli's Letter
description: A letter penned by Changli, containing a message for you.
background:
With a subtle delightful scent, it reads: "Behold Hongzhen in its entirety, next to a ring and hanging eaves. When eternal snow thaws into flowing streams, let us reconvene."
It appears to be an invitation.

name: Feather Pendant
description: A feather pendant left behind by Changli.
background:
Warm and weightless, it gently lands in your palm.
Its purpose remains a mystery.

name: Flame Feather Pendant
description: A flame feather warm to the touch, bestowed by Changli. It symbolizes a cherished sentiment.
background: Through relentless practice, the most brilliant flames born of Forte are condensed into a flame feather nestled in your palm. Radiating a warmth akin to the touch of its creator, it shields the carrier from the harm of Flame Manipulation. This gift is reserved solely for the most significant individual.

name: Glazed Lamp
description: A key item in the Rite of Offering. Can be used to activate the Altar of Initiation.
background: An ancient lamp crafted from special minerals. Its luminous blue radiance flickers ceaselessly, as if infused with boundless energy that endures through the ages.

name: Pavo Plum Sample
description: A Pavo Plum sample collected near the hot spring. It should come in handy for Bing'ge.
background: Like Pavo Plums found elsewhere, this fruit looks incredibly delicious. However, knowing its taste, you wouldn't be quick to eat it.

name: Activated Chrono Sign
description: While equipped, this allows you to use the Chronopins left by CSC to temporarily slow down time in the surrounding area.
background: Confirming identity, code name: Rover. Top-level access to the Woodveil Hall laboratory granted. May this item guide you to the answers and enlightenment we seek.

name: Zoom Camera
description: Capture moments with a portable camera.
background: Developed by the Pioneer Association, this camera allows its users to capture samples with detailed data in the wild.

name: Ultrasonic Pulse Chip
description: Release a powerful vortex to cleanse muds and the mud shield of Tacet Discords.
background: Developed by Huaxu Academy, this chip can release vortex flow and facilitate researches surrounding the Whining Aix's Mire.

name: Ultrasonic Pulse Chip
description: Release a powerful vortex to cleanse muds and the mud shield of Tacet Discords.
background: Developed by Huaxu Academy, this chip can release vortex flow and facilitate researches surrounding the Whining Aix's Mire.

name: Trace Scale
description: A unique item that unlocks Scale of Past when equipped.
background: A crystal-clear scale that seems to reveal a different world within. It possesses an ability called Chrono Trace, which records surrounding time and space, allowing them to be revisited in the future. It is said to have intricate connections with Sentinel Jué.

name: A player that contains Qianxin's singing voice.
description: After use, it can play the "Dawn Ballad" sung by Qianxin before her voice was damaged.
background: An audio player carefully preserved by Yanzi. It contains only the "Dawn Ballad" sung by Qianxin before she lost her voice. Due to the special nature of Qianxin's Resonance ability, when her voice is played, the residual frequencies of her Resonance can still be activated and provide a slight enhancement to the abilities of others.

name: Stellar Matrix's Core
description: The core of a Stellar Matrix, where records of the key indicators of the Lament are compressed into. Upload it at the Modulation Hall to retrieve the data.
background: If the stars ever cry, they must sound like the wrenching wails stilled in this cosmic relic.

name: "Starlight"
description: A Blake Bloom that symbolizes the supreme authority of the Black Shores, donned by the leader of the organization.
background: She has seen all the stars, journeying to the end of time and space and back. This gleaming star kept her company, a speck of blooming stardust illuminating the night sky and guiding her way home. Listen closely to hear echoes of her prescence.

name: KU-Money's Personal Collection
description: A music player in which the Black Shores merchant KU-Money keeps a playlist of personal favorites.
background: Even a merchant who handles millions every day listens to music to relax. Of course, it's up to you to decide what the value of this music player is.

name: Model HL-1
description: A device used by the Black Shores to monitor the status of each of the Sentinels. This model bears the serial HL-1. The meter reads 0.
background: It is the Black Shores' duty to monitor the Sentinels, who are at the forefront of keeping the Lament and Threnodians at bay—yet it seems some have found ways to evade their surveillance.

name: Tyrvine
description: A blade sealed with the very powers of Sentinel Imperator, and the artifact used to select Their Resonator.
background:
The Sword of Divinity—"Tyrvine."

A blade sealed with the very powers of Sentinel Imperator, and the artifact used to select Their Resonator.

Approach it, and you might hear the faint howling of the wind.

name: Hognis
description: The blade exudes an aura as deep and mysterious as the abyss of the sea.
background:
The Sword of Discord—Hognis.

A blade of unknown origin. According to Cartethyia, it seems to be the key to unraveling the seal in the Inverted Tower.

It exudes an aura as deep and mysterious as the abyss of the sea.

name: Haultir
description: A blade that bears no traces of time.
background:
The Sword of Virtue—Haultir.

This sword once belonging to Cartethyia has now become one of the keys to unraveling the seal.

name: Skyshaker
description: A special firecracker sold at the Fireworks Shop. After equipping this to Utility, you can throw firecrackers to damage enemies. (Only available during the "By Moon's Grace" Event and will be removed from Backpack after the Event ends.)
background: A special firecracker made by following a secret blueprint found in Xisha. Refrain from using this in crowded areas as it is both powerful and loud.

name: The Present
description: A folding fan that Zhezhi painted for you.
background: Zhezhi's painting on this fan captures everything that is beautiful about this moment forever. It is her wish that you will recall this beautiful moment when you see this fan no matter where you are.

name: Skyshaker
description: A special firecracker sold at the Fireworks Shop. After equipping this to Utility, you can throw firecrackers to damage enemies. (Only available during the "By Moon's Grace" Event and will be removed from Backpack after the Event ends.)
background: A special firecracker made by following a secret blueprint found in Xisha. Refrain from using this in crowded areas as it is both powerful and loud.

name: Serenity of Xiehua Village
description: A scroll painting that Zhezhi gave you. This is the first scroll painting she has painted with her Forte in many years. The beautiful scenery depicted in the painting seems to give off a different feeling than before.
background: It is an opportunity for encounters, a testimony of shared experiences, a key that opens hearts, and an unforgettable collaboration.

name: Carlotta's "Gem"
description: Before the battle begins, Carlotta places a handful of crystals in your hands. These are crafted from her Forte, akin to the texture of the bullets she uses in combat. Could there be a hidden message within this gesture?
background:
In the Montelli family, it's common to pass on messages through coded language, gestures, and postures. By handing you her weapon and bullets, Carlotta assures you that you are safe—she has no intention of harming you during the upcoming action. 
Trust her, and follow her lead in this performance.

name: Invitation with a Fragrance
description: An invitation with a faint fragrance. The Montelli family crest embossed in the sealing wax.
background:
The letter not only mentions that "the Carnevale will soon return to Rinascita" but also extends an offer to you: as the recipient, you are granted special status as an esteemed guest of the Montelli family, with access to the funds provided at Averardo Bank.
In a world of advanced technology, sending such an invitation via traditional letter speaks to the sincerity of the sender, highlighting their desire to forge a genuine and lasting connection with the invitee.

name: The Martyrdom of Blessed Fleurdelys - Act III (Unfinished)
description: A play written by the mysterious playwright Cristoforo, telling the story of Fleurdelys, the Blessed Maiden of the Order of the Deep.
background:
A play written by the mysterious playwright Cristoforo, telling the story of Fleurdelys, the Blessed Maiden of the Order of the Deep.
The script, however, is unfinished, leaving the story hanging just before the Maiden's martyrdom.

name: Lycoris with Ominous Aura
description: A withered lycoris, its petals exuding an ominous aura.
background: A withered lycoris, its petals exuding an ominous aura. You feel as if you've encountered a flower like this before...

name: Cloudcaster's Handle
description: The Cloudcaster's handle, once used as a fishing reel by the Troupe member.
background:
The Cloudcaster's handle, once used as a fishing reel by the Troupe member.
It can be assembled with other parts of the Cloudcaster. Collect all the components and go find Roccia for the next step.

name: Cloudcaster's Base
description: The Cloudcaster's base, once used as a desk by the Troupe member for composing music.
background:
The Cloudcaster's base, once used as a desk by the Troupe member for composing music.
It can be assembled with other parts of the Cloudcaster. Collect all the components and go find Roccia for the next step.

name: Cloudcaster's Resonance Unit
description: The Cloudcaster's Resonance Unit, once used to calibrate pitch and rhythm by the Troupe member.
background:
The Cloudcaster's Resonance Unit, once used to calibrate pitch and rhythm by the Troupe member.
It can be assembled with other parts of the Cloudcaster. Collect all the components and go find Roccia for the next step.

name: Codex of the Deep: Preface (137th Edition)
description: A gift from Phoebe. This book introduces the Codex of the Order and explains the basic doctrines and philosophies regarding the Divinites, written in simple terms.
background: A gift from Phoebe. This book introduces the Codex of the Order and explains the basic doctrines and philosophies regarding the Divinites, written in simple terms.

name: Unfettered Dove through Day and Night
description: A custom-made Carnevale mask ordered by Carlotta for you. It draws inspiration from her impressions on you and Abby.
background:
A custom-made Carnevale mask ordered by Carlotta for you. It draws inspiration from her impressions on you and Abby. 
This mask covers half of the face, creating a perfect balance of personality and enigma. Minimal decorations ensure that it remains functional, offering unobstructed vision and mobility during combat.

name: Perfect Curtain Call
description: A photo captured by Fulmine, recording the moment you shared the curtain call with your companions.
background:
A photo captured by Fulmine, recording the moment you shared the curtain call with your companions.
You can zoom in to view the photo.

name: Perfect Curtain Call
description: A photo captured by Fulmine, recording the moment you shared the curtain call with your companions.
background:
A photo captured by Fulmine, recording the moment you shared the curtain call with your companions.
You can zoom in to view the photo.

name: Beacon of the Past
description: Rover: Spectro's skills have been enhanced. Go to Resonators - Forte for more details.
background: A beacon you once set for yourself, imbued with the strength and faith to keep moving forward.

name: Phaom Whistle
description: A whistle Cartethyia taught you how to use. When equipped in Utility, it allows you to summon the Gondola Phaom near water. (Usable only in Avinoleum)
background: A whistle Cartethyia taught you how to use.

name: Crimson Baton
description: Phrolova's baton, imbued with part of her Forte.
background:
A precarious alliance demands deep trust. She handed you her last hope, just to earn a moment of your faith.
Keep it close. Even from afar, a temporarily allied enemy must remain in your grasp.

name: Wilting Reverberation
description: A residual fragment of Phrolova's Forte. Though not nearly as strong as her baton, it remains just sufficient for Orchestrating.
background: As the blade drove through her chest, everything around her fell silent. Her body was flung away, light as a fallen petal. Tears and the blood bloomed into flowers unnoticed. In their midst, a melody whispered, softly and wistfully, of loss and regrets sunken beneath the sea.

name: Quickhack Module
description: A Quickhack module from Lucy. Can be used to hack into the various mechanisms within Somnoire: Night City.
background: A Quickhack module from Lucy. Can be used to hack into the various mechanisms within Somnoire: Night City.

name: Roccia's Gift: Luceanite
description: A gift from Roccia. A gold-striped black stone that shines with a soft brilliance, much like the gentle sparkle in your eyes.
background: A piece of Luceanite washed ashore by the tide. Despite enduring centuries of wind, rain, and the ravages of time, this special Luceanite has retained its sheen. Roccia discovered it, carefully polished it, and kept it safe. After much hesitation, she finally gathered the courage to give it to you.

name: Scattered Petals
description: A few petals likely once part of a wreath. They have since wilted under the harsh sea winds.
background: A few petals found near the Pilgrim's Sail. Likely once part of a wreath, they have since wilted under the harsh sea winds. Their advanced state of decay suggests they've been adrift at sea for a long time.

name: "Star"
description: A clear and sparkling star that shines just like the North Star in Pegasus.
background: During their pilgrimage, everyone gathered around this "star" and sang Pegasus in praise of freedom to encourage one another. Wherever they could laugh freely, that was home.

name: New Student ID
description: A new student ID of Startorch Academy.
background: A brand-new student ID issued upon your admission, symbolizing your identity as an official member of Startorch Academy. Though its design has changed with new patterns, the people and moments from your past remain unchanged, waiting patiently for your return.

name: Admission Letter
description: An admission letter to Startorch Academy in Lahai-Roi, which also serves as an important passport within Lahai-Roi.
background:
An admission letter personally prepared by the Shorekeeper, bearing a permanent authorization.
On it is written: "Synchronist Test passed. Rabelle's Curve fitted. Exostrider adaptability confirmed."

name: Frequency Cassette Recorder
description: A standardized Terminal for the Spacetrek Collective members. Your Rabelle Cassette is stored within.
background: Voices from the past are now overlaid by new memories. As the tape turns, past and future wind into a single reel.

name: Trail of Sunshine
description: A livery gifted by Lynae for your expedition motorbike, in remembrance of your encounter and the battles you weathered together.
background: Carried by the winds of Lahai-Roi, she no longer fears the shadow of her past and now paints her colors freely.

name: Knowledge of the Heliogyre
description: Knowledge the Shaper gleaned from the Heliogyre, enabling you to establish a link with the Solisylum.
background: With your authorization, the Shaper harnesses the full computational strength of the Heliodic Six. Through the luminous stream of data, he perceives the whole truth of Lahai-Roi.

name: Group Photo Under the New Sun
description: A photo of you, Mornye, and Lynae under the New Sun.
background:
A photo of you, Mornye, and Lynae under the New Sun. With the light of Helios, a brighter future reveals before you.

"To freedom. To civilization. To new beginnings."

name: Void Storm Generator
description: A device containing Voidmatter. Can be used to manually induce Void Storms.
background: By storing Voidworm frequency, the device emits Voidmatter within a set radius, generating an artificial Void Storm.

name: Group Photo Under the New Sun
description: A photo of you, Mornye, and Lynae under the New Sun.
background:
A photo of you, Mornye, and Lynae under the New Sun. With the light of Helios, a brighter future reveals before you.

"To freedom. To civilization. To new beginnings."

name: Lucilla's Communicator
description: A communicator given to you by Lucilla. It resembles a makeup mirror.
background: A communicator given to you by Lucilla. Designed in her personal style, this device is well-suited for covert operations.

name: Startorch Academy Dark Side Investigation Report No. AN25360
description: The digital file of Professor Sevi's personal information.
background: The digital file that records Professor Sevi's basic personal information and major achievements.

name: Startorch Prize Medal
description: The Medal of the Startorch Prize established by Startorch Academy.
background: The Medal of the Startorch Prize established by Startorch Academy. It is an honor awarded to researchers who have made significant contributions to the advancement of science for the benefit of humanity.

name: The Rabbit's Bow Tie
description: An accessory worn by the strange rabbit.
background: An accessory worn by the strange rabbit in the Dark Side. This little pet of the Grand Architect is also the root cause of the Dark Side anomaly.

name: Starbright Resonance
description: A crown that casts countless rays of starlight.
background: Rays of starlight and distant sounds are frozen within this crown at this very moment. It is a gift to you—the one who has always watched over them.

name: Stellar Anchor of Memories
description: Use to claim one of the three Resonators: <color=#ffd12f>Shorekeeper, Camellya, Jinhsi</color>, or 8 Transducers.
background: To the waves of the past, I call upon you. Following the tides of memory, you arrive as promised.

name: 5-Star Weapon Supply Chest - Synth Armament
description: Open to claim one of the following weapons: <color=#ffd12f>Laser Shearer, Radiance Cleaver, Phasic Homogenizer, Pulsation Bracer, Boson Astrolabe.</color>
background: A custom weapon supply chest commissioned by the Spacetrek Collective. Inside lies the Synth Armament series, the dream equipment for every Academy student and researcher.

name: Customized Squeezy Jelly
description: According to food safety inspections, each ingredient is entirely ordinary. And yet, together they form a flavor both complex and unexpectedly new.
background: The first taste of it somehow stirs a sense of nostalgia.

name: Old Music Record
description: A salvaged vinyl record. The surface has been meticulously cleaned, yet the scars of time remain plainly visible.
background: Your analysis of its residual frequencies reveals only a short, indistinct hum, as if carrying words that could never quite be spoken aloud.

name: Refreshing Waffle
description: Luuk Herssen has his own improved waffle recipe. His version is lighter and less heavily sweetened than the ones in style at the Academy
background: Dessert-making is a hobby Luuk Herssen took up amid his busy schedule. Creating treats is similar to conducting experiments. Both involve following a prescribed order, which helps him regain a sense of familiarity he once had. Meanwhile, the comfort of cooking connects him to the vibrant realities of life. Of course, not every attempt is a success. But he chose to present his most successful creation to you, for whom he'll share the very life he has experienced.

name: Paper Black Cat
description: A paper black cat gifted to you by Sigrika, a bit crooked, but very much heartfelt.
background: She pressed her feelings into the folds. In each crease is a wordless thank-you.

name: New Solar Celebration Pass
description: An admission pass granting entry to the New Solar Celebration. It also serves as a small keepsake for those who have taken part in the celebration.
background:
The Exostrider poured forth light and heat from its Reactor Drive, sheltering life from the killing frost. Grateful for this gift, the Roya revered the Reactor Drive as their sun. They took it upon themselves to gather the Exostrider's "cells," making this quiet labor the duty of their tribe.
Now, their ancient vow is complete. As the new sun rises, they hold the New Solar Celebration, both to mark the renewal and to remind their kin of the purpose that set them on this path.

name: Key to the Petri Dish
description: A strange-looking key that seems like it can fit into a certain keyhole.
background: Hé Civilization Designed Key

name: Key to the Rock Ruins
description: A strange-looking key that seems like it can fit into a certain keyhole.
background: Hé Civilization Designed Key

name: A beautiful necklace.
description: A necklace that looks very valuable.
background: A necklace found in the snow.

name: The gem on the necklace.
description: The gem on the necklace pendant, which seems to be inlaid somewhere.
background: The gem obtained after the necklace was destroyed.
