name: Ashen Dream
description: An item obtained from defeating Scar in Somnoire.
background:
"I don't want to be your enemy, nor do I actually plan to destroy anything.
Let me make it clear for you: destruction is not my end goal. It's not even a matter of anyone's desires, but an inevitable conclusion.
Embrace IT. You will come to realize that resistance is futile."

name: Dream of Chaos
description: An item obtained from defeating Dreamless in Somnoire.
background:
Sweet dreams, bad dreams, ordinary dreams, heroic dreams, empty dreams...
Dreams that collide and fuse before dissipating like foams. At the point of impact, a hazy shadow appears—a projection of the anticipation and premonitions intertwined within...

name: The Unworthy Dreams
description: An item obtained from clearing the Nonexistent Dream.
background:
A young woman dreams of the vibrant garden back in her hometown.
An elderly man envisions pouring tea for his late wife, just as he did in their early days together.
Yet IT claims these dreams are worthless, devoid of meaning.
Do you also agree that they should be erased?

name: Dream Imprint
description: An old-style detective's hat, often a symbol of the protagonist in classic mysteries.
background:
"No matter how late you show up, you're a detective.
Everything leaves a trace and a detective must pursue it without end."
The story is far from over. Someone deep within the Somnoire has entrusted this to you, awaiting the day the story reaches its end.

name: Denia's Birthday Cake
description: A celebratory cake from the Spacetrek Collective. Don't worry—it's 100% free of food security issues.
background: An exquisitely crafted orange cake. At Denia's request, the top is encrusted with an array of weird hard candies and dried fruits... leaving one to wonder exactly what kind of flavor profile it has.

name: Denia's Birthday Memento
description: A group photo from Denia's birthday, capturing a side of her rarely seen in the day-to-day: unbridled vitality and passion.
background:
To her, a day as calm and gentle as this is reason enough to celebrate.
So she chooses to spend it with her dearest friends.

name: Denia's Birthday Memento
description: A group photo from Denia's birthday, capturing a side of her rarely seen in the day-to-day: unbridled vitality and passion.
background:
To her, a day as calm and gentle as this is reason enough to celebrate.
So she chooses to spend it with her dearest friends.

name: Photo of the Exhibition Hall Central Area
description: "Key" to the Exhibition Hall Central Area.
background: A backdoor Lucilla crafted for herself using her power. Very few know how to use it correctly.

name: Photo of the Old Research Institute
description: "Key" to the old Research Institute.
background: A photograph taken while the old Institute was still operational. For its owner, it serves as a memento—the unpleasant kind.

name: Antivoid Material Lab Keepsake Photo
description: "Key" to the Antivoid Material Lab.
background: A photo taken before a certain individual left the lab. For some reason, they didn't take it with them, choosing instead to carry away something far more precious.

name: "Exit" Key
description: "Key" to the Exit of Lucilla's Memory Palace.
background: A "key" marked with the exit of Lucilla's Memory Palace. To escape the shackles of memory, one must first put them on.

name: Damaged Photo of Student Dorm
description: "Key" to a Student Dorm.
background: A photo of an ordinary student dorm. The paper appears to have been gripped tightly, leaving the surface creased and mottled.

name: Yellowed Photo of Student Dorm
description: "Key" to a Student Dorm.
background: A photo of an ordinary student dorm. The image was captured slightly out of focus.

name: "Classroom" Photo
description: "Key" to a "Classroom."
background: A place of passage for countless students and teachers, where innumerable memories overlap. A "classroom" that exists only in memory.

name: Visitor Pass
description: A visitor pass for the gate at the market. The image on it depicts a tale from the past about admiration and misunderstanding.
background: A visitor pass for the gate at the market. The image on it depicts a tale from the past about admiration and misunderstanding.

name: "All Eyes On You"
description: A gift from President Lucilla. Lucy left it in Solaris when she woke from the dream that surprised her.
background: Memory may fade, but this cross-realm friendship will keep its colors.

name: "All Eyes On You"
description: A gift from President Lucilla. Lucy left it in Solaris when she woke from the dream that surprised her.
background: Memory may fade, but this cross-realm friendship will keep its colors.

name: Chat Screenshot
description: A screenshot of a chat with Lucilla. It may be the key to reaching the rendezvous point.
background: Don't get yourself lost in a memory, Rover.

name: Travel Snapshot
description: A photo Lucilla took of you in the Memory Palace. Just a keepsake.
background: Someone really isn't that photogenic.

name: Travel Snapshot
description: A photo Lucilla took of you in the Memory Palace. Just a keepsake.
background: Someone really isn't that photogenic.

name: "Untitled 18 - Brancesi, 2021"
description: A painting from another world. Is it a real piece? Hell knows.
background: At least you can't sell it repeatedly to get the dough in this world.

name: Treasure Map to Sword of Courage
description: A treasure map bearing the location of the Sword of Courage. With the help of the map, one can find the Sword of Courage.
background:
A map painted on wood, showing where the Sword of Courage can be found.
This is a gift given to Ying by Ying's mother before she passed away, which embodies the unspoken agreement between a mother and a daughter, whether the fabled gateway of wishes is real or not.

name: Wreath of Hope
description: A wreath woven from the feelings of the Wooly Adventure Squad. It marks the beginning of a new leg of the journey.
background:
A wreath infused with the myriad feelings and emotions you and your friends have experienced along the way. The sight of this wreath gives you the strength to forge ahead.
You and the girl who suggested making this wreath have made a pact: Stories are an extension of life. You'll never run out of them, if you're adventurous enough. There will always be more adventures to be had, and more stories to be told.

name: Benett's Terminal
description: The Reserved Terminal owned by Benett, a deceased member of the Montelli family. It is severely damaged, with components missing or broken.
background: Once repaired by a technician, it can provide information about the movements of its previous owner. However, further repairs are required to unlock more data. Though the deceased cannot speak, this Terminal serves as his voice. Complete the restoration to uncover the mystery—those covered data may hold the key to the truth you seek.

name: Cat's Eye Brooch
description: A Cat's Eye brooch from Carlotta, reflecting your golden eyes—also a personal token from her.
background: In Montelli, each member has an item corresponding to their code name. Carlotta might begin preparing this gift for you from the very moment she was captivated by your golden eyes and offered you the code name "Cat's Eye." Although you don't intend to officially join Montelli, you know that she will forever keep this code name for you—Cat's Eye, the first and only member to receive Opal's personal invitation.

name: Aemeath's Cassette
description: The cassette Aemeath once used, still bearing a sticker that was unmistakably hers.
background:
The cassette Aemeath used during her Academy days, still bearing a sticker that was unmistakably hers.
She had left many traces throughout Lahai-Roi. This serves as proof that she existed.
Back in Voidspace, she pushed it toward you... What was it she was trying to say?

name: Rune of "Seek"
description: A rune Sigrika carved for you.
background:
A rune Sigrika carved for you. You can feel the warmth of its power flowing gently through your palm.
It can help you perceive the Royan rune fragments scattered throughout Lahai-Roi and restore them to their original form.
But who was it, and by what means, that used the Royan runes to etch those scattered messages across the plains?

name: Origami Construct
description:
An Origami Construct prepared by Hiyuki. It carries a trace of her frequency and can produce a freezing effect to aid Spacetrek operations in the Dimmr Plains.

Despite its hastily made, somewhat unrefined appearance, it is absolutely reliable.
background: An Origami Construct provided by the Spacetrek Collective.

name: Plushie Village Restoration Log: I
description: The Plushie Village restoration records.
background: A proof of the efforts made in restoring the Plushie Village alongside your Plushie friends. Continue collecting Sonance Caskets to further restore the village's power, bringing more plusheis into this warm and lively home.

name: Plushies' Photo
description: A group photo of Plushies, accidentally discovered within a morph painting.
background: A group photo from the past, capturing the feeling that never fades.

name: Plushie Village Restoration Log: Final
description: The last commemorative item earned from restoring the Plushie Village.
background: A proof of the efforts made in restoring the Plushie Village alongside your Plushie friends. It represents the cherished memories you share with your Plushie companions—"No one needs you, but I do; no one accepts who you are, but I do."

name: Bell of Resonance
description: A special item obtained after fully restoring the Plushie Village.
background: A bell said to resonate with others, no matter the distance.

name: Plushie Village Restoration Log: II
description: The Plushie Village restoration records.
background: A proof of the efforts made in restoring the Plushie Village alongside your Plushie friends. Continue collecting Sonance Caskets to further restore the village's power, bringing more plusheis into this warm and lively home.

name: Plushie Village Restoration Log: III
description: The Plushie Village restoration records.
background: A proof of the efforts made in restoring the Plushie Village alongside your Plushie friends. Continue collecting Sonance Caskets to further restore the village's power, bringing more plusheis into this warm and lively home.

name: "Script"
description: A play script given by Phrolova.
background:
A script telling a story. It updates its contents as the plot progresses.
Every actor has their assigned role, and all stories unfold exactly as written, unless...

name: Champion's Medal
description: A medal awarded to the winner of Septimont's Agon of Champions.
background:
A medal split in two. Lupa wears the other half. 
It's a testament to the applause you've earned in the City of Glory and the symbol of the triumph you've achieved side by side.

name: Her Oath
description: A fleeting trace in memory, one that belongs to Lupa for your journey in the City of Septimont.
background: The journey has come to an end. Her oath remains steadfast and sincere.

name: Her Wishes
description: A fleeting trace in memory, one that belongs to Cartethyia for your journey in the City of Septimont.
background: The journey has come to an end. Her three wishes have now all come true.

name: Copper Mirror of Truth
description: A copper mirror given by Buling.
background:
An old copper mirror, simply crafted, with a fox-shaped tassel at its tail.
In the tales of Huanglong, mirrors are said to reveal hidden truths, and in certain hands, even legends may reflect reality.

name: Orchestration Movement I
description: Phrolova composed this melody upon the founding of the Fabricatorium. She blended the music of her past into it, wishing that those dear and near to her might one day play it in the real world.
background: Incomplete sheet music, part of the core melody regulating the Fabricatorium of the Deep.

name: Orchestration Movement II
description: Phrolova composed this melody upon the founding of the Fabricatorium. She blended the music of her past into it, wishing that those dear and near to her might one day play it in the real world.
background: Incomplete sheet music, part of the core melody regulating the Fabricatorium of the Deep.

name: Orchestration Movement III
description: Phrolova composed this melody upon the founding of the Fabricatorium. She blended the music of her past into it, wishing that those dear and near to her might one day play it in the real world.
background: Incomplete sheet music, part of the core melody regulating the Fabricatorium of the Deep.

name: Sacred Salt
description: An item that Butler the Steward of the Order at the Supply Station is collecting and willing to trade for.
background: To the Acolytes, Sacred Salt has the ability to cleanse anything untouched by the Sentinel's grace. With its purifying power, sliced bread turns into the Divinity's nurturing meal, ordinary wine becomes holy blood that grants enlightenment...
source: Fabricatorium of the Deep Exploration Progress Reward

name: Pilgrim's Scriptures
description: A book given to you by the Acolyte of the Sanctuary of Faith.
background: According to Acolyte Confere, this book offers the most comprehensive documentation of rites performed by the most devout of the Order. It may be worth studying.

name: Petals for Rosebearer
description: Petals symbolizing honor and triumph.
background:
At the height of the celebration, petals will shower down as everyone rejoices.
Beneath this rain of petals, people who fought side by side will share honey and wine. Such is a true moment of joy for the Septimontians.
To receive petals from the Rosebearer is an honor. And to bestow them? Just as great a privilege.

name: Pure Dark Tide Frequency
description: A pure reverberation from the Dark Tide of the past.
background:
Pure and silent, this frequency has slumbered long enough to leave no ripples. As the firstborn of the Dark Tide, it carries the ancient will of its mother. Undeniably powerful yet defiant, it betrayed its creator in the abyss and now sleeps alone in the dark realm.
Only the sweet Resonance can stir its dreamless sleep… and awaken its long-forgotten hunger.

name: Peso's Challenge Note
description: A note found behind the waterfall near the Three Heroes' Crest. Use to view details.
background: "It's located beside the House of Prophecy, beneath the Hornett."

name: A Debt Note
description: A scrap of paper retrieved from a fallen Gladiator.
background: Fictro owes Nolon his life for scribbling on his shield and needs to keep it safe until the hunt ends.

name: A Reply Letter
description: A scrap of paper retrieved from a fallen Gladiator.
background: Why buy such an expensive helmet? And it doesn't even fit! Return it!

name: An Unsent Note
description: A scrap of paper retrieved from a fallen Gladiator.
background: Thanks for the gift. Works like a charm. Still not ready to forgive you.

name: A Challenge Letter
description: A scrap of paper retrieved from a fallen Gladiator.
background: Round Ten. Let's see who makes it to the Wastelands first, Fictro.

name: Anchor Stone Fragment
description: A shattered piece of an Anchor Stone.
background:
A shattered piece of an Anchor Stone, still emitting the force field as ever.
"Let this small thing pry open the cracks in fate's door."

name: Imperator's Relic
description: A relic that Sentinel Imperator left you.
background: This relic from Sentinel Imperator has been sealed in the Earthrend Wedge, waiting silently for the destined hand. As your fingers lightly tap on its surface, a gentle wind whispers past your ear, carrying with it an unspoken tenderness from realms beyond the farthest horizon.

name: Invitation Letter from Ephor's Palace
description: A handwritten invitation from Augusta herself.
background:
You feel lingering warmth on the envelope as you unfold the letter:

To Our Distinguished Guest from Afar,

I hope your stay in Septimont has been pleasant. Though we never met again after the Great Agon's Final, your deeds have already stirred fresh winds through our halls. Even from mere fragments of conversation, I know your arrival has breathed new life into our city.

While formalities were never Septimont's tradition, I must apologize for missing our appointed meeting. No excuse justifies such neglect toward a Champion of Septimont. Now, with preparations complete and sunrise approaching, I too await the dawn.

Should this invitation still find favor with you, I would be honored by your presence at Ephor's Palace. I await your coming with humble anticipation.

Augusta

name: Lunarum Bracelet
description: A bracelet given to you by Iuno.
background: This bracelet has been with Iuno ever since she became a Priestess. Forged from lunarum and adorned with sprout motifs, it is not only a keepsake, but a quiet witness to her journey. Now, she entrusts it to you as a medium of Anchoring so you may draw upon her strength to reveal the Dark Tide creations.

name: Old Anchor Stone
description: An Anchor Stone that looks a bit worn.
background:
A type of small device manufactured with Tacetite formed around the Earthrend Wedge. It provides energy to Anchor Obelisks, which in turn amplify its frequency to repel the Dark Tide and its creations.
During the hunts, Gladiators of Septimont strategically set up Anchor Obelisks carrying Anchor Stones at critical locations across Maroonwood, the main battlefield. These devices help them drive the Dark Tide and its creations toward the base of the Earthrend Wedge, where they are eliminated. The strategy has proven highly effective in preventing the Dark Tide's spread beyond the Earthrend Wedge's containment.

name: Together in the Petal Rain
description: Bruno happened to capture this moment at the height of the celebration.
background: She has preserved many such memories in this way to guard against the fading blur brought on by her Anchoring ability. Those photos have blurred in the eyes of those who no longer recall her. But… this one marks a beginning. Moonlight pours down, filling the quiet void. For the first time, the present belongs to both of you.

name: Together in the Petal Rain
description: Bruno happened to capture this moment at the height of the celebration.
background: She has preserved many such memories in this way to guard against the fading blur brought on by her Anchoring ability. Those photos have blurred in the eyes of those who no longer recall her. But… this one marks a beginning. Moonlight pours down, filling the quiet void. For the first time, the present belongs to both of you.

name: Lunarum Bracelet
description: A bracelet given to you by Iuno, once again.
background: You tried to return it to her. Yet, in time, it found its way back to you. To wear it or keep it safe, the choice is yours, and in that choice lies her trust. But this time, it means something more. No longer merely a relic of her long and lonely journey, it has become proof that you reached out and drew the moon to your side. She Anchored the world, and you, with this, have Anchored her.

name: Cloth of the Unyielding
description: The frequency lingering on the cloth still echoes the battles of old.
background:
A scrap of fabric imbued with the unyielding will of its former owner, a warrior who stood fearless against the Dark Tide.
Bathed in the Dark Tide, the Gladiator faced death without hesitation. Crimson blood long stained the cloth that bound his wounds. He fought. He bled. He rose. He fought again. Until death came, but never conquered.

name: "Dawn of Home"
description: A finely crafted toy of unknown material. It emits a faint but warm frequency.
background:
A token of your successful completion of all the challenges in "Dreams of Cindertide: Septimont." A tribute to the long-awaited Hero of the Heroes from their loyal warriors.
It emits a faint but warm frequency, though its true purpose remains uncertain.
"The cherished homeland of mine... I wonder if flowers begin to bloom there once more?"

name: Lollo Logistics Delivery Box
description: A misplaced delivery box.
background: A box with an "Items Insured" label affixed to the side. What valuables could be inside?

name: Skyscribe Armillary
description: A portable device issued by Xuanfang's Ministry of War, capable of syncing frequency data with Skywatch Rings.
background: A portable device made to synchronize seamlessly with Skywatch Rings in real time. Xuanfang Wardens rely on it to monitor and log the Autopuppets' patrol routes. When calibrated with the proper data, it can also be deployed to hunt down specific frequencies.

name: Yangyang's Letter
description: A letter from Yangyang.
background: A letter from Yangyang. Ever since your journey began, the two of you have kept in touch through letters, sharing the latest twists and turns in each other's lives.

name: Spirit Pendant
description: A jade pendant from Suisui.
background: A jade pendant gifted by Suisui, one of a matching pair. Rigged with a hidden tracking function, the set allows each bearer to keep tabs on the other's condition.

name: Letter of Reply
description: Your letter to Yangyang.
background: Your reply to Yangyang's letter. Exchanging letters with her has become an indispensable part of your journey.

name: Unfinished Letter
description: A letter written by Yangyang in the Land of Xuanfang.
background: A letter penned by Yangyang while she sojourned in the Land of Xuanfang. She never truly expected it would find its way to you, but when feelings run deep and longing knows no bounds, even a miracle can become the destiny.

name: Skyscribe Armillary
description: A portable device issued by Xuanfang's Ministry of War, capable of syncing frequency data with Skywatch Rings.
background: A portable device made to synchronize seamlessly with Skywatch Rings in real time. Xuanfang Wardens rely on it to monitor and log the Autopuppets' patrol routes. When calibrated with the proper data, it can also be deployed to hunt down specific frequencies.

name: Unfinished Letter
description: A letter written by Yangyang in the Land of Xuanfang.
background: A letter penned by Yangyang while she sojourned in the Land of Xuanfang. She never truly expected it would find its way to you, but when feelings run deep and longing knows no bounds, even a miracle can become the destiny.

name: Fox Mask
description: A fox mask, presumably dropped by the suspect who stole the Sentinel's Token.
background: A fox mask, presumably dropped by the suspect who stole the Sentinel's Token.

name: Unique Climber Shoot
description: A Climber Shoot discovered by you and the Fillet Fairmaiden inside an abandoned wooden mechanism out in the wilderness.
background: Growing from cracks in mechanisms, this uniquely textured Climber Shoot is essential for cooking Immortal's Medley.

name: Undelivered Letter of Confession
description: A confession letter Jiuwu wrote to Sonija, attached with several drafts.
background: A confession letter to Sonija, bearing the marks of countless erasures and revisions. The final draft was never sent out due to a lack of determination.

name: Heavy Gift
description: A token of gratitude from the patients of Xuanfang Hold to Baizhi.
background:
A token of gratitude from the patients of Xuanfang Hold to Baizhi. It is wrapped meticulously in multiple layers, hefty to hold, as if the senders feared their heartfelt intentions might not fully come through. You do not know what is hidden inside, nor whether it matches the package you received. But you know that within its weight lies a profound depth of blessings and appreciation.
Deep down, you know Baizhi will surely treasure it.

name: Donation Certificate I
description: A card issued by Jianji to the donors, which can be presented to Jianji to claim dividends.
background: A strange data card. It is said that the encryption key stored within can prove the holder has made a financial donation.

name: Donation Certificate II
description: A card issued by Jianji to the donors, which can be presented to Jianji to claim dividends.
background: A strange data card. It is said that the encryption key stored within can prove the holder has made a financial donation.

name: Donation Certificate III
description: A card issued by Jianji to the donors, which can be presented to Jianji to claim dividends.
background: A strange data card. It is said that the encryption key stored within can prove the holder has made a financial donation.

name: Retreat Ward Medicine
description: A standard medication prescribed by the Retreat Ward for basic medical care and injury recovery.
background: A standard medication prescribed by the Retreat Ward for basic medical care and injury recovery.

name: Friends as Ever
description: The photo that Duzhou always carries. In it are three people in Xuanfang Warden garb, laughing and embracing each other. At the bottom are written their names: Duzhou, Yanlang, and Mingyu.
background: The photo that Duzhou always carries. In it are three people in Xuanfang Warden garb, laughing and embracing each other. At the bottom are written their names: Duzhou, Yanlang, and Mingyu.

name: Jade Upon the Ripples
description: Upon the blue waters, the reflections of you and Danjin ripple softly. This precious moment will remain forever etched in both of your memories.
background: The pain of losing her family left a lasting stain on the girl's jade pendant and her heart. Though she struck out countless times, her blade could never cleave her nightmares, only carving the trauma deeper into her mind. Fortunately, the bond once broken has been mended by the warmth of companionship. That heartfelt devotion has finally chased away the haunting mists of her suffering. Now, the girl smiles again—as soft as wind dancing across clear waters, as bright as jade regaining its luster.

name: Jade Upon the Ripples
description: Upon the blue waters, the reflections of you and Danjin ripple softly. This precious moment will remain forever etched in both of your memories.
background: The pain of losing her family left a lasting stain on the girl's jade pendant and her heart. Now, the girl smiles again—as soft as wind dancing across clear waters, as bright as jade regaining its luster.

name: Chamber Data
description: Data gathered across Fogveil Pagoda, required to unlock the path to the Fogveil Pivot.
background: A modular part containing the Chamber Data. There are three such pieces in total, each storing data for the Chamber, the Lockpit, and the Purging Mill respectively. Only by gathering all three can the path to the Fogveil Pivot be opened.

name: Lockpit Data
description: Data gathered across Fogveil Pagoda, required to unlock the path to the Fogveil Pivot.
background: A modular part containing the Lockpit Data. There are three such pieces in total, each storing data for the Chamber, the Lockpit, and the Purging Mill respectively. Only by gathering all three can the path to the Fogveil Pivot be opened.

name: Purging Mill Data
description: Data gathered across Fogveil Pagoda, required to unlock the path to the Fogveil Pivot.
background: A modular part containing the Purging Mill Data. There are three such pieces in total, each storing data for the Chamber, the Lockpit, and the Purging Mill respectively. Only by gathering all three can the path to the Fogveil Pivot be opened.

name: Loneliness of the Deep Sea
description: A toy made from unknown materials, capable of detecting weak but warm frequencies.
background:
A token of your successful completion of all the challenges in "Dream Patrol: Ragunna," a gift to you, who remains as warm as ever in the depths of the deep sea.
A delicate glass bottle containing a miniature landscape that emits weak but warm frequencies. Yet, its true purpose remains uncertain.
"The warm Rinascita, where the sun shines blazingly and the water ripples tenderly."

name: Glacio Eroded Coin
description:
Increases Glacio DMG by 20%.

This Token has unlimited uses in Whimpering Wastes.
background: Relics from the shipwrecks of merchants, pilgrims, and pirates. These eroded coins stand as the last witnesses to their stories.
source: Obtained in Tutorial Quest "Ocean Is a Soul's Rest."

name: Fusion Eroded Coin
description:
Increases Fusion DMG by 20%.

This Token has unlimited uses in Whimpering Wastes.
background: Relics from the shipwrecks of merchants, pilgrims, and pirates. These eroded coins stand as the last witnesses to their stories.

description:
Increases Electro DMG by 20%.

This Token has unlimited uses in Whimpering Wastes.

description:

This Token has unlimited uses in Whimpering Wastes.

name: Judgment Lost Flag
description:
After casting Intro Skill, increases Crit. DMG of all Resonators in the team by 40% for 15s.

This Token has unlimited uses in Whimpering Wastes.
background: A flag used by ships transporting prisoners between islands.

name: Sermon Lost Flag
description:
Every time a Resonator deals Basic Attack DMG, their next Basic Attack DMG is Amplified by 4% for 15s, stacking up to 5 times.

This Token has unlimited uses in Whimpering Wastes.
background: A flag used by ships transporting Acolytes from the Order between islands.

name: Merchant Lost Flag
background: A flag used by merchant ships conducting commerce between islands.

name: Hunting Lost Flag
description:
Every time a Resonator deals damage, their next Heavy Attack DMG is Amplified by 4% for 15s, stacking up to 5 times.

This Token has unlimited uses in Whimpering Wastes.
background: A flag used by pirate ships hiding within the sea mist.

name: Assistance: Rare Pact
description:
Summons an Echo to support you in combat. It does not take damage from the Resonators.

This Token has unlimited uses in Whimpering Wastes.
background: A strange pact and its accompanying Echo, offered by an unnamed lady. It recreates fragments of the Sentinel's divine miracles in a mysterious way.

name: Development Rare Pact
background: An amazing device paired with its detailed instruction manual brought from distant shores. It vanished without a trace after being auctioned off to a mysterious magnate.

name: Pioneer Captain's Seal
background: The seal of a captain whose settler ship foundered within sight of its new homeland. The captain ordered those onboard to save themselves, while he himself gripped the helm and vanished into the deep with his cherished ship.

name: Plunderer Captain's Seal
description:
Recovers 3% of the Resonator's HP per second and deals 600% Electro DMG to nearby targets upon the sixth HP recovery.

This Token can be used up to <color=#fee388>2</color> times in Whimpering Wastes.
background: A pirate ship wandering in the mist, known for instilling everlasting fear with the simplest tricks.

name: Betrayer Captain's Seal
background: A ship, wrecked in the struggle for its seal. Treachery set its sail ablaze, toppled its masts, and left nothing but this seal.

name: Absolver Captain's Seal
description:
After casting Resonance Liberation, increases Basic Attack Crit. DMG of all Resonators in the team by 40% for 15s and reduces their Resonance Skill cooldown by 10s.

This Token can be used up to <color=#fee388>2</color> times in Whimpering Wastes.
background: A ship of the Order Tribunal, often found cruising the sea. It always arrives in time to "mediate" conflicts. They may have "absolved" the guilty, but others never "absolve" them.

name: Pilgrim Captain's Seal
description:
Each time casting Resonance Skill reduces Resonance Liberation cooldown by 20% and recovers Resonance Energy by 20%. This effect has a cooldown of 3s.

This Token can be used up to <color=#fee388>2</color> times in Whimpering Wastes.
background: Everyone celebrates its departure; no one anticipates its return.

name: Reveler Captain's Seal
description:
Amplifies all Attribute DMG by 25%.

This Token can be used up to <color=#fee388>2</color> times in Whimpering Wastes.
background: Evil sank their ship, trying to stifle their joy. Instead, they turned their last moments into a fiery celebration, singing and dancing atop the blazing sea.

name: The Gospel that Receives Harmonized Praise
description:

background: You've now mastered every fishing technique. Now put your skills to the test. Reel in that whale!

description: A scripture fragment obtained by chance, used to enhance Phoebe's Fishing Ability, add Request slots, and lower Request consumption.
background: "Hooves churn the sea as the fish's tail thrashes the foam."

name: Fragment of a Mysterious Scripture: Chapter Two
description: A scripture fragment obtained by chance, used to enhance Phoebe's Fishing Ability, and increase hull Durability.
background: "...Let it be known—on tranquil waters, no sailor reigns supreme."

name: Fragment of a Mysterious Scripture: Chapter Three
description: A scripture fragment obtained by chance, used to enhance Phoebe's Fishing Ability, and increase the probability of obtaining Mutants.
background: "Avenge... for the divine... and for yourself."

name: Rusty Iron Case
description: An iron case discovered in a shipwreck in the waters of the Riccioli Islands. Open it to claim mysterious rewards.
background: Don't just discard rusty iron cases, as they might contain hidden treasures. And if not, they still make a formidable melee weapon!

name: Melody Box
description: A crafted collection of recorded music, which, when given to the Aria Mummer, adds the tracks to their collection list.
background: A cherished item among the Rinascita people, it is said to hold music within, crafted by skilled artisans. However, due to internal damage, it no longer fulfills its original purpose.

name: Amber Key
description: An amber key that seemingly holds the secret to unlocking a treasure chest.
background: "It looks like a chunk of amber. Its color is quite beautiful. Let's take it and head to the next isle."

name: Captain's Chart
description: A chart worth "a whole coin," carrying a hidden story, a big adventure, and... a person's untold life.
background: "If we want something from the sea, we have to offer something in return."

name: Half A Lucky Coin
description: A lucky coin discovered while gutting a fish, bearing the mark of Captain Drake. Unfortunately, it's only a half.
background: According to the crew, this coin might point the way to a hidden treasure...

name: Lucky Coin
description: A whole coin. The map it reveals points the way to Captain Drake's treasure under the moonlight.
background: With the coin complete, the path to treasure lies ahead. The course is set, ready to sail!

name: Potion Vial
description:
A potion vial that Cantarella carries with her all the time. Its body is adorned with a sapphire that represents the family head's authority.

To a Fisalia like her, what's stored inside is more than just potion but her very essence: her trust, her emotions, and her soul...
background:
A token from Cantarella. This vial holds a potion she specially crafted for you. Its delicate, calming fragrance works to soothe your mind. She has noticed your specialty, the burdens you carry, and the efforts you put forth. In her kindness, she hopes this potion brings you a peaceful slumber wherever you are.

This vial also contains her deepest sincerity and affection for you. It grants its owner unrestricted access to Porto-Veno Castle. All of Fisalias' elixirs, secrets, and resources... are yours to claim.

name: Fortified Flour
description: Material needed for a Lollo Errand.
background: Flour with enriched nutrients sold in the Gondola Market, which fuels the body and satiates hunger.

name: Margherita's Gift of Milk
description: A material used for Cooking.
background: A natural dairy product, not only suitable for direct drinking, but also can provide a unique milk flavor for the dish.

name: Margherita's Gift of Flour
description: A material used for Cooking.
background: Food made from ground wheat, rich in starch, often used for making staple food.

name: Cartethyia's Pendant
description: A pendant once worn close to Cartethyia's heart. It seems she left a message within. Since her frequency still lingers within you, resonating with the pendant may reveal her message.
background: {PlayerName}, trust her. And trust me... Everything we've done... is to... defeat... Leviathan...

name: A Manuscript of Golden Anthem
description: A manuscript of Golden Anthem, transcribed by Cristoforo.
background: A manuscript from the Golden Anthem Poets Society preserving their poems and musical compositions, transcribed by Cristoforo.

name: A Lithograph With the Sentinel's True Form
description: A lithograph etched with Sentinal Imperator's true form.
background: A lithograph carved with Sentinal Imperator's true form. Members of the Poets Society concealed it in Egla Town, assuming it was a relic left by the ancient Rinascitans.

name: Verses and Rhythms
description: A sheet music book gifted by Ciaccona, preserving every melody she recorded on her travels.
background: A sheet music book gifted by Ciaccona, preserving every melody she recorded on her travels. With her Forte, she can bring the stories behind the music back to life.

name: Photo from Fa the Soliskin I
description: A photo Matthew left for the Soliskin.
background: The red wasteland lay silent, like a seabed after the tide had withdrawn. The wind lingered, echoing endlessly across the surface. If Fa recalls correctly, this was where they first met Matthew. He was holding that strange object in his hands, which, with a single gentle pluck, let sound bloom into the night, bright and tender. It was here that the Soliskin learned how to enjoy music for the first time, and the photo quietly preserved that moment of first encounter.

name: Photo from Fa the Soliskin II
description: A photo Matthew left for the Soliskin.
background: Water cascaded down the rock face, scattering into a fine mist that shimmered softly in the air. If Fa recalls correctly, they practiced playing the music here again and again with Matthew. When they finally succeeded, the melody carried them forward like flowing water. The color of "Mi" softened into green, and the photograph retained the memory of wind and water entwined, a light that still trembles gently, like dew on a blade of grass.

name: Photo from Fa the Soliskin III
description: A photo Matthew left for the Soliskin.
background: A massive metal ring caught the light, its curves reflecting a warm, muted glow. Beyond it, the plains stood in silence. If Fa recalls correctly, it was here that Matthew taught them to recover the beat with their own steps. The bass drifted like the wind across open ground, rhythm lighting up within the Soliskin themselves. The photo preserves that moment when rhythm was rejoined, a faint tremor lingering in the sunlight.

name: Restored "Music Sheet"
description: A "music sheet" marked with the notes restored by the Soliskin.
background: Beginning, climax, finale... red, yellow, and green marks rest quietly in order, forming a complete score. These colors once drifted separately, carried by wind, water, and light. until they return to a single melody. It is a song they completed together. And it remains, even now, a gentle echo that the Soliskin still remember.

name: Token of Radiance
description: A badge earned by completing the challenges of Peaks of Prestige. Can be used to redeem rewards in Radiant Selection.
background: A badge that represents the spirit of the duel. Furius hopes it sparks the fire within challengers during their fights and drives them to seek true glory.

name: Prestige Point
description: Frequency data collected from fights in Peaks of Prestige. Used to unlock or enhance special Echoes exclusive to the event.
background: Echoes from Peaks of Prestige can't be enhanced using Sealed Tubes or processed in Data Bank. Instead, players must use Frequency data called "Prestige Points" to unlock or enhance them.

name: Duel Resonance
description: A stored memory of your battles in Peaks of Prestige. Used to increase your level in the event.
background: Using the Terminal's built-in recorder, Duelists can review every match they've fought. For those who want to improve, studying past duels is essential.

name: Fame Flag
description: A virtual flag that marks your victories in Peaks of Prestige. It stands as a symbol of fame and unmatched skill.
background: While Duelists don't fight like Gladiators, they share the same goal: to claim victory and glory in the heat of battle.

name: Token of Radiance: Lahai-Roi
description: A badge earned by completing the challenges of Peaks of Prestige in Lahai-Roi. Can be used to redeem rewards.
background: A badge earned by completing the challenges of Peaks of Prestige in Lahai-Roi. Can be used to redeem rewards.

name: Prestige Point: Lahai-Roi
description: Frequency data collected from fights in Peaks of Prestige. Used to unlock special Echoes exclusive to the event. Can only be used in Lahai-Roi.
background: Duelists use specialized Frequency data called Prestige Points to unlock their Echoes. As the Peaks of Prestige version in Lahai-Roi differs from the one in Septimont, Prestige Points earned in Septimont cannot be used in Lahai-Roi.

name: Lahai-Roi Rank Point
description: Points earned from defeating opponents in the Peaks of Prestige Lahai-Roi Ranked Tornament. Used to increase your rank in Lahai-Roi.
background: So far, the success of Peaks of Prestige in Lahai-Roi has surpassed even Furius's wildest dreams. Many qualified duelists have gathered in Lahai-Roi, all competing for the coveted title of Division Champion, making Rank Points the most sought-after prize of all.

name: Dhalifa's Forte Evaluation Report
description: Use to view information
background: During Dhalifa's pre-admission physical, researchers questioned her Resonance abilities, especially how she alone survived a Void Storm. The incident drew no small amount of attention at the time, but in the end, everyone agreed it was only a miracle no one could replicate.

name: Dhalifa's Cherished Item
description: Use to view information
background: Dhalifa's childhood, the first chapter of her story.

name: Silk with Names
description: Use to view information
background: On the day Dhalifa was discharged, Sephira could not hold back her tears. Holding this length of silk, she crossed out Dhalifa's name right before her eyes.

name: The Genesis of the Twin Nova Project: A Developmental Retrospective (Excerpt)
description: Use to view information
background: At the Institute, discussions about the Twin Nova series combat mechs never seem to die down. Their development and their elegant combat maneuvers remain a favorite topic among researchers.

name: The Genesis of the Spacetrek Explorer Project: A Developmental Retrospective (Excerpt)
description: Use to view information
background: Massive wheels, an intimidating cannon, and blistering speed. Students passionate about motorbike racing love challenging the Spacetrek Explorer, but every match is, without exception, terminated by S.I.G.M.A. before the engines even start.

name: Route Constructor Operation Manual
description: Use to view information
background: When the first Route Constructor rolled off the production line, every researcher unanimously acknowledged that its creation was a major milestone in Lahai-Roi's scientific expeditions.

name: Relay Station Rental Service Notice
description: Use to view information
background: Relay Stations serve as hubs in Lahai-Roi's route network. They bustle with traffic and supply deliveries, making them hotspots where rumors and intel flow.

name: Rakosan's Speech (Excerpt)
description: Use to view information
background: Passion alone cannot sustain an undertaking of this scale. When Rakosan delivered his speech, every department head was present, a clear indicator of how meticulously he had laid the groundwork.

name: Who Are the "Outcasts" (Excerpt)
description: Use to view information
background: Don't let the Outcasts' rough speech and brash manners fool you into thinking they are all brawn and no brains. Roya are, after all, Roya. Their intellect is not to be underestimated, even if they sometimes put it to dubious use.

name: Parcel to be Delivered
description: A parcel to be delivered.
background: Inside is a well-worn Nine Linked Rings puzzle, and a half-opened letter. Left behind by a daughter for her father, these tokens are as quiet as she was—a silent proof of her unspoken care.

name: An Inventory and A Parcel
description: An inventory and a parcel.
background: An inventory listing the belongings of the fallen Xuanfang Wardens, accompanied by a parcel containing the Nine Linked Rings puzzle and the letter you just retrieved.

name: Parcel to be Delivered
description: A parcel to be delivered.
background: A delicate jade-green pendant emitting a soft, restrained glow. Alongside it lies a crumpled, expired ticket to a popular water performance in Mengzhou.

name: Jinzhou Skewers
description: Increases ATK of all Resonators in the team by 100, lasting for 15m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background: Skewers that have become a favorite for everyone in Jinzhou and must-have on the menu of every restaurant in Jinzhou. But each restaurant has its own secret recipe. "Come to my place, my skewers are the real deal!"

name: Stuffed Flatbread
description: Increases DEF of all Resonators in the team by 200, lasting for 15m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background: An ordinary plain flatbread. Carries the memory of the difficult times of the residents of Huanglong.

name: Perilla Salad
description: Increases Crit. Rate of all Resonators in the team by 10%, lasting for 15m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background: A dish used to stave off hunger when supplies are scarce, it has now become a refreshing side dish on the dinner table.

name: Spicy Pulled Chicken
description: Reduces Wall Dash and Swimming STA consumption for all Resonators in the team by 15% for 15m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background: A simple cold dish of pulled chicken with an appetizing splash of hot chili oil. Although simple to make, it always reminds people of their childhood.

name: Loong Whiskers Crisp
description: Restores 80 STA.
background: A popular dessert in Huanglong, it is considered a symbol of good luck and blessings because of its association with loong.

name: Food Ration Bar
description: Reduces Cooldown for Grapple by 25% for a selected Resonator in the team for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background: A staple food of the Jinzhou Garrison. Besides a hearty bite, it is also easy to make and carry around. Each serving comes with a message about guarding the homeland and a reminder to the soldiers that although the night is long and endless, Jinzhou always has their back.

name: Refreshment Tea
description: Increases Max HP of all Resonators in the team by 800, lasting for 15m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background: A free herbal tea distributed by the Jinzhou government. It is known for its refreshing and detoxifying effects and is popular among the working class. "Thank you to everyone who works hard for Jinzhou."

name: Salted Milk Tea
description: Defeating overworld enemies yields 25% more Shell Credits, lasting for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background: A sugary, salty beverage inspired by the favorite tea drink of the miners in Huanglong. During the cold winter months, a bowl of Salted Milk Tea can warm the entire body.

name: Angelica Tea
description: Increases Max HP of all Resonators in the team by 25%, lasting for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background: During the period of material shortage, Angelica was used by the people of Huanglong as an important medicine to resist the cold. After the production of synthetic drugs was restored, the habit of drinking Angelica tea to resist the cold was retained and gradually developed into the current Angelica Tea.

name: Shuyun Herbal Tea
description: Increases ATK and Crit. Rate of all Resonators in the team by 12% and 10% respectively, lasting for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background: Shuyun's family secret herbal tea, best savored in summer. Its flavor, however, is an acquired taste, and opinions on it are sharply divided. The recipe has never been shared, and no amount of gold could ever pry it loose. Usually, the only way to try it is to ask Shuyun to brew it for you.

name: Poached Chicken
description: Reduces Cooldown for Grapple by 15% for a selected Resonator in the team for 15m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background: A must-have dish in the Panhua Restaurant, the poached chicken is added with a special sauce. Some people want to replicate the taste of the Panhua Restaurant's Poached Chicken, but there is always a difference. After all, a restaurant must have some skills.

name: Spicy Meat Slices
description: Increases ATK of all Resonators in the team by 25%, lasting for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background: A famous dish in Huanglong, the spicy taste is mouth-watering. Some people have tried to replace the spices with fruit sauce, but this was strongly protested by the Huanglong chefs.

name: Loong Bun
description: Increases DEF of all Resonators in the team by 25%, lasting for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background: This round bun featuring Loong horns comes in a variety of flavors. Highly cherished by the people of Huanglong, they are a staple on festive tables. Legend has it that consuming a whole bun brings good fortune in the following year.

name: Iron Shovel Edodes
description: Increases Crit. Rate of all Resonators in the team by 16%, lasting for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background: A special dish that originated in the Huanglong army. Huanglong soldiers would use an engineer's shovel as an iron plate, and after heating, they would grill and enjoy the ingredients. This way of eating was later passed back to the home by the retired soldiers and became a famous dish.

name: Jinzhou Stew
description: Increases ATK and Crit. Rate of all Resonators in the team by 8% and 6% respectively, lasting for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background: A stew comprised of mixed protein and vegetables. The popular Jinzhou family meal allows for the preservation of the ingredients' natural flavors to the maximum owing to its simplicity and versatility. "Jinzhou Stew, Jingzhou brew!"

name: Candied Caltrops
description: Increases DEF and Max HP of all Resonators in the team by 18% and 15% respectively, lasting for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background: One of the famous signature dishes of the Panhua Restaurant. Its sweet and soft taste is very popular among the children of Jinzhou.

name: Wuthercake
description: Increases ATK of all Resonators in the team by 30%, lasting for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background: A kind of pure golden pastry made with a lot of egg yolks. It can maintain its crisp taste even in a humid environment. You can eat it with confidence at any time.

name: Aureate Fried Rice
description: Reduces Wall Dash and Swimming STA consumption for all Resonators in the team by 20% for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background: A fried rice dish that every family in Jinzhou knows how to make. Each grain of rice is coated in a golden layer of egg yolk, symbolizing good fortune. It is often served during festive dinners in the mines, carrying the workers' wishes that their toil and frugality may bring about peace and prosperity.

name: Lemon-Braised Pork
description: Increases Echo drop rate by 20%, lasting for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-Op Mode.
background: One of the famous field recipes of the Midnight Rangers, carefully selected Lemongrass and Raw Meat are combined for barbecue. Later adaptations transformed it into a stew, where Lemongrass's fragrance adeptly masks the gamey flavor of the meat, contributing to its widespread popularity.

name: Milky Fish Soup
description: Restores 40 STA.
background: A fish soup that warms the body and seems to ward off the cold. Some families in Huanglong often serve it to sick family members.

name: Kudzu Congee
description: Increases Crit. Rate of all Resonators in the team by 22%, lasting for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background: A congee mixed with kudzu powders for high fiber and satiety. In the early years, there were always peddlers with shoulder poles in the streets and alleys of Jinzhou. When the clinkering sounds of their bells come, people would know it was for selling Kudzu Congee. Therefore, the elderly also use tinkering sounds to refer to Kudzu Congee.

name: Star Flakes
description: Increases DEF of all Resonators in the team by 35%, lasting for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background: A snack popular among the children of Jinzhou, made with deep-fried meat bits of starry shapes and served with a special power dip. It is said that you can make a wish after eating it. "One star, two stars... you can't make a wish without eating it!"

name: Caltrop Stir Fry
description: Defeating overworld enemies yields 25% more materials, lasting for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background: A famous medicinal dish in Huanglong, its ingredients are simple, just need to stir fry the Caltrop with meat after shelling. This dish can calm the mind and invigorate the body, and is popular with the people of Huanglong.

name: Caltrop Soup
description: Increases Max HP of all Resonators in the team by 30%, lasting for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background: Also known as "Winter Cloud Soup”. A luxury congee made by slow-cooking Caltrop with poultry broth. The key to make this dish is the control of the heat and the ratio of the ingredients. The slow cooking with a gentle heat preserves the original sweetness of the Caltrop. Paired with Honeysuckle, even a lonely night will feel happy.

name: Crispy Squab
description: Increases DEF of all Resonators in the team by 50%, lasting for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background: The squab, with crispy skin and tender meat, embodies Huanglong's warm hospitality, making it a must-have dish for welcoming guests and a favorite among visitors from all over the world.

name: Jinzhou Maocai
description: Increases Crit. Rate of all Resonators in the team by 28%, lasting for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background: Originally a dish invented by Huanglong miners who were too busy to cook, Maocai is prepared simply by mixing and stewing all ingredients with spices in one pot.

name: Rising Loong
description: Increases Max HP of all Resonators in the team by 40%, lasting for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background: A golden and crispy fish dish with a complex preparation process. The carp is styled to look up to the sky, as if it wishes to transform into a dragon. It is said that when the Jué descends, the big fishes in the ocean all resurfaced. In order to commemorate this wonderous sight, people serve it on the table during festivals, praying for a good fortune in the coming year.

name: Sweet & Sour Pork
description: Increases Echo drop rate by 50%, lasting for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-Op Mode.
background: One of the must-have dishes at the Huanglong New Year's feast. Because of its sour, sweet, and crispy taste, it is popular with children and is also known as "Kid's Delight" by the people. Perhaps the heartfelt smile of happiness on the children’s faces when they taste the sweetness of this dish is more satisfactory the dish itself.

name: Chili Sauce Tofu
description: Defeating overworld enemies yields 50% more Shell Credits, lasting for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background: A dish of tender tofu served in chili sauce. The appetizing spiciness of it makes Chili Sauce Tofu a widely popular dish even among the nobles of the New Federation.

name: Morri Pot
description: Increases ATK of all Resonators in the team by 40%, lasting for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background: Beef hot pots made with mushroom soup base and other ingredients. The taste is delicious, retaining the original flavor of the dish. But the selection of materials and processing must be careful, and careful again. If hallucinations occur during consumption, please seek medical attention immediately.

name: Stuffed Tofu
description: Defeating overworld enemies yields 50% more materials, lasting for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background: A private dish made by digging a hole in the tofu and filling it with special minced meat. The tofu that is dug out should not be wasted and can be made into other tofu snacks.

name: Failed Attempt
description: Increases ATK of all Resonators in the team by 50, lasting for 15m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background: A product of a failed gastronomy experiment. Though its taste could be indescribable, at least it fills the stomach (if taken all in)... “Is this... is this edible?"

name: Happiness Tea
description: Increases DEF and Max HP of all Resonators in the team by 12% and 10% respectively, lasting for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background: One of the traditional handmade drinks of Huanglong, implying "double happiness". The method of making it is simple, just dry the fresh Honeysuckle, stir-fry it with Lemongrass, and pour it into boiling water. Add a little Caltrop before drinking to add sweetness. The finished product is sour and sweet, with a slightly bitter aftertaste, which helps digestion, so it is often seen on the festival table.

name: Lotus Pastry
description: Increases Crit. DMG of all Resonators in the team by 32%, lasting for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background:
One of the specialties in Mt. Firmament. It resembles the fruit of the Silver Lotus. In fact, the residents of Mt. Firmament do incorporate Silver Lotus into this pastry.
It is said that the Silver Lotus only grows in thick snow, blooming amidst the cold. The residents on Mt. Firmament believe that this flower blooms in deep snow to show gratitude to the forest and to uphold a belief in eternal blossoming. Thus, they have wrapped this promise within this pastry. As the stars rise and the moon sets, as snow falls and melts, the people of Mt. Firmament will never forget their promises.

name: Spicy Meat with Pavo Plums
description: Increases Energy Regen of all Resonators in the team by 20%, lasting for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background:
This dish features meat stir-fried with a generous amount of Pavo Plums. It's flavorful yet not greasy, aromatic, and spicy. It's an essential, simple dish to help you get through a lengthy winter.
"Want it tasty? Just add more Pavo Plums. It has to be spicy! The spiciness is key to its flavor!"

name: Huanglong Omelette
description: Increases ATK and Energy Regen of all Resonators in the team by 6% and 10% respectively, lasting for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background:
A common dish that has become a hallmark of Huanglong cuisine. Golden and exquisite, it is a breakfast plate beloved by people of all ages.
As it is always found on the dining tables of Huanglong, most folks see it as an everyday indulgence. But those who have been away from their homes always find themselves longing for its delicate fragrance.

name: Plumpcake
description: Restores 80 STA.
background:
A cake that is baked in every kitchen in Huanglong when the Moon-Chasing Festival is around.
Shared on the reunion dinner among the elder and the young, who exchange good wishes in the moonlight sifting through the lush leaves of the osmanthus trees. Over the moon-chasing tale that's been told a thousand times before, everyone bites down on this sweet, fragrant treat and savors the joy of reunion.

name: Moon Pearl
description: Increases Max HP of all Resonators in the team by 1000, lasting for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background:
A signature dessert of the Moon-Chasing Festival, with chewy rice balls served in rich, mellow sweet soup.
While some people pray to the moon for blessings, others put their prayers and blessings into this dessert.
"Reunion is what these Moon Pearls are all about!"

name: Moon Brew
description: Increases Energy Regen of all Resonators in the team by 20%, lasting for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background:
A mellow and refreshing wine enjoyed during the Moon-Chasing Festival.
In Jinzhou, there is a famous play about a person who drinks a thousand cups of wine so that, as he's awake, he can still walk in a dream, for there are places only reachable in the dreamland. The sweet taste enjoyed with closed eyes is the taste of home.

name: Fisher's Chowder
description: Increases DEF and Max HP of all Resonators in the team by 10% and 20% respectively, lasting for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background: A thick soup made with fish and dried Sea Flytraps simmered in milk. People in the coastal areas love this hearty and rich dish. With the cold wind blowing in from the sea, what dish could beat a bowl of hot soup?

name: Honeysuckle Cake
description: Increases ATK and Crit. DMG of all Resonators in the team by 8% and 12% respectively, lasting for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background: A cake filled with honeysuckle paste, offering a subtle floral aroma and a distinctly sweet taste.

name: Pizza Classica
description: Increases Basic Attack DMG Bonus of all Resonators in the team by 40% for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background:
A traditional dish from Rinascita, topped with gemberry jam, cheese, and smoked sausage. When it comes out of the oven, it fills the air with a rich aroma.
There was a man who swore he'd never have olives on his pizza, but the more he resisted, the more olives he got.

name: Pizza Tropicale
description: Increases Healing Bonus of all Resonators in the team by 25% for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background:
A non-traditional dish from Rinascita, topped with gemberry jam, cheese, and crownapple. When it comes out of the oven, it elicits gasps and cries.
1. NEVER mention Pizza Tropicale to a Ragunnesi.
2. NEVER mention crownapple to a Ragunnesi.
3. NEVER mention apple or crown...

name: Triple-Scoop Ice Cream
description: Reduces Flight STA consumption for all Resonators in the team by 15% for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background: Three perfectly stacked scoops of ice cream, balanced on a crunchy cone. Each scoop brings a different flavor, and every bite tastes like joy.

name: Nuvola Pasta
description: Reduces Wall Dash and Swimming STA consumption for all Resonators in the team by 30% for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background: Pasta made with Mastic Nuvola, known for its strong, inviting fragrance. It is said that the fragrance attracts the singing wraiths from the Nimbus Sanctum. People often venture out at dawn to gather fresh Mastic Nuvola, hoping to catch the melody it holds within.

name: Ragunna Espresso
description: Reduces Flight STA consumption for all Resonators in the team by 10% for 15m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background:
A traditional coffee from Ragunna, rich and intense. Finishing a cup of Ragunna Espresso without flinching is a true mark of adulthood.
"You've already had three cups today!"
"But this is only my third task!"

name: Steak Margherita
description: Increases Resonance Liberation DMG Bonus of all Resonators in the team by 40% for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background: A massive, freshly cooked steak perfect for a family gathering. According to a well-meaning local, the only proper way to enjoy Steak Margherita is medium-rare. Noted. But let's go with medium-well, just to be safe.

name: Laurus Salad
description: Increases Healing Bonus of all Resonators in the team by 30% for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background:
Freshly mixed with Viscum Berries and Laurus Sprouts, this salad is light, sweet, and healthy.
Acolytes of the Order regard the Viscum Berry as the "holy nourishment of the wise." They chew the fruit alongside sacred texts, believing that doing so imprints the teachings upon the soul.

name: Nectarwine
description: Increases Healing Bonus of all Resonators in the team by 15% for 15m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background: Brewed from the nectar of Sunflare Everlasting, this mead is gifted by the Montelli family to each of its new members. To drink this mead is to let go of old grudges, and show the truest of hearts.

name: Daily Panini
description: Increases Energy Regen of all Resonators in the team by 25% for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background:
The perfect morning sandwich—delicious, quick, and wholesome. 
Even the simplest bread holds infinite potential. Like life, a panini may seem the same every day, but it is always a little different.

name: Every Flavor Bell Crab
description: Increases ATK and Crit. Rate of all Resonators in the team by 22% and 12% respectively for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background: The troupe's favorite seafood, Bell Crab, is the soul of this dish. Each Bell Crab finds its perfect shell, giving it a distinct flavor. Before every meal, the troupe members place a bet: What will the next crab taste like?

name: Baton Bread
description: Increases Healing Bonus and Max HP of all Resonators in the team by 5% and 10% respectively for 15m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background: A bread that looks like a baton and tastes like one. Rumor has it, someone once tried to use it as the main shaft for an aircraft—fortunately, that idea never took off.

name: Troupe Strength
description: Increases Heavy Attack DMG Bonus of all Resonators in the team by 25% for 15m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background: The troupe's self-brewed liquor, its name a symbol of ownership, power, and honor. The seafarers used to bicker endlessly over what to call it. After many wagers and a fair bit of their private stock on the line, the drunken Fools finally reached a decision: it would be called "Troupe's Strength."

name: Gold Star Pizza
description: Increases Resonance Skill DMG Bonus of all Resonators in the team by 50% for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background: Now available at Trattoria Margherita in Ragunna City, a new pizza said to come from the distant land of Huanglong. With a unique topping of beef, pineapple, durian, and cheese, this pizza delivers a flavor that surprises and lingers. As fans of this bold combo always say, "It hits like a wave!"

name: Every Flavor Bell-less Crab
description: Increases all team members' ATK by 22% and Crit. DMG by 24% for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background: Bell Crabs shed their iconic bells during certain times of the year. During this period, these crabs are also known as "Bell-less Crabs," said to have a distinct flavor apart from Bell Crabs.

name: Wine-Brewed Octopus Clam
description: Increases all team members' Max HP by 30% for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background: It is said that a drunken Troupe member once mistook wine for water while cooking seafood, accidentally creating this dish. Fortunately, no fires were involved.

name: Riccioli Salt Baked Fish
description: Increases all team members' DEF by 35% for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background: The finest ingredients often require only the simplest preparation. Fresh fish, lightly cleaned and baked in sea salt, brings out its pure, natural flavors. For seasoned sailors, this dish is a commonplace staple. However, for the sheltered nobles of Ragunna, it represents their most vivid imagination of the sea.

name: Oaknut Honeycake
description: Reduces Flight STA consumption for all Resonators in the team by 10% for 15m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background:
Add more syrup! No, even more! Until this honeycake is as sweet and warm as a hug! And don't forget to top it with some Oaknuts, the forest's blessings and nature's gift.
May you have a sweet day.

name: Saltimbocca
description: Grants 40% Resonance Liberation DMG Bonus to all Resonators in the team for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background:
A traditional Septimont dish made from mashed veal and Bloodleaf Viburnums.
It's said that it leaps into your mouth and gives you courage for battle.
Septimontians drum and feast before the hunt. They defend their home with blood and flesh.

name: Glory Roast Platter
description: Grants 50% Healing Bonus to all Resonators in the team for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background:
Skewers, poultry legs, and meat wraps. Now you've got yourself a Glory Roast Platter!
Come, Hero of Gladiators, Star of the Arena, take this "glory" and let's meet at the top!

name: Frosted Cream Blizzard
description: Grants 25% Healing Bonus to all Resonators in the team for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background:
A cup of seemingly ordinary shaved ice. Is it really as ordinary as it looks?
...Alright, yes. It is absolutely ordinary. But for Septimontians, this simple treat is one of the few chances to truly cool down.

name: Solis
description: Increases Energy Regen of all Resonators in the team by 30% for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background:
A popular energy drink among Septimont Gladiators.
Drink this can of Solis, and fight 'til the last breath!

name: Bamboo Iris Crisps
description: Increases ATK of all Resonators in the team by 25% for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background:
A local Septimontian Snack made from fried petals of Bamboo Iris. Light and crunchy.
Each pack holds just a few Bamboo Iris Crisps... and a whole lot of deliciously fragrant air. You won't stop at just one.

name: Seasalt Popcorn
description: Grants 10% Healing Bonus to all Resonators in the team and increases their Max HP by 20%, lasting for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background: Seasalt Popcorn, your must-have snack for any Agon. Salty, joyful, and healthy! Every bite brings the taste of the sea.

name: Bubbly Buddy
description: Grants 30% Heavy Attack DMG Bonus to all Resonators in the team for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background:
Whether you're watching Agons or catching every clash in the arena, it's there for you.
Zero sugar. Zero calories. Packed with Bloodleaf Viburnums. Let it fire up the arena!

name: Marinated Olives
description: Grants 50% Resonance Skill DMG Bonus to all Resonators in the team for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background:
The clever folk of Septimont know a thousand ways to prepare olives, but only the marinated kind truly wins their hearts.
A handful of olives and a good bottle of wine, that's all it takes to bring Septimontians the simplest joy and happiness sometimes.

name: Blooming Bread
description: Grants 40% Heavy Attack DMG Bonus to all Resonators in the team for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background:
A traditional staple of Septimont. Long before its people ever settled these highlands, this crisp-crusted, hearty bread had already become the most enduring flavor on their tongues.
To a Septimontian table, bread is what a sword is to a Gladiator.

name: Laurel Shrimp in Nimbus Reduction
description: Increases ATK of all Resonators in the team by 25% for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background: Food that was once a staple of Rinascitan home cooking, but which has since disappeared from the public eye as high demand led to a precipitous drop in the availability of the tasty shrimp used in its preparation. Today, only a few who purchase expensive shrimp from merchants affiliated with the Order are able to recreate this classical dish.

name: Skelecanth Tartare
description: Reduces Wall Dash and Swimming STA consumption for all Resonators in the team by 20% for 15m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background: In the Royan language, the name of this dish means "sand-buried"—a reference to how the Roya preserve Skelecanth rinsed in salt and spice. During this slow process, the fish gently ferments, its flesh turning tender and deeply flavorful.

name: Lichen Salad
description: Increases Max HP of all Resonators in the team by 25% for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background: In Lahai-Roi, every edible ingredient is treasured, even the humble Cradle Lichen. A handful of fresh, lightly seasoned lichen mixed with the nuts of Creeping Torchpine creates a simple yet nourishing Royan delicacy rich in dietary fiber.

name: Pine Needle Soda
description: Restores 80 STA.
background: In the clear container, bubbles fizz upward, rising through the pine needles that drift and settle inside the glass. What began as a simple "use-what-you-have" nutritional drink turned out to be unexpectedly delicious. One sip, and the pine's fragrance lingers between your teeth. Crisp, aromatic, with a cooling sweetness that sweeps away every trace of fatigue.

name: Honeypot Jam
description: Grants 25% Healing Bonus to all Resonators in the team for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background: To make preserved Dusk Honeypot, the fully ripened berries are harvested and gently simmered to remove excess moisture, then finished with just a touch of sugar. Time stops within the jar. The berry loses its faint, intoxicating effect, but its sweetness remains, safely kept for an entire year.

name: Smoked Meat Stew
description: Grants 40% Resonance Liberation DMG Bonus to all Resonators in the team for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background: Thin slices of meat smoked over Creeping Torchpine needles are stewed together with the fermented drink, then served with mashed potatoes and a spoonful of Honeypot Jam. The rich fat of the Kronapuff mingles with the firm, chewy Lemming meat, offering alternating waves of flavor. On a night when the cold wind cuts to the bone, one mouthful of this dish is enough to make you forget the coldness and the exhaustion.

name: Grilled Fern Spore
description: Increases Crit. DMG of all Resonators in the team by 32% for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background: Young fern balls are picked, skewered, and grilled into one of the most common Royan greens. They have a noticeable bitterness. Fans say the aftertaste is pleasantly sweet, calling it "the taste of adulthood." Royan children avoid them, but anyone who can finish a whole skewer without making a face earns bragging rights.

name: Fruit Crackle
description: Grants 30% Heavy Attack DMG Bonus to all Resonators in the team for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background: A snack made from Dusk Honeypots coated in frozen syrup. It gets its name from the cracking sound you hear when you bite into it. It's a favorite among Royan children, though it takes some skill to crunch the sugar-coated berry without spilling its juice onto the clothes.

name: "Crack & Bolt" Fish Jar
description: Grants 50% Basic Attack DMG Bonus to all Resonators in the team for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background:
A Royan specialty strictly banned from Startorch Academy. Salted fish is packed into a jar and sealed with wet clay, allowing it to ferment and develop a strong, distinctive flavor. To eat it, one must crack the jar's lid.

Before eating it, make sure to keep these things in mind:
1. Always open the jar outdoors, in a wide and downwind spot.
2. Never open it indoors, in a warm place, upwind, or near a crowd.
3. Check the jar before eating. If you see a crack, put it down immediately and bolt.

name: "Munchie-More" Bun
description: Increases ATK by 10% and Crit. DMG by 20% for all Resonators in the team for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background: A Startorch Academy cafeteria classic. It looks like a simple carb-on-carb combo, but it's surprisingly addictive: a soft bun brushed with salad dressing, stuffed with sweet-and-savory fried noodles, topped with red pickled ginger for balance. Most people can't stop munching more.

name: Complete Nutrition Squeezy Jelly
description: Increases Max HP of all Resonators in the team by 20% for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background: Created for Startorch Academy's students and staff, this jelly is packed with balanced nutrients and fiber, offering steady energy and long-lasting fullness. Its nozzle is designed for easy use anywhere. You can customize the flavor, but be cautious when accepting homemade jelly from others. Not every creative flavor is pleasant for your tummy.

name: Lahai-Roi Special Plant Milk
description: Increases Max HP of all Resonators in the team by 1000 for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background: A drink rich in nervonic acid that helps sharpen mental response. It's mellow with a hint of pine-leaf bitterness. Developed by the Academy kitchen using local Lahai-Roi ingredients, it represents their effort to explore new, sustainable food options.

name: Canned Surprise
description: Grants 50% Resonance Skill DMG Bonus to all Resonators in the team for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background: Cake, jam, and cream are stacked in tidy layers, then sealed inside a tin. The metal casing gives this delicate dessert a long shelf life and sturdy protection. Whether you're alone in a dorm room, working late in a lab, or out on a frozen plain, it's always there when you need a small, almost magical comfort.

name: Instant Wakeup Energy Gel Sachet
description: Increases Energy Regen of all Resonators in the team by 25% for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background: Created for people who dislike sweets, this smooth, savory blend goes down easily and is gentle on the stomach. According to one student who prefers not to be named, it tastes almost exactly like a cat treat.

name: Midnight Wonder Cup Noodles
description: Increases DEF by 10% and Max HP by 20% for all Resonators in the team, lasting for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background:
Specially made by the Agronomy Wing, the cup noodles are famous for their rich aroma, which somehow manages to tempt people mostly at night. They may not be the most balanced meal, but they're undeniably one of the Academy's favorites.

The container has its own heating system, so just add drinking water and wait. If left too long and the noodles or the vegetables start multiplying unusually fast, please contact the Agronomy Wing for collection.
