name: "Sweetness At the Corner" Chocolate Box
description: Increases Max HP of all Resonators in the team by 30% for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background: A chocolate box filled with sweetness, and with the bright smiles of your friends melted into every piece. Share this moment of joy together, and let each bite bring back those happy encounters waiting just around the corner.

name: Crispy Juicy Fried Pork Chops Lunchbox
description: Increases ATK of all Resonators in the team by 30% for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background: A generously packed lunchbox loaded with flavor. Take a firm bite of the golden, crispy pork chops and savor every last piece. The satisfaction and energy it offers will fuel your next victory!

name: Morning, Resonator
description: Increases Max HP of all Resonators in the team by 30% for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background: The rich, roasted aroma of coffee blends with a gentle hint of milk, creating a smooth, layered flavor in every sip. On every morning in Solaris, take this with you, and say "good morning" to yourself and to the world.

name: Spicy Crispy Chicken Burger
description: Increases ATK by 10% and Crit. DMG by 20% for all Resonators in the team for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background: A fried drumstick with a crisp golden crust and tender meat inside, finished with a house-made spicy sauce. It's savory with just the right kick, making every bite deeply satisfying.

name: The David Martinez
description: Increases ATK of all Resonators in the team by 30%, lasting for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background: A drink in the Afterlife named after David Martinez. Part of a ritual to honor the memory of street legends who went out in a blaze of glory.

name: Jade Mushroom Soup
description: Grants 40% Resonance Liberation DMG Bonus to all Resonators in the team for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background:
A soup made by pouring Uncracked Jade liquid and White Jade Beauty into a broth, then letting it simmer over a low flame. Remarkably versatile, it bends willingly to the cook's hand—a rich stock brings out a deep, savory character, while spring water yields a lighter, fresher note. A brief simmer is all it takes for the flavors to naturally bloom.

To keep impatient children from sneaking a taste before the mushrooms are fully cooked, parents have long made a habit of hiding away their bowls and chopsticks until the White Jade Beauty is properly done. Across the Land of Xuanfang, this is a comfort dish everyone grows up with.

name: Cloudward Stew
description: Grants 50% Healing Bonus to all Resonators in the team for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background:
Made by slow-stewing newly sprouted bamboo shoots with salted meat in a single pot. The natural sweetness of the bamboo melds with the savory depth of the meat, yielding a classic dish that is both hearty and deeply satisfying.

In Yuan Fortress, Cloudward Stew is regarded as a dish of good fortune, said to grant children sharp senses and a compassionate heart. During school enrollments or festive occasions, families often prepare this meal, wishing for their little ones to grow as strong and upright as spring bamboo, reaching ever skyward toward the clouds.

name: Sizzling Jade Stir-fry
description: Grants 25% Healing Bonus to all Resonators in the team for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background:
Thinly sliced cured meat is layered atop sliced mushrooms and steamed for hours. The saltiness of the meat seeps into the mushrooms' natural sweetness, lifting the whole dish to something far greater than its parts.

Mengzhou has a long-standing tradition of curing meat to bring out deeper flavor. Among the cuts, locals prize the rose-colored core as the "Sizzling Cube." This dish lays that cube over White Jade Beauty mushrooms, hence the name "Sizzling Jade Stir-fry." When honored guests arrive, a plate of this fine delicacy is more than enough to delight them.

name: Crab Braised Fish
description: Increases Energy Regen of all Resonators in the team by 30% for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background:
Fresh fish fillets are bathed in a sweet-and-sour glaze, then simmered over a low flame to bring out their delicate flavor. Though no crab ever touches the pot, the taste is remarkably true to the real thing.

This famous Yuan Fortress dish boasts a long history, though its reputation has waxed and waned with the passing generations. The recipe that now circulates across the Land of Xuanfang preserves the most widely embraced method, yet the truly authentic taste is known only to a few.

name: Little Snowy Moons
description: Increases ATK of all Resonators in the team by 25% for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background:
Steamed from a base of rice milk, these snow-white sponge cakes are shaped like a full moon, earning them the name "Little Snowy Moons." Soft and sweet, the pastry also goes by alternative names such as "Jade Plate" or "Water Moon Bun."

During Mengzhou's annual Waking Moon Festival, it has long been a tradition for every household to prepare these cakes in welcome of the rising moon. Soldiers stationed far from home in Xuanfang carried this custom with them, hoping that even if the same moon doesn't shine over both lands, their hearts might still meet in this shared moment of reunion.

name: Stir-Fried Trio
description: Grants 10% Healing Bonus to all Resonators in the team and increases their Max HP by 20%, lasting for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background:
Two varieties of fresh meat and seasonal bamboo shoots are finely scored in a chrysanthemum pattern, then flash-fried over a roaring flame. When the heat hits just right, all three ingredients curl up and bloom into a bright, glistening cascade of crimson.

This dish boasts an incredibly short cooking time, delivering a rich aroma and fiery kick that instantly stirs the appetite. In the Land of Xuanfang, locals often gauge a patient's recovery by their craving for the Stir-Fried Trio. If they can catch its scent and handle the heat, they're bound to be well on the mend.

name: Flavor Under Heaven
description: Grants 30% Heavy Attack DMG Bonus to all Resonators in the team for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background:
A whole fowl is submerged in an aged stock and braised thoroughly over a low flame, basted again and again with the savory broth until the meat turns tender.

This dish is intensely spicy, yet the heat builds up rather than striking at first bite. First-timers are often fooled by its seemingly mild appearance, but by the time the waves of spice roll in, they are drenched in sweat, tongues burning as if they'd swallowed a wheel of fire. Rumor has it that an epicure who feared no spice once polished off three whole plates. Finishing his meal, he let out a satisfied cry: "Three birds, one hand—enough to seize every flavor under heaven." The room fell silent in awe, and the dish has borne the name ever since.

name: Brocade Pearl Meatballs
description: Grants 50% Resonance Skill DMG Bonus to all Resonators in the team for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background:
Minced meat is mixed with diced bamboo shoots and chili flakes, shaped into perfect spheres, and placed into a bamboo steamer to cook through. The finished meatballs gleam with a pleasing, glossy crimson hue. With each bite, a fragrant burst of meat and spice unfurls, revealing a texture that is soft yet chewy. Their luminous, pearl-like appearance has earned them the local name "Brocade Pearl Meatballs."

Round as they are, they speak of reunion. Red as they gleam, they carry wishes for prosperity. And that perfect hint of spice keeps this well-rounded flavor ever tasting plain.

name: Memories of Autumn
description: Grants 40% Heavy Attack DMG Bonus to all Resonators in the team for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background:
Delicate fish balls, crafted from minced fish, are simmered together with tea leaves to form a refined soup. The tea buds offer a gentle bitterness while the fish balls lend a subtle sweetness. At first glance, the soup appears modest and unassuming, but a careful sip reveals a faint, lingering note of autumn that stays on the palate.

This soup traces its origins to Mengzhou, where it was initially made with an entirely different aquatic ingredient, one far fresher than tea leaves. When the recipe made its way here, however, that original ingredient was nowhere to be found, and the locals had no choice but to substitute it with tea. And so, as the soup meets the tongue—poised somewhere between the familiar and the foreign—it stirs a flood of memories all the way back home.

name: Jade Broth Noodles
description: Increases ATK of all Resonators in the team by 25% for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background:
Fine noodles, thin as silver silk, are dropped into boiling water, blanched in an instant, then nestled neatly into a bowl. Large chunks of meat, slow-braised to a melt-in-your-mouth tenderness, rest atop the noodles. The broth, clarified to crystal clarity with White Jade Beauty mushrooms and rich stock, carries a faint, lingering whisper of cooking wine.

It is the most common meal you'll find across the Land of Xuanfang. Utterly ordinary in appearance, yet it delivers a depth of flavor that surprises with the very first bite. As some have put it: "The mildest flavors hold the truest essence. The ultimate delicacy is pure simplicity."

name: Immortal's Medley Tribute
description: Increases Max HP of all Resonators in the team by 25%, lasting for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background:
White Jade Beauty mushrooms and Climber Shoots are julienned and flash-fried in hot oil until their edges curl slightly. An Uncracked Jade egg mixture is then poured in and tossed gently until soft, delicate curds form, then finished with a scattering of Pavo Plums. With each sudden burst of berry juice, an intense, spicy aroma unfurls, instantly coaxing out the freshness of every ingredient.

Unbound by the traditional culinary methods, the Fillet Fairmaiden captures the true spirit of cooking. The essence of these premium ingredients seeps fully into the mushrooms, bamboo shoots, and egg curds, sending out a fragrance so mouthwatering that anyone who catches a whiff can't help but crave a taste.

name: Liondance Companion
description: Increases ATK of all Resonators in the team by 120, lasting for 15m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background: Snacks Lingyang made for the Liondance audience. The treats were a perfect combination of fatty and lean meats, complemented by fruits and vegetables to balance out the heaviness. Ideal for enjoying while watching the performance.

name: Sweet Stuffed Flatbread
description: Increases DEF of all Resonators in the team by 220, lasting for 15m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background: Zhezhi likes her Stuffed Flatbread sweet. She improved on the original recipe by adding her favorite sweetener. This simple, modest pastry restores energy quickly upon consumption and doesn't go bad for a long time. After learning how to make it, Zhezhi always stores lots of it at home and considers it an essential snack for her sketching trips.

name: Iced Perilla
description: Increases Crit. Rate of all Resonators in the team by 12%, lasting for 15m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background: In moments of research block, Baizhi turns to the chilled Perilla she always has on hand for a refreshing pause. The cool, herbal flavor soothes her senses and helps calm her racing thoughts. As she finishes her plate, her mind clears and she's able to refocus on her work with renewed determination.

name: Spicy Pulled Chicken
description: Reduces Wall Dash and Swimming STA consumption for all Resonators in the team by 15% for 15m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background: A simple cold dish of pulled chicken with an appetizing splash of hot chili oil. Although simple to make, it always reminds people of their childhood.

name: Silky Reveries
description: Restores 100 points of STA.
background: The delicious scent of Loong Whiskers Crisp enveloped Danjin as she bit into the perfectly crisp exterior, her teeth sinking into the dreamy floss coating. Despite her love for this sweet treat, she always wished for more. The kind stall owner suggested adding extra ingredients to enhance the sweetness even further, a tempting offer that Danjin couldn't resist.

name: Ration Bar
description: Reduces Cooldown for Grapple by 30% for a selected Resonator in the team for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background: Calcharo has a fondness for Huanglong's Food Ration Bar. He believes it efficiently satisfies basic energy needs in the wild and has a unique taste. To cater to some of the younger merc's preferences, Calcharo has enhanced the bar by adding dried fruits, sugar beans, and various seasonings, creating a variety of flavors.

name: Iced Grape Tea
description: Defeating overworld enemies yields 28% more Shell Credits, lasting for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background:
Chilled, diced fruit is put in ice water and sweetened with fresh nectar. The clinking ice cubes produce a clear, melodic sound. 
Camellya made this fruit tea to her liking, with just a hint of milk and grapes as the base, subtly balanced by a splash of gooseberry juice. 
The refreshing sweetness dances on the tongue, leaving a delightful aftertaste as the faint bitterness from the tea fades.

name: Sanqing Tea
description: Increases Max HP of all Resonators in the team by 28%, lasting for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background: The Sanqing tea from Yuanwu Boxing Gym has healing properties, aiding the spleen, lungs, and alleviating worries. A cup after a boxing session boosts blood flow and circulation while soothing the mind. The perfect combination of exercise and tea brings a sense of inner peace, momentarily freeing one from mundane concerns and desires.

name: Yuezhou Spicy Meat Noodles
description: Increases ATK of all Resonators in the team by 28%, lasting for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background:
Long, silky noodles absorb the rich, spicy broth. Chopped scallions adorn generous slices of meat. One bite can make you sweat, even in winter's chill.
In the remote, rustic village of Yuezhou, this dish is Lumi's fondest memory of home. 
Despite her travels after joining Lollo Logistics, tasting a variety of cuisines, Lumi still believes that the steaming bowl of noodles from her hometown is the true definition of happiness.

name: Crystal Clear Buns
description: Increases DEF of all Resonators in the team by 28%, lasting for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background: Sanhua revamped the traditional ingredients used in Loong Buns, creating a refreshing and translucent treat perfect for cooling down during hot summers. This delicacy quickly became a staple on the City Hall's tables, winning over the hearts of all visitors... and the Jinzhou Magistrate herself.

name: Yesterday in Jinzhou
description: Increases ATK and Crit. Rate of all Resonators in the team by 10% and 8% respectively, lasting for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background: While many may turn up their noses at General Jiyan's cooking, the Midnight Rangers, a group of experienced soldiers, savor each bite. The stew is brimming with hearty vegetables and sparing on meat, a reminder of their past battles on the frontlines. Its familiar flavors evoke a sense of nostalgia for their time as warriors, making it a treasured dish among these old soldiers.

name: Fluffy Wuthercake
description: Increases ATK of all Resonators in the team by 33%, lasting for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background: A Wuthercake made with Yangyang's special formula. It incorporates whipped egg whites instead of the usual yolks. The result? A fluffy and tender treat that is both delicious and nutritious, thanks to the addition of berry jam. This revamped recipe caters to all ages, from seniors to picky kids, making it a satisfying indulgence for everyone.

name: Golden Fried Rice
description: Reduces Wall Dash and Swimming stamina consumption for all Resonators in the team by 24% for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background: Fried rice is a staple dish for beginner cooks, but only those with a discerning palate can master it to perfection. Yinlin, accustomed to the affluent and refined through her job, has developed a taste for the finest cuisine. This golden fried rice, made with humble ingredients but expert skill, is her favorite. It embodies what she values most in cooking - the ability to turn simplicity into excellence.

name: Lemon-Scented Sukiyaki
description: Increases Echo drop rate by 22%, lasting for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode
background: Refreshing lemons meld their zesty notes into this rich stew. Tender and flavorful, it is one of Chisa's signature dishes. Every winter, she'd curl up under a heated futon to watch music shows while scents wafting from the pot filled the room. Those were the coziest days in her memories.

name: Shredded Fish Soup
description: Restores 50 STA.
background: Stir fry the shredded fish with seasoning, place it on top of the simmered thick broth, and then pour hot oil over the dish, creating a sizzling sound that brings out sweet and savory flavors. This rich soup is by far Buling's favorite hometown dish.

name: Floral Porridge
description: Increases Crit. Rate of all Resonators in the team by 24%, lasting for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background: Gently simmer the rice over low heat, adding a few delicate flower petals for flavor. As it begins to lightly boil, this simple yet sweet dish becomes a favorite snack for Taoqi when relaxing at home. With each slow sip, it seems to wash away the accumulated fatigue of the day, leaving a refreshing feeling in its wake.

name: Baa Baa Crisp
description: Increases DEF of all Resonators in the team by 40%, lasting for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background: After multiple attempts, Encore triumphantly created a dish she was pleased with. Golden and crunchy, each bite resembled a miniature lamb. And after indulging, one would surely dream of frolicking among sheep. With this culinary masterpiece, there's no need to fret — it can be savored without hesitation.

name: Lotus Seed Soup
description: Increases Max HP of all Resonators in the team by 33%, lasting for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background: Maintaining a healthy body is crucial. The combination of gold and silver lotus seeds in this recipe provides warmth, nourishment, and a calming effect on both the body and mind. It was the first medicinal meal Jianxin learned during her mountain retreat and remains one of her go-to recipes for overall health and well-being.

name: Smoked Pigeon
description: Increases DEF of all Resonators in the team by 55%, lasting for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background: Mortefi's signature dish, created during his time wandering in the wilderness. Despite early struggles with controlling his powers, he has now mastered the art of cooking it. A perfect balance of crispy outer layer and tender interior, it boasts a sweet and fragrant flavor while maintaining the freshness of the meat itself.

name: Champion Hotpot
description: Increases Crit. Rate of all Resonators in the team by 30%, lasting for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background: A steaming hot pot filled to the brim with Victor Savor, known for its spicy and flavorful taste. Chixia claims it is the best hot pot in the world. However, for those who can't handle the spiciness... caution is advised before trying.

name: Chongzhou Spicy Tofu
description: Defeating overworld enemies yields 55% more Shell Credits, lasting for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background:
When Qiuyuan and his comrades were still in service, their missions often required them to travel fast and eat light, with little chance to enjoy a good meal. Even when they lodged at village inns, they still had to cook their own food out of an abundance of caution. Originally from Chongzhou, Qiuyuan had learned a few basic recipes at a young age. One of his dishes was fragrant, spicy, and mouthwatering, perfect for an empty stomach when paired with rice. Simple, yet satisfying. 
"Eat well, live well."

name: Green Field Pot
description: Increases ATK of all Resonators in the team by 44%, lasting for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background: Verina's prized Morri Pot brims with a delectable blend of freshly grown vegetables and herbs. Her meticulous care and patience in breeding and preparing these ingredients result in a uniquely delicious taste. Through the growth of her plants, she witnesses the beauty of life cycles, and in cooking, she finds joy in the anticipation of harvest.

name: Misty Tea
description: Increases DEF and Max HP of all Resonators in the team by 14% and 12% respectively, lasting for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background:
This tea is a favorite of Aalto's. As the water in the pot turns to mist and then back into water in the cup, the aroma of the tea is coupled with the soothing mist.
"Now, let's get down to business."
It seems Aalto's mastery of tea-making is just one of his many skills in the business world.

name: Spring Pastry
description: Increases Crit. DMG of all Resonators in the team by 36%, lasting for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background:
Jinhsi's modified version of Lotus Pastry, a special dessert in Mt. Firmament.
As snow blankets the landscape, wishes drift down with the snowfall, settling quietly in the woods.
Though the snow continues to fall, it will eventually be swept away by the spring breeze, and the wishes buried deep in the snow will bloom like flowers.

name: Blazing Feather Spicy Meat
description: Increases Energy Regen of all Resonators in the team by 24%, lasting for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background:
Changli's favorite dish, which is made with extra chili.
The vibrant redness hints at its intense flavor, which seems to leap out of the bowl. Served alongside rice and a cup of osmanthus syrup, amidst the bustling ambiance of Capital Mingting, it provides a heavenly culinary experience.
While few in Mingting, apart from Changli, venture to taste this delicacy, it's a cherished household favorite among families in Hongzhen. Accompanied by wine, it adds an extra layer of warmth to the dining experience.

name: Vege Omelette
description: Increases ATK and Energy Regen of all Resonators in the team by 8% and 12% respectively, lasting for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background:
This nutritionally balanced, simple dish is a breakfast staple in Huanglong and a regular dish found in every household and the breakfast shops in Jinzhou. For someone who has lived in Jinzhou for many years like Xiangli Yao, it is an easy first choice for breakfast.
A sip of tea after a bite perfectly balances the flavors, satisfying your appetite while awakening your taste buds and mind after a deep sleep.

name: Creamy Clouds
description: Increases DEF and Max HP of all Resonators in the team by 12% and 22% respectively, lasting for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background:
A thick soup beloved by the Shorekeeper made with nothing fancy but the freshly caught seafood commonly found in coastal households. The secret is to add in heavy milk and reduce the soup slowly.
It's little known that the soup was a result of the Shorekeeper's effort to recreate a soup that used to bring her so much comfort. She tried to replicate it to the best of her recollection, but through numerous attempts, she ended up with a recipe with her personal touch. The sweetness of the seafood blends well with a freshly toasted slice of bread. Its warmth soothes fatigue and soul... Maybe that's what that person meant by a "simple but certain" happiness.

name: Frostwork Cake
description: Increases ATK and Crit. DMG of all Resonators in the team by 10% and 16% respectively, lasting for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background:
Snacks kept by Youhu in her ice cauldron, always cool to the touch. 
It’s difficult for Youhu to find food and accommodations while she travels around Solaris hunting for antiquities. These tasty cakes are what keep her from starving at times like these.
Youhu likes to put fruits in the cauldron too. As a result, the moist crusts of the cakes always gives off the faint fragrance of the seasonal fruits.

name: A Slice of Pizza
description: Increases Basic Attack DMG Bonus of all Resonators in the team by 44% for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background:
A slice cut from an unimaginably large pizza, rich with melted cheese and laden with various toppings. Every child can find a slice they like, making for a rare treat eaten together only once a month.

The nannies used to say, "Love inspires faith, faith fosters sharing, and sharing brings love full circle."

name: Multi-Scoop Ice Cream
description: Reduces Flight STA consumption for all Resonators in the team by 18% for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background: With a makeshift mini ice cream maker, Roccia serves up simple ice cream that's both generous in portion and light on the pocket. It's become a beloved treat among the troupe, satisfying their cravings for sweets without straining their budget.

name: One-Pot Pasta
description: Reduces Wall Dash and Swimming STA cost for all Resonators in the team by 35% for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background:
Zani's pasta is a rich and flavorful dish, made by layering hearty meat sauce with cheese, sausage, and fragrant herbs before cooking it to perfection.
According to what she said, she first stumbled upon the idea while reheating a takeout meal that had gone cold after a long workday. On a whim, she threw in whatever ingredients she had on hand, and to her surprise, the result was unexpectedly delicious. What began as a quick fix soon turned into a carefully refined recipe.

name: Orange Espresso
description: Reduces Flight STA consumption for all Resonators in the team by 12% for 15m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background: An espresso with a hint of orange, this has become Carlotta's morning ritual since joining the Montelli family. The bold coffee flavor is mellowed by a citrusy sweetness, creating a refreshing balance. It's perfect for those gearing up for a challenge or unwinding after one.

name: Knight-Errant's Essentials
description: Grants 34% Healing Bonus to all Resonators in the team for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background:
Prepared by Cartethyia herself, this Laurus Salad comes packed with extra Viscum Berries, crispy and sweet.
Now a wandering knight, she's hungry to learn, to grow, and to see the world.
Let's start with a salad made just for the wandering knight. This time, extra berries included!

name: Homemade Panini
description: Increases Energy Regen of all Resonators in the team by 28% for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background:
A Panini made by Cantarella herself.

Two pieces of perfectly baked, crispy bread are stuffed with a blend of carefully seasoned seafood.

With each bite, the rich flavors slide down your throat and settle in your stomach, filling it with unparalleled satisfaction.

Unlike potions' mysterious flavors, this is a taste of simple comfort and warmth.

name: Pasta Bocadillo
description: Gives 8% Healing Bonus to all Resonators in the team and increases their Max HP by 12% for 15m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background:
For a wandering bard like Ciaccona, meals on the road are all about striking a balance between taste and convenience.
One day, as the campfire crackled to life, she had an idea and took the bread she always carried.
As the rich aroma of meat sauce filled the air, seeping into the bread's warm crust, she spread on the final layer of seasoning.
However, there's an unspoken rule. Ragunna's pasta is not to be tampered with. No shortcuts, no twists. Taking a bite of her creation, Ciaccona was lost in her thoughts. "If I ever get banished, this bread might just be one of the reasons."

name: Purity Strength
description: Increases Heavy Attack DMG Bonus of all Resonators in the team by 28% for 15m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background:
Crafted by Brant himself, this exceptional brew offers a refreshing flavor with a lingering aftertaste.

Just as he dedicates his soul to every performance on stage, Brant pours his passion into each bottle.

With his name signed proudly on the bottle, he extends his heartfelt well wishes to those who receive this meticulously prepared gift.

"Life is to celebrate and to embrace freedom."

name: Redcurrant Tart
description: Reduces Flight STA consumption for all Resonators in the team by 12% for 15m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background: A tart drenched in thick, tangy jam that floods every crevice of the pastry, overpowering its sweetness. No one but Phrolova enjoys this zesty flavor, nor does anyone know where the tiny, sour berries even come from.

name: Super Doubleshot Shaved Ice Milkshake Deluxe
description: Grants 28% Healing Bonus to all Resonators in the team for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background:
Galbrena's unique dessert recipe features large scoops of ice cream over a bowl of shaved ice, topped with colorful jams for that extra kick in flavor, along with a portion generous enough to eat to your heart's content. She even took extra care to adjust the Tacet Discord-shaped candies and cookies to be more appealing and cute.
Perhaps there's a deeper reason behind it all: When dealing with Tacet Discords, one needs a sharp, decisive "crunch." But when it comes to life, one should savor its flavors to the fullest. According to Galbrena, eating them separately or together comes down to personal preference. Her only advice is: Enjoy it before it melts. Many life's precious moments "melt in an instant," just like the sprinkles of ice. But don't worry, delightful flavors cling to the taste buds and never fade, always there to enjoy.

name: Heartpour
description: Increases Energy Regen of all Resonators in the team by 34% for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background:
Endorsed by Gladiator Star Lupa, it's still a hit across Septimont.
Lightly sweet, refreshingly smooth, and coming in a variety of flavors, it is best enjoyed ice cold.
For Lupa, fighting in the arena is an indispensable part of her life. At the breaks of matches, she still takes a sip of this Heartpour, remembering the thrill of the fight and the laughter she shared with her partner during the Agon of Champions.

name: Sweetened Olives
description: Grants 55% Resonance Skill DMG Bonus to all Resonators in the team for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background: Did someone pick these olives? Hardly. The branches, heavy with ripened fruit, simply yielded their bounty, dropping them gently into her waiting hands. No elaborate preparation could improve their natural, fresh flavor. A simple roll in honey is all it takes to satisfy her discerning palate: as the verdant aroma still clings to her fingertips, a wave of sweet freshness washes over her mouth.

name: Sweetleaf Blooming Bread
description: Grants 44% Heavy Attack DMG Bonus to all Resonators in the team for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background:
An ordinary, traditional bread found throughout Septimont, even in the far-off town of Fabianum. Perhaps to set it apart, local bakers in Fabianum would sprinkle crushed herbs over the crisp crust and, with a sense of ceremony, carve the word "Delicious" into the surface, as if this modest declaration could lend it a hint of dignity.
Is it delicious? The young Augusta never thought so. To her, it was just the dry, hard bread waiting at home after a day of running wild, something to fill her belly, the quiet "footnote" to every dinner her mother made. It was plain, unremarkable. Like water. Like sunlight. So ordinary it was easy to overlook. But years later, standing before her own stove in Septimont, Augusta tried to recapture that long-forgotten taste. And as the familiar scent and gentle sweetness returned to her tongue, she finally understood what "Delicious" meant.
Perhaps, she had never truly bid farewell to her hometown.

name: Super Snowfluff Storm
description: Restores 100 points of STA.
background:
Soft, snow-white ice cream floats atop dark coffee, with an ice in the shape of a Snowfluff Seal resting peacefully within. A staple for those burning the midnight oil in the library, this drink balances the bitterness with a light, creamy sweetness. Every sip is a quiet moment of refreshment.

This drink is Aemys's award-winning creation from the Startorch Academy Beverage Innovation Contest. She once said that it was inspired by homesickness.

That sounded like a joke, perhaps, but not entirely. Those childhood days spent on the silent frostlands, playing with her family and the seals, now feel far away. And yet, the memories still linger in her mind.

name: Splendorous Sweetness
description: Grants 28% Healing Bonus to all Resonators in the team for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background:
Denia's dessert from a cooking class. She spent most of the session taste-testing, so in the end she went with jam, something easy to prep.
The result was extremely sweet, under-marinated, and overcooked. The texture and sweetness never quite came together. But it looked creative and photographed well, so her classmates still gave it decent scores—by a slim margin.
"It tastes sweet. It looks nice. That's good enough, right? Hm? Texture and flavor? Sorry, not really following you."

name: Hearty Double-Smoked Stew
description: Grants 44% Resonance Liberation DMG Bonus to all Resonators in the team for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background: This stew is made with vegetables and poultry smoked separately, then simmered together in one pot to bring out a layered, comforting aroma. The vegetables add a light, woodsy freshness, while the chicken brings a rich, savory depth, all coming together in a warm, golden broth. Luuk often cooks it on a small tabletop stove after work. He says the rising steam and gentle smell help people relax the moment they step inside, like sitting down to a warm meal shared among friends.

name: Star Crackle
description: Grants 35% Heavy ATK DMG Bonus to all Resonators in the team for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background:
Sigrika's take on Fruit Crackle, which she made to satisfy her own tastes. The star-shaped frosted candy is cool, sweet, and refreshing.
She didn't follow the recipe to the letter. Instead, she added a dash of "inspiration" on a whim.
Thankfully, the result was pretty good.
Sometimes a little inspiration goes a long way.

name: Packaged Red Bean Pudding
description: Increases Max HP of all Resonators in the team by 25%, lasting for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background:
Red bean pudding that can be easily made at home, a simple homemade dessert. After Hiyuki tweaked the recipe, it now comes in a more convenient package.
Hiyuki doesn't have much of a sweet tooth, but once she became the miko, she quietly visited a dessert shop to learn how to make red bean puddings. 
The children of Ashinohara came to call it the "good luck pudding." However the story grew, the sweetness itself stayed simple. Almost plain.
Just as she hoped.

name: Refreshing Morning
description: Increases Max HP of all Resonators in the team by 1250, lasting for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background: "Wondering how I get my morning spark? Here, try a sip."

name: Canned Efficiency
description: Grants 55% Resonance Skill DMG Bonus to all Resonators in the team for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background: A dish Mornye invented back when she was a student in her cooking class. She skipped the decorative fruit topping and packed in extra Dusk Honeypots instead, making each bite far more calorie-dense. According to her classmates, in the name of "better nutrition," she even tried adding fish and soggy Fern Spores...

name: Rainbow Wonder Cup Noodles
description: Increases DEF by 12% and Max HP by 25% for all Resonators in the team, lasting for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background: Lynae's custom version of Midnight Wonder Cup Noodles takes her favorite flavor and tweaks it further. For some reason, the steam that rises when it's cooked glows in rainbow colors. One night, after an all-nighter experiment, a student opened a cup in the lab, and colorful mist drifted up from a dim corner, making them think they were seeing things.

name: Gilded Jadeite
description: Grants 44% Resonance Liberation DMG Bonus to all Resonators in the team for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background:
Wax gourd and fresh crab meat are simmered together with an Uncracked Jade egg mixture in a tureen, creating rich, alternating layers of gold and jade. Stewed slowly in a rich broth, the wax gourd soaks up the full sweetness of the crab, while a delicate topping of finely minced ham adds a savory depth to the unfolding finish. Every spoonful feels like a conversation between the mountains and the sea.

The first time Suisui laid eyes on this soup in a small eatery, she was instantly captivated by its layers of jade-and-gold hue. One spoonful, and the fragrance unfurled across her tongue. From then on, she sent someone to buy takeout from the shop every single day. However, it was tucked away in a remote corner and saw few customers, teetering on the edge of closure and soon to be turned into a tea house. Without a second thought, Suisui marched in with a chest of Credit Shells and an acquisition contract, and set them down squarely in front of the shopkeeper.

name: The Secret of Delicacy
description: Increases ATK of all Resonators in the team by 28%, lasting for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
background:
The egg noodles Yangyang makes, tasting exactly as she remembers her mother's did.

Back in her hometown, Yangyang's schedule was always packed to the brim. Still unsure of where her path would lead, she was constantly trying to squeeze out every last second, desperate to add any edge that might carry her forward.  But no matter how late she came home from vocal lessons, walking back under a starlit sky, a steaming bowl of egg noodles was always waiting for her on the table. Sometimes there would be two bowls, which meant her father had also worked late into the night. And sometimes, there would be three, because her older sister, who was supposed to be fast asleep, would inevitably catch the scent of the noodles and coax her mother into making her a midnight meal.

To Yangyang, that bowl of egg noodles means home, love, and all the quiet warmth folded into everyday life.

It's the flavor that carried her all the way to where she is now, and the exact taste she wishes to pass on to someone special, someday.

name: Supermassive Birthday Cake (2025)
description: An item serving as access to the Birthday Celebration. Used to review blessings sent by your companions.
background: An anonymously gifted birthday cake, brimming with warm wishes and blessings. With rich chocolate, colorful fruit jam, and a lifelike marshmallow Abby on top, it's almost too wonderful to eat!

name: The Stars that Shine For You
description: A customized 2025 birthday accessory for Rover. Before you even notice, this crown gently finds its way into your Backpack.
background: Before you even notice, this crown gently finds its way into your Backpack. Our bonds shine like starlight, weaving stories as brilliant as the boundless galaxies.

name: Happie Birthdaie!
description: The 2025 birthday song, magnificently performed by the Plushie Squad.
background: A sweet Rinascitan-style birthday song performed by the Plushies of the Plushie Village, infused with their warmest wishes just for you!

name: The Frosted Hope in Our Stars
description: An item serving as access to the Birthday Celebration. Used to review blessings sent by your companions.
background:
Cream, icing, chiffon cake... every ingredient handpicked by your friends to bake this little "sweet dream," all for the sake of your gentle smile as you make your wish.
Take a bite, and you'll taste soft, warm memories: the days you shared, the hopes left unspoken, all blending into the cake's comforting aroma.

name: Trails of Companion Stars
description: A customized 2026 birthday accessory for Rover. This circlet braided from starlight and Resonance Cord now rests in your Backpack, as if it had always been there.
background: The stars and voices that travel with you are gathered within this circlet-shaped device, their energy preserved and always flowing around you. Both functional and decorative, it stands for praise, honor, and the heartfelt wish from your friends: "May your path ahead be wrapped in light and hope."

name: A Promised Moment
description: The 2026 birthday song, specially readapted by your dear friends.
background:
A piece of music as gentle and bright as the afternoon breeze that once brushed your cheek. It carries shared memories of adventures, unspoken gratitude, and quiet longing. With every note, the happy days you lived through return once more. This isn't merely a song written for you. It's a moment in time, carefully kept for you.
Happy birthday, Rover.

name: Grand Master
description:
They say Yuanwu can best any challenger in three minutes. It takes him one minute to step into the ring, then another minute to perform a ceremonial bow, and one final minute before the kettle comes to a boil.
"Come now, all martial artists are friends. Do stay for a cup of tea."
background: Fully activate Yuanwu's Resonance Chain

name: Market Maker
description:
In the market, Aalto floats on the boundary between buying and selling, playing different roles: investor, opportunist, and market mover. He lays chips in every corner.
Every investment made is an avenue of future wealth.
background: Fully activate Aalto's Resonance Chain

name: Whispers Amidst the Blooms
description: Planting seeds, watering and nurturing them till they sprout and bloom... That's how Verina initially imagined what the process of "Healing" meant.
background: Fully activate Verina's Resonance Chain

name: Wooly Warrior
description: Encore's paradise is in the land of imagination. Brave Wooly Warriors and their wooly companions leap from the pages of books to a "Happily Ever After."

name: Fangs in Shadow
description: The "hound" in the shadow stalks his prey. First, he is calm, waiting for his target to move through the crowd. Then, unease sets in as the surroundings grow eerily quiet. Finally, the fangs are bared, and the target can no longer see its own shadow.
background: Fully activate Calcharo's Resonance Chain

name: Lion Dancer
description: With every step a dance, he will surely leap to the highest perch.
background: Fully activate Lingyang's Resonance Chain

name: Heart of Clear Mirror
description: With a limpid mind and sustained inner peace, she, who has undergone the trials of the world, completes the final piece of the mirror. The heart is a mirror. The mirror reflects her heart.
background: Fully activate Jianxin's Resonance Chain

name: Loong with the Wind
description: "The enemies surging in were suddenly met by a streak of blue light. Qingloong swept in with the wind, and after the storm subsided, the Midnight Rangers' flag stood tall on the high ground…"
background: Fully activate Jiyan's Resonance Chain

name: Silent Judge
description: Like a puppet with a thousand faces, she walks through the shadows in different facades. But at the end of the day, she's still the one holding the strings.
background: Fully activate Yinlin's Resonance Chain

name: Chrono Thawbringer
description:
It was an age when the flow of time was chaotic, with dawn blurring into dusk and the cold proving relentless.
Doubt, weariness, and the weight of duty... such was the life of a Magistrate. Though quite young, she shouldered it all as she ascended the mountain, striving to illuminate the sky with a sliver of candlelight. It was the moment when winter relented. The thaw came, and the slopes awoke, bathed in the first tender hues of spring...
background: Fully activate Jinhsi's Resonance Chain

name: Eternal Fire
description:
Changli wishes for an era of peace and prosperity.
This is the longest game of Weiqi she's ever played, and with each move, she becomes a part of the game, an eternal fire that lights the way.
background: Fully activate Changli's Resonance Chain

name: Vision of Truth
description:
Xiangli Yao often describes himself as a greedy person, who is hungry for truth, yet equally starves for the warmth of human bonds.
Though he often gazes at the stars, he occasionally casts glances at the distant mountains and the vast land they anchor. And with each step forward, he measures the distance he has traveled, the life he has lived.
background: Fully activate Xiangli Yao's Resonance Chain

name: Ink Dyed Nature
description:
She prefers colors on ink and wash, which, while not the most dazzling, still depict a stunning array of hues.
This is Zhezhi's true colors, that which she hopes will one day burst forth with the power to leave others in awe.
Or at least, during self-introductions...
background: Fully activate Zhezhi's Resonance Chain

name: Stellar Roamer
description: Starlight falls into the deep sea, filling all of her longing and emptiness. In vastness and loneliness, she stood watch over the shores that exist only because of {Male=him;Female=her}... This is her innate duty, both past and future.
background: Fully activate Shorekeeper's Resonance Chain

name: Keen Conservator
description: Though young, Youhu can already distinguish real antiques from fakes. Valuables weighed down by time can only be cherished and cared for when entrusted to those who understand their value.
background: Fully activate Youhu's Resonance Chain

name: Camellya Rouge
description: Blossom, wither, and bloom again with memories of the past. When red and white converge... What form will Camellya take when she flowers once more in your eyes?
background: Fully activate Camellya's Resonance Chain

name: Courier of Dawn
description:
We Promise, We Deliver!
Bright and cheerful Lumi travels across the vast land of Solaris, delivering messages from distant places to those on her route.
background: Fully activate Lumi's Resonance Chain

name: Overflowing Opal
description:
Before this radiant moment arrived, the "gem" had endured endless nights of rain.
Once, she loathed the downpower, but now she embraces the rhythm... With patient hands, she polished the rough stone that was "herself" until it shimmered with a thousand captured hues, in the name of Montelli, and more so in the name of Carlotta.
background: Fully activate Carlotta's Resonance Chain

name: Dancer in the Starlight
description: How should the stage be set for a drama? Spotlights check, curtains check, magnificent costumes? Check. "Pero Pero!" A strange box jumps up and hands her a confetti gun. "Ta-da!" —It's showtime!
background: Fully activate Roccia's Resonance Chain

name: The Merry Fool
description: Set sail! The curtain rises! This maritime stage belongs to Brant. From the bow comes the scent of "Troupe Strength" and wild laughter mocking the outdated doctrines of The Order. On deck, they're rehearsing plays banned by The Order. From the stern, the sea chases after them in pursuit.
background: Fully activate Brant's Resonance Chain

name: Envoy of Light
description: "As the sand of time flickers through your finger, please remember: in the gentle starlight, among beautiful waves, beneath the lantern... and where the kindness of your heart shines, my unspoken words are waiting for you... Listen! The door is open. It's time to move on."
background: Fully activate Phoebe's Resonance Chain

name: Diver of Dreams
description: Where does the dream end and reality begin? The moment your fingers meet the jellyfish, you're falling into a deep sea, descending ever deeper... Only to surface at last into the calm harbor of her gaze.
background: Fully activate Cantarella's Resonance Chain

name: Soloist of Fate
description: Listen! The chimes of a starry, starry night, a prelude to the young maid's song. Bright as midsummer sun even in the depth of the night, yet gentle as the breeze on a summer's day. The wind carries her music across the dark, a melodic story that greets the dawn.
background: Fully activate Ciaccona's Resonance Chain

name: Night Aflame
description:
A fixed routine isn't that bad. Stability has got to count for something. These are words Zani lives by.
Her routine consists of work, meals, sleep, and the occasional bouts of saving the world. Life, after all, is simply a matter of style.
background: Fully activate Zani's Resonance Chain

name: Havoc Reaper
description: In the face of darkness, shadow, and fear, courage is your sharpest blade.
background: Fully activate Rover: Havoc's Resonance Chain

name: The Vanguard Gale
description: The wind that sweeps across mountains and seas knows no hesitation, no retreat. As steadfast as an ancient oath and as faithful as a time-forged pact, I am the blade of justice. I am the vanguard that never falters.
background: Fully activate Rover: Aero's Resonance Chain

name: The Death Defier
description:
The Divinity spoke whispers in her ears, she swung her sword in reply. Fate has written her a script, she tore the pages to shreds.
She has chosen her own path through gale and tide.
background: Fully activate Cartethyia's Resonance Chain

name: Lupus Firestar
description: Flames ignite the cheers of the arena, as the wolf tears out the throats of every shadow. She is the brightest star on the field.

description: A special reward obtained in "Virtual Crisis: Frontier Trials." It records the highest total Stress Level reached during the challenge.

name: The Nevermore
description: The living dwell upon the dark beyond, stubbornly denying the insurmountable divide between life and death.
background: Fully activate Phrolova's Resonance Chain

name: Eternal Blazing Sun
description: What is the Sun? She is the one who offers warmth and radiance without end. To this ancient land, she devotes her blood, her glory, and her life. And thus, she becomes the Sun, the eternal blaze for all to look upon.
background: Fully activate Augusta's Resonance Chain

name: Defier of Fated End
description:
The Moon has always been herself, long before she knew she was the Moon.
She no longer peers into the future through the scattered light of fate, for she understands that wherever she sets her gaze, the future she seeks awaits. Amid the countless paths of destiny, she chooses to become the one true Anchor for herself.
background: Fully activate Iuno's Resonance Chain

name: Flame Undying
description:
I am ash, I am flame; I am darkness, yet I am salvation.
Though light falters and torments sear my flesh, still I remain true to my oath. My undying flame shall scour all evil.
background: Fully activate Galbrena's Resonance Chain

name: Blade Within Bamboo

name: Where the Red Thread Binds

description: I grant this Fu Talisman, purging every trace of malice, until my ears hear only clarity, where neither demon nor divinity remains.

name: Colorful Dawn

name: Anchor of Ideals
description: Observe. Calculate. Calibrate. Extrapolate… And in the end, she reaches toward the stars.
background: Fully activate Mornye's Resonance Chain

name: Wings to Spring

It began as a dream that took root in a child's heart, then was folded into paper wings and cast upon the spring breeze, flying to the end of the stars.
Now, I can finally walk beside you.

name: Golden Diagnosis

Pour some yogurt into the answer, draw some oranges in the runes, spread some frosting over the future.
There is no right or wrong—a perfect balance of sweet and sour.

name: Scorching Frost

All desires are bound by one blade. Every road leads to the same end.
The future that belongs to her alone shall answer her wish.

description: Ten thousand miles she has traveled, and she saw, wherever cooking smoke curls, there is the mortal world; wherever lanternlight glows, there is a flourishing age. name: Mechanite
description: Material gathered from the environment, essential for constructing the Spacetrek Observatory and routes.
background: Once a native mineral widely distributed throughout Lahai-Roi, this ore developed crystalline formations etched with mechanical patterns under the influence of the Exostrider. Electronic devices crafted from this material exhibit modest increases in computational performance, making it a highly sought-after industrial resource.

name: Compressed Bedrock
description: Material recovered from fallen enemies, used in constructing the Spacetrek Observatory and routes.
background: A high-density material processed from Lahai-Roi's native stone. Specially formulated for use with Route Constructors, it played a critical role during the early stages of the Spacetrek Collective's large-scale infrastructure development in Lahai-Roi. When paired with Route Constructors, Compressed Bedrock enabled rapid and stable route deployment across the region.

name: Constructor Core
description: Material gained unintentionally during exploration, used in constructing the Spacetrek Observatory and routes.
background: A portable, rechargeable power unit developed by the Spacetrek Collective to support long-term field expeditions in Lahai-Roi. Within it stores the energy converted from the Reactor's glow by Solis Lens Arrays. Each Constructor Core can supply the basic power needs of a five-person expedition team for approximately 12 hours.

name: Service Credit
description: Points earned by completing the reconstruction of the Spacetrek Observatory and the routes. Can be used to redeem rewards in the store.
background: Digital credits granted by the Spacetrek Collective to anyone who has contributed to the construction of Lahai-Roi's Route Network, which can be redeemed at the Spacetrek Collective for rewards.

name: Purified Mechanite
description: A Mechanite free of impurities, produced only after multiple rounds of highly complex refinement procedures.
background: Specialized material for the older Route Constructor model.

name: Refined Compressed Bedrock
description: A product obtained by further compressing multiple Compressed Bedrocks, a process that consumes an immense amount of energy.

name: Prism Fruit
description: A reward for restoring the Voidbane Eldertrees. Deliver it to I.R.I.S. at the Base Camp to raise your Base Camp Level.
background: The fruit of the Voidbane Eldertree. Its skin, structured like an optical grating, casts dancing rainbows across its surface when struck by light. A treasure for those who study optics, botany, and bionics alike.
source: Complete all Restoration activities in any area

name: Lumen Coin
description: Event points. Used to exchange for rewards.
background: Commemorative coins issued by Startorch Academy to those who contributed to scientific expeditions. Can be collected to exchange for rewards.

name: Constable Token
description: A small token resembling ancient currency. Can be used to exchange for supplies at the Yard Exchange.
background: An official token issued to Constables. It functions as currency to trade for supplies at Shaftpost Yard, but is barred from circulation within the Hold. These tokens are generally distributed as a stipend upon the successful resolution of a case.

name: Trust Key
description: A symbol of a trusted bond forged with H.E.R.M.E.S. Used to unlock and upgrade various clearance levels in the rider training.
background: A data entity formed when H.E.R.M.E.S. grants you access to its underlying data port. You can even sense a faint warmth. Though born from pure logical computation, it feels like the prototype of a genuine heart.

name: Lollo Joy Album
description: A brochure of the Lollo Party. Within its pages, moments from Forever Fest are preserved, each one ready to unfurl into boundless joy.
background: Though Forever Fest may have drawn to a close, it is only at the end of "forever" that new beginnings and happiness can take root... Come and experience the everlasting joy at Lollo Party!

name: Starfall Coin
description: A coin frequency found at Forever Fest. Can be exchanged for decorations from Cobb Copo.
background: An ancient coin frequency long withdrawn from circulation. Similar in form to Monnaie, it bears the pattern of a flowing star.

name: Lollo Voucher
description: A reward voucher from Lollo Logistics, issued to party supporters. Can be exchanged for generous rewards provided by Lollo Logistics.
background: "Lollo Party, may you be happy everyday!"

name: Invitation to the Fest
description: A letter someone left at Forever Fest, inviting you to join a game and help boost the <color=Highlight>Vibe Gauge</color>.
background:
"When revelry swells, and laughter fills the air, you will be answered with a gentle fall of stars."
The handwriting is stylish.
The envelope carries a blended scent of orange juice, lemon peel, and grenadine, a flavor some fondly call "Starfall."

background:
A tiny chip that holds an irresistible pull for any Pinball.
"To the far reaches of the galaxy and beyond!"

name: Stardock Voucher
description: The universal currency of the Sonoro Cosmos. Can be exchanged for supplies and rewards at the Stardock Market.
background:
They say even the most picky person cracks a smile at the sight of this voucher. After all, who could turn down a chance at the next great interstellar adventure?

But still, if you spend it all at once, you'll be left staring at everyone else's loot while quietly plotting your next great get-rich-quick scheme.
